Objective: Collect 5 Water St. Mary Figureheads, 5 Water Angel Figureheads, 5 Water Mermaid Figureheads and deliver them to the God of Luck at Quanzhou Port.

We went onto the island to collect materials to repair our ship, but we met the evil "Taskmaster Rowan" and he injured me. Please, help me get my revenge. I will reward you.
Objective: Kill Taskmaster Rowan

Objective: Collect 50 High class chine and Perfect Hide respectively.

Name: Key to grave
Offer: A Cliff Valley Guardian killed my brother. Please collect 4 hearts of Cliff Valley Guardians for me.
Objective: Collect 4 hearts of Cliff Valley Guardians, then reply to Claude.

Name: Kill head of grave robbers Dante
Offer: Dante, the head of the grave robbers, is the chief of the Golden Pirates. He is hiding in the depth of the grave. If you fail to defeat him, you cannot go forward.
Objective: Kill Dante, then reply to Claude.

Name: Fashion show task- Valiancy garment
Offer: Kill 10 Cannibal Warriors and 10 Cannibal Champions.
Objective: Kill 10 Cannibal Warriors and 10 Cannibal Champions.

Name: Fashion show task- Valiancy garment
Offer: Ah, thanks for helping my good friend Thomas. I can help you make a shapeshift item. I will need 50 Level 10 Cloth, 5 Level 10 Clothing Patterns and 3 Sapphires.
Objective: Collect 50 Level 10 Cloth, 5 Level 10 Clothing Patterns and 3 Sapphires.

Name: Fashion show task - Undead Pirate
Offer: Hey stranger. Recently, gobins have started raiding merchant ships. I have suffered heavy losses at the hands of those accursed goblins. Will you exact revenge for me? Along with my gratitude, I will give you information about the Dead Spirit Pirate Charm.
Objective: Go to the rural area of Basra to kill 10 Jungle Goblins, 10 Spearman Goblins, 10 Dart Goblins, and 10 Poison Dart Goblins.

Name: Fashion show task - Undead Pirate
Offer: Ha ha! So Hardy is still alive! Since you have his badge, you must have come for the charm. But you will have to collect some things for me first.
Objective: Collect 50 Level 10 Leather and 1 Holy Spirit Stone.

Name: Costume Day Quest-The Honor of the Navy
Offer: Welcome, Captain! Do you know of General Willan? He was recently placed in charge of maritime trade. Do you often trade in cloth? If you bring me some cloth, I can introduce you to General Willian.
Objective: Purchase 50 Level 10 Cloth and 30 Level 10 Leather.

Name: Costume Day Quest-The Honor of the Navy
Offer: We have heard of your deeds. Although we managed to flush the pirates from their hideout, the Pirate King managed to escape. Are you willing to hunt down the Pirate King for us?
Objective: Kill 10 Pirate Kings

Name: Fashion show task- Adventure and treasury
Offer: Only the true adventurers are qualified to own the Change Adventurer's Charm. Do you want to try? Tidy up your articles before submitting the quest or you won't be able to obtain your reward.
Objective: Collect a Jadeite Treasure Chest, a Gem Ring, a Silver Brooch, and a Gem Hairpin to Russell in Lisben.

Name: Fashion show task- Merchant and Escort
Offer: How may I serve you? Since you are a friend of Thoreau's, would you like to have a set of my newest clothing designs? I will need 20 Musa, 20 Poacynum, 3 Sapphires, 3 Olivines, and 3 Obsidians.
Objective: Collect 20 Musa, 20 Poacynum, 3 Sapphires, 3 Olivines, and 3 Obsidians.

Name: Costume Day Quest-The Information about Pirates
Offer: Life is so boring! I need some excitement. Oh, a letter from Rick? He helped me before. Let me see. Alright, if you want the Great Pirate's Charm, I want 15 Poacynum and 5 Obsidians in exchange.
Objective: Collect 15 Poacynum and 5 Obsidians

Name: Fashion show task- Craftsman's information
Offer: Tired? You'll never get anywhere without hard work! Time's a-wasting! Will you help me buy some materials? I am too busy. If you help me, I will give you this dagger.
Objective: Collect 10 Level 10 Moulds, 10 Level 10 Hat Flans and 10 Level 10 Clothing Patterns.

Name: Fashion show task- Craftsman's information
Offer: Hey there, Captain. Thanks for the help. If you provide the materials, I can make some Charms for you.
Objective: Collect 3 Level 10 clothing patterns, 3 Level 10 Leathers and 1 Superfine Clothing Pattern.

Name: Fashion show task - The Legend of the Dragon Rider
Offer: I am looking for the legend about Dragon Rider. It might be true! According to Mallika, it can be found in some pirate castle. I am trapped by the pirates on this island. If you kill 10 Pirate Kings, I will give you a letter of introduction for Mallika.
Objective: Kill 10 Pirate Kings

Name: Fashion show task - The Legend of the Dragon Rider
Offer: Have you heard about the legend of the Dragon Rider? Oh, a letter from Mel. Heh, I was only joking with him. There are many legends about the Dragon Rider, but only I know the truth. It be a charm, and I am the only one that can make it in the whole of Pirate City. Collect 5 superior Clothing models, 5 perfect Chine and 5 perfect Hides and I will trade for it.
Objective: Collect 5 superior Clothing models, 5 perfect Chine and 5 perfect Hides to trade with me

Name: Fashion show task- Adventure and treasury
Offer: Beast fur is a perfect defensive material. Do you know Change Barbarian Hunter's Charm? If you have enough time, please make one for me. Before submitting your task, you have to adjust your items, or you cannot obtain any other items.
Objective: Collect 5 Advanced Hides, 5 furs of Palladium, 5 Perfect Chine and 5 Perfect Hides

Name: Fashion show task- Future warrior
Offer: There are so many different types of clothing. I recently salvaged a heavy box at the corner of the harbor. I was confident it was filled with treasure, but instead there's only this inky piece of clothing. If you are interested, it is yours. For a price.
Objective: Collect a Windstorm Stone, a Blaze Stone and a Huge Power Stone.

Name: Fashion show task- The Emperor's New Clothes
Offer: Welcome, brave adventurer. I never expected someone would come look for The Emperor's New Clothes. Ha, I trust you know the rules. Finish the quest then! Only the true of heart will find The Emperor's New Clothes. Go challenge the Devil's Guardians, and bring back 100 gold trophies alive. A warning: they have 8 legs, and can see without light. If you return, I will tell you the next step.
Objective: Collect 100 golden trophies (spun gold)

Name: Fashion show task- The Emperor's New Clothes
Offer: Greetings, mysterious visitor. I am shocked you know who I am… But you had better carry on with the quest. The price of being a secret keeper is steep. I've wasted a lot of time and money to help people like you. To recompensate me for my time, bring me some agates, sapphires and rubies. Don't bother with fakes, I can see through them at a glance. Hmm, you look well to do, so make it 3 of each, ha ha!
Objective: Collect 5 Flawless Agates, 5 Flawless Rubies, and 5 Flawless Sapphires.

Name: The dawn of colony-Bribery Minister
Offer: What's wrong? It seems that you have something to speak to me. Shoot it. I am busy now. What? You mean you want to enlarge our nation's territory. Great, I think it is a good idea. But I am not the one who can make final dicision. If you help me get my favorite collection, i can tell His Majesty your idea. How about getting Ossesian Skull for me. Once you help me get it, i will arrange you to see His Majesty.
Objective: Submit One Ossesian Skull to Colonial Minister.

Name: The dawn of colony-Bribery Minister

Name: The dawn of colony-colony time
Offer: Thank god. The bill has been passed. Bring treasure back to us as much as possible. I have private requirement for you. There is a Trinket Map possessed by a Hell Messenger from Hurricane Island. You have to get it for me. Once you successfully come back, i will appoint you to be Discovery Captain
Objective: Give 25,000,000 silver coins and a Trinket Map

Objective: Kill 5 Wild wolves, 5 Jackals and 5 Coyotes

Offer: Haven't you been attacked by the damned pirates? Do you want to defeat them. We can provide you with the weapons.

Name: Go on the extermination.
Offer: We hope you can help as to extermiante the pirates utill the level of your sea battle reach 21.
Objective: Defeat 5 Steel Tooth Armed Ships and 5 Golden Eye Armed Ships.

Name: The shortcut of purchasing.
Offer: It's time to use Wool Fabricin this season,please buy 20 of it for me.
Objective: Collect 20 Wool Fabric

Name: Trade Caravan
Offer: I know you feel boring about the same trade routine. Now I want to give you the quest about carrying Porcelain. But I suggest you take part in a trade caravan and then you'll know the advantage of it.
Objective: Collect 18 Porcelain

Name: The Bronze is used to make ship.
Offer: Welcome to Seville.If your level of Ore Study still at level 2, I suggest you go back to Athens and boot it to 3 and then go back meet me here again. If you've reached level 3, I hope you can help us to get 20 Impure Copper Ore? After that I'll give you the reward.
Objective: Collect 20 Impure Copper Ore

Name: The wood is uesed to make ship.
Offer: Welcome to Seville. If your Log Study is still at level 2, I suggest you go back to Athens and visit me again after your Log Study reaches level 3. If your Log Study exceeds level 3, I hope you can go to the Suburbs of Lisbon, purchase 20 level 3 Logs and bring them back to me. The Shipbuilding Overman has received a big order. We desperately need wood. Are you willing to help me? I will surely reward you.
Objective: Collect 20 Level 3 Logs

Name: Delicious Codfish
Offer: I like cod, do you like it? Can you provide me some cod? I'll give you reward.
Objective: Collect 20 Codfish

Name: Plant Linen
Offer: It's very surprise that you want to learn some thing about planting. I'll give you the 20 Rosemary Seeds if you collect 5 Linen.
Objective: Collect 10 Linen

Name: Experience Auto-planting
Offer: Planting is a hard work, but with Auto-planting Card, things will become very easy. Here is an Auto-planting Trial Card, you can experience Auto-planting for one day with it.
Objective: Collect 11 Rosemary

Name: Purchase Rosemary
Offer: I am buying Rosemary. I see that you have a beautiful crop of the very stuff. Would you be willing to sell some to me?
Objective: Collect 20 Rosemary

Name: Collect the necessary materials for Alchemy.
Offer: I'm not a peculiar Alchemist. I am a devout Catholic, my whole family are Catholics. I belive God is omnipotent and benevolent although he cannot help me to deal with our cold or other illness. Often, I use medicine to cure people. But now I need some plant. Can you collect some for me? After that I'll teach you about the medicine.
Objective: Collect 5 Mystic Fruits and 5 Rosemary

Name: Antidote
Offer: Can you make the Low-level Antidote to help the patients in the city?
Objective: Collect 10 Antidotes

Name: Sailor Uniform
Offer: Can you help me to make 5 European Male Sail-controller Uniforms?
Objective: Collect 5 European Male Sail-controller Uniforms

Name: To make Kukri
Offer: Can you help me to make 6 Broad Kukris?
Objective: Collect 6 Broad Kukris

Name: To make the Dolphin Figurehead.
Offer: Can you make the Dolphin Figurehead? If you can, make 3 of it to me.
Objective: Submit 3 Fire Dolphin Figureheads (With 5 chances to withstand upgrade failure)

Name: Sicily Frog
Offer: Go to kill the aberrance of the fog at the Sicily Caves. After that I'll give you the reward.
Objective: Kill 8 Toads, 8 Bullfrogs and 8 Poisonous Frogs

Name: Materials for Sewing
Offer: Making dress requires cloth, processing cloth needs textiles, you understand? Collect some level 1 textiles and process them into level 1 cloth, then give them to me.
Objective: Collect 10 level 1 cloth

Name: Materials for Figurehead
Offer: To let you know the flow of ship-building better, I need you to collect the materials first, then, I'll teach you the basic ship-building and give your related drawing.
Objective: Collect 6 Level 1 Timbers and 6 Pig Irons

Name: Materials For Foundry
Offer: To let you know the flow of foundry better, I need you to collect the materials first, then, I'll teach you the basic foundry and give your related drawing.
Objective: Collect 2 Level 2 Timbers and 2 Pig Irons

Name: Killerbee in Sicily
Offer: There are Killerbees living in land on Sicily Island. Do you dare go to there and kill1 5 Killerbees?
Objective: Defeat 15 Killerbees

Name: Sicily Wild Boar
Offer: Wild Boars always destroys the corps.I hope you can deal with them.
Objective: Defeat 15 Wild Boars

Name: Trouble of North European Trade Route
Offer: There is some trouble of North European Trade Route. Do you want to help the Queen to deal with it? If you go to exterminate the pirates, I will give you the reward on behalf of the Queen.
Objective: Destroy 8 Golden Eye Armed Ships and 8 Jackal Armed Ships.

Name: In Fashion!
Offer: The prevalence is important for trade. If you happen to sell something which is pop in the local place, you will gain double profits. And now the Scorpion Venom is in pop here. I want you to carry 20 of it from Accra and then give it to me.
Objective: Collect 20 Scorpion Venom

Name: Finished Bronze
Offer: Mr Mu from Pamirs plateau need you to smelt 50 brozens.
Objective: Collect 50 Brozens

Name: Process Lumber
Offer: Indians are goona hold the Canoe Competition, and they need many woods to build the ships. Captain, could you help me to collect 50 Level 3 Timbers.
Objective: Collect 50 Level 3 Timbers.

Name: London Codfish
Offer: The level of the Fishing Net will limit what kind fish you can get. Once your dredging reaches level 31, you can get the high-level fish by using level 30 fishing net. But before that, I hope you can get back 90 Cod to me.
Objective: Collect 90 Codfishes

Name: It Still Smells Nice from FarAway(1)
Offer: Your planting skill must be level 21. So you can plant level 3 crops. However, you may learn how to plant level 4 corps, you still cannot do it without level 31 hoe. I have 100 Thymus vulgaris Seeds which are suitable for you. You can get it if you give me 50 rosemaries.
Objective: Collect 50 Rosemaries

Name: It Still Smells Nice from FarAway(2)
Offer: Oh, great! You've reached level 31, but where is the Thymus? If you give me 100 of it I'll give you rewards. Hoe can be used to plant level 4 or higher corps. Ghost Change Charm can be used to scare the sparrow. And these 6 pieces can be made one treasure map by the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona.
Objective: Collect 100 Thymus

Name: Purchase Thymus
Offer: Do you want to sell the Thymus vulgaris? I need it.
Objective: Collect 50 Thymus

Name: Incitantia
Offer: If you make 20 Low-level Incitantia for me and the quality is very well, I'll give you reward.
Objective: Collect 20 Low-level Incitantia.

Name: Purchase Incitantia
Offer: I need more incitantia,can you give me some again?
Objective: Collect 20 Low-level Incitantia.

Name: Army Uniform
Offer: Can you make 5 Male Infantry Lieutenant Junior Grade Uniforms for me?
Objective: Collect 5 Male Infantry Lieutenant Junior Grade Uniforms

Targets.Name: Male Infantry Lieutenant Junior Grade Uniform

Name: Ornamental Western Sword
Offer: Can you make 5 Broad Western Swords for me? Pretty is the most significant. The quality is not neccessay...
Objective: Collect 5 Broad Western Swords

Name: Coquilhatville Sailboat
Offer: 5 Coquilhatville Sailboat is going to sail. Can you make 5 Water Sea Horse Figureheads from me?
Objective: Collect 5 Water Sea Horse Figurehead(With 5 chances to withstand upgrade failure)

Name: Fight against Bear (Sword-playing)
Offer: If you can kill the powerful bear in Mallorca Inland, I'll give you reward.
Objective: Kill 5 Grizzly Bears, 5 Brown Bears and 5 Black Bears

Name: Fight against Bear (Sword-playing)
Offer: If you can kill the powerful bear in Mallorca Inland, I'll give you reward.
Objective: Kill 5 Grizzly Bears, 5 Brown Bears and 5 Black Bears

Name: Fight against Bear (Gun-playing)
Offer: If you can kill the powerful bear in Mallorca Inland, I'll give you reward.
Objective: Kill 5 Grizzly Bears, 5 Brown Bears and 5 Black Bears

Name: Fight against Bear (Axe-playing)
Offer: If you can kill the powerful bear in Mallorca Inland, I'll give you reward.
Objective: Kill 5 Grizzly Bears, 5 Brown Bears and 5 Black Bears

Name: Hematophagous Bats
Offer: It's said the Bats in Mallorca Caves like to suck the blood of people, the tourists are very scared. Could you help to eliminate some of them.
Objective: Slay 5 Ghost Shape Bats, 5 Black Wing Bats and 5 Fox Bats.

Name: Cape of Good Hope Pirates
Offer: Since the Cape of Good Hope was discovered, more and more Merchant Ships have been using that route. More merchants means more pirates. Go take care of them with your cannon, buddy.
Objective: Exterminate 10 Falcon Armed Ships and 10 Jackal Raiding Ships in Cape of Good Hope Battlefield.

Name: Compressing Provision
Offer: Did your ship oftern sail at a lowest speed because you didn't carry enough provisions? Hehe`it tastes bad. If you don't want to experience that again, I can tell you a good idea--carry Compressing Provisions. They won't take any ship space and weight. They can help much especially in a team commercial travel. You can buy some from item mall. But I think you can't afford it now. Luckily, I still have some Compressing Provisions. But I won't give you for free. Bring me 5 helpings of Marijuana, 5 helpings of Wheat and 5 Mirrors, then I will give you one.
Objective: Collect 5 helpings of Marijuana, 5 helpings of Wheat and 5 Mirrors

Name: Oceanic Trade
Offer: Bring me 24 Datura back from Muscat.the principal awaits you at Seville. (You need to go to the Seville City to sumbit this quest)
Objective: Collect 24 Datura

Name: African Miner
Offer: There are some good mines at the suburb of Las Palmas. These mines yield various ores, such as brass, which is what I need. Bring me 80 brass please.
Objective: Collect 80 brasses

Name: Galenic Carrack
Offer: I need plenty of wood to build a Galenic Carrack. Can you help me to collect 80 Level 4 Timbers. Submit 80 Level 4 Timbers
Objective: Collect 80 Level 4 Timbers

Name: African Electric Ray
Offer: Many Electric Rays appear alongshore of the port recently. That's why many fishers dare not take water. Can you help us solve this problem?
Objective: Collect 20 Electric Rays

Name: African Farmer
Offer: There are not many planters here. But I just have some unwanted Seeds of Holy Light Weed. If you bring me 100 Thymus vulgaris, I can give them to you.
Objective: Collect 100 Thymus

Name: Purchase Holy Light Weed
Offer: I am purchasing Holy Light Weeds. If you have any, just sell to me.
Objective: Collect 50 Holy Light Weeds

Name: African Witch Doctor
Offer: I am a witch doctor. I cure people with herbs. Whites always consider us to be curious and evil. But I think their pricking blood therapy is really evil. Hun--all the sailors on the Santa Mary are ill strangely. This is really a good opportunity for me to prove my medical skill. Would you please help me make some Secondary Healing Potions?
Objective: Collect 20 Secondary Healing Potion

Name: Adventuring Equipment
Offer: Many adventurers have come here recently. So if we sell Explorer Leather Dresses, we shall make much money. Want to cooperate with me?
Objective: Collect 6 High-Level Male Exploration Armor

Name: Adventurer's Weapon
Offer: There are lots of beasts in Africa. So Long-barrel Guns are always very marketable. Would you like to help me make 5 Rapid-fire Long-barrel Guns? I will reward you.
Objective: Collect 5 Rapid-fire Long-barrel Guns

Name: Water Lion
Offer: Big ship can contain more goods but small boat can run quicker.And most figureheads of Light Merchant Ships are Water Lion Figureheads. If you are able to make Water Lion Figureheads, please make 5 for me.
Objective: Collect 5 Water Lion Figurehead(With 5 chances to withstand failure)

Name: Strike Smugglers
Offer: Smuggle is very rampant. They refuse to pay taxes because they have armed ships. It really enrages the shaikh. So, would you please help us destroy their armed ships?
Objective: Defeat 3 Jackal Armed Ships at the Cape of Good Hope.

Name: End of Jackals
Offer: Greetings, excellent sea captain. You look like you've seen your share of sea battles. So you must be very familiar with Jackal Armed Ships, right? Well, we've been working hard to exterminate them. If you can help us destroy 10 Jackal Armed Ships and 20 Golden Eye Armed Ships, I will reward you with a lot of experience and a mystic gift. Ships of this kind are usually found at the North Sea Battlefield.
Objective: Destroy 10 Jackal Armed Ships and 20 Golden Eye Armed Ships at the North Sea Battlefield

Name: The Scar of War
Offer: War has brought us disaster. Our country has lacked materials seriously. If you can provide us with plenty of goods, I can reward you with lots of Eloquence experience and a mystic gift.
Objective: Collect 6 boxes of Datura, 8 boxes of Marijuana and 8 boxes Rose Oil.

Name: The Anneal to Advance (Falchion-playing)
Offer: Do you think you are not skilled enough at falchion-playing? Surely, you haven't used a falchion for a long time. If you continue to practise your falchion-playing skill and also bring us some loots, I can reward you with lots of falchion-playing experience and a mystic gift.
Objective: Slay 10 Ghost Shape Bats and 20 Black Wing Bats

Name: The Anneal to Advance (Sword-playing)
Offer: Do you think you are not skilled enough at sword-playing? Surely, you haven't used a falchion for a long time. If you continue to practise your sword-playing skill and also bring us some loots, I can reward you with lots of sword-playing experience and a mystic gift.
Objective: Slay 10 Ghost Shape Bats and 20 Black Wing Bats

Name: The Anneal to Advance (Axe-playing)
Offer: Do you think you are not skilled enough at axe-playing? Surely, you haven't used a falchion for a long time. If you continue to practise your axe-playing skill and also bring us some loots, I can reward you with lots of axe-playing experience and a mystic gift.
Objective: Slay 10 Ghost Shape Bats and 20 Black Wing Bats

Name: The Anneal to Advance (Gun-playing)
Offer: Do you think you are not skilled enough at Gun-playing? Surely, you haven't used a falchion for a long time. If you continue to practise your falchion-playing skill and also bring us some loots, I can reward you with lots of shooting experience and a mystic gift.
Objective: Slay 10 Ghost Shape Bats and 20 Black Wing Bats

Name: A Luxurious Villa
Offer: The General Zhang want to build a villa. If you provide us with the timber, I can give you a mystic gift.
Objective: Collect 100 Level 5 Timbers

Name: Constantly Strive to Become Stronger
Offer: Weapon, we need them! Even though every country touts peace as slogan, they are still producing them. To produce wearpon, we need tons of mineral, collect us some, we will reward you for that.
Objective: Collect 100 Copper.

Name: Lack of Medicine
Offer: We need the materials to make medicine and bandage. We'll give you a mystic gift if you provide some for us.
Objective: Collect 50 Coffee, 50 Bewitching Weed and 100 Sisal Hemp.

Name: Provide Fish
Offer: We now need lots of marine products. We'll give you a mystic gift if you provide some for us.
Objective: Collect 80 boxes of Mackerel.

Name: Falcon in War
Offer: Do you want to exterminate the Falcon Pirate Ship? Whoever finishes it will get a mystical gift. Ships of this kind are usually found at the Cape of Good Hope Battlefield.
Objective: Exterminate 10 Falcon Armed Ships and 20 Jackal Raiding Ships.

Name: Commercial Overlord's Dream
Offer: Are you a successful businessman? Do you want to help us to import some goods?(You need to go to the Seville City to sumbit this quest)
Objective: Hand over 6 boxes of Datura, 8 boxes of Marijuana and 8 boxes Rose Oil.

Name: The Peak of Advancement (Falchion-playing)
Offer: It seems that you are good at using a falchion. I know you've learned advanced falchion skill for a period of time. I believe you'll be more powerful after some hard work. I can give you good jewelry and a mystic gift if you give me some booty.
Objective: Kill 10 Single Arm Skeletons and 20 Dry Skeletons.

Name: The Peak of Advancement (Sword-playing)
Offer: It seems that you are good at using a falchion. I know you've learned advanced falchion skill for a period of time. I believe you'll be more powerful after some hard work. I can give you good jewelry and a mystic gift if you give me some booty.
Objective: Kill 10 Single Arm Skeletons and 20 Dry Skeletons.

Name: The Peak of Advancement (Axe-playing)
Offer: It seems that you are good at using a falchion. I know you've learned advanced falchion skill for a period of time. I believe you'll be more powerful after some hard work. I can give you good jewelry and a mystic gift if you give me some booty.
Objective: Kill 10 Single Arm Skeletons and 20 Dry Skeletons.

Name: The Peak of Advancement (Gun-playing)
Offer: It seems that you are good at using a falchion. I know you've learned advanced falchion skill for a period of time. I believe you'll be more powerful after some hard work. I can give you good jewelry and a mystic gift if you give me some booty.
Objective: Kill 10 Single Arm Skeletons and 20 Dry Skeletons.

Name: Want of Timbers
Offer: I need some timbers to repair my ruin of a house. I'll give you lots of experience and a mystic gift as reward.
Objective: Collect 150 Level 6 Timbers

Name: Flames of War
Offer: We need lots of ore to make cannon so as to promote our arms expansion. Do you want to help us. You will get lots of EXP and a mystic gift.
Objective: Collect 150 Green Silver

Name: Abundant Seafood
Offer: Marine Products are abundant in the cities which located near the sea. Wee now need lots of marine products. Can you help us? You will get lots of EXP and a mystic gift.
Objective: Hand over 100 chests of Electric Ray

Name: Import Weapons
Offer: We need some guns, can you make some for me? By doing this simple task you will gain lots of experience and a mystic gift as reward. Hand over 4 Lieutenant Colonel Guns
Objective: Collect 4 Lieutenant Colonel Command Guns

Name: Falcon in Flames of War
Offer: We need lots of Fire Falcon Figureheads, can you make some for me? You will get lots of EXP and a mystic gift as rewards.
Objective: Collect 3 Fire Falcon Figureheads

Name: Defeat Evil Beast Trainer
Offer: Ever since my fellow young apprentice was bewitched by that magician, he has indulged in unnatural spells. As a result, he has hurt many creatures. Would you please defeat him? I guess he must be in the dense forest. Notes: He does not appear in the forest very often.
Objective: Defeat Evil Beast Trainer

Name: Slay Giant Lizard
Offer: Mallorca Island is celebrated for both its scenic beauty and pleasant climate. This is the reason why so many Nobles choose to make their home there. However it's beauty has been spoiled as many people have been attacked by the demented beasts there. So, we have no choice, we must kill all of those hateful beasts especially the Giant Lizards.
Objective: Kill all of the Mallorcan Giant Lizards. They must be in the Dungeon there.

Name: Slay Black Widow
Offer: If you are willing to kill the Black Widow, then it must also be true that you are willing to go deep into the Cretan Labyrinth to do so.
Objective: Kill the Black Widow, then it must also be true that you are willing to go deep into the Cretan Labyrinth to do so

Name: Slay Caveman Chief
Offer: Please help me to kill the Caveman Chieftain. He has become a great threat to adventurers.
Objective: Slay Caveman Chief

Name: Slay Ghost
Offer: Please help slay the Phantom of the Taj Mahal. I will greatly reward you.
Objective: Slay 1 ghost in the Taj Mahal.

Name: Slay the Guardian Beast
Offer: Since you dare to hunt for treasure in the imperial tomb, finishing off the Protection Beast is sure to be an easy mission for you, right?
Objective: Slay the Guardian Beast

Name: Defeat Evil Mage Image
Offer: Evil Mage Image has recently been doing bad things to local citizens, can you teach him a lesson? You should notice that he usually has some images, so I suggest you should defeat those images first.
Objective: Defeat Evil Mage Image

Name: Defeat Clan Leader
Offer: Since our clan leader saw the Magic Stone, he was bewitched by it and has become obsessed with praying to it to make him a god. However, without his leadership our harvests have grown poorer and poorer. Now we do not even have enough food to live on, many of us are sure to die of hunger soon. So, we need your help. Help us to awake him. Rescue our clan please.
Objective: Defeat Clan Leader

Name: Defeat Maya King
Offer: The enemy is pressing heavily on our borders and we fear that we cannot resist for much longer. But alas! Our king is still ordering people to build his tomb instead of leading us in the fight. We attempted to call Apollo and beg him to help his loyal servants. Are you his envoy come to rescue us?
Objective: Defeat Maya King

Name: Collect Crab Pincers
Offer: Crab Pincers can be used for making some small tools, can you collect some for me?
Objective: Collect 5 Crab Pincers

Name: Hunt Goats
Offer: Damn Goats! They attacked me when I was passing by their territory! I hope you can kill them for me.
Objective: Slay 5 Goats and 1 Bellwether.

Name: Kill Depressed Poet
Offer: It's time to punish the Depressed Poet.
Objective: Defeat the "Depressed Poet" in the Athens Suburbs

Name: Trading quests of Alexandria and Beirut
Offer: Help me to do something in Alexandria, you can also practise your trade skill with that.
Objective: Purchase 5 helpings of Wheat from Alexandria and 5 Dates from Beirut.

Name: Mission of purchasing Lobsters
Offer: Lobsters from Seville is very popular, hope you can complete the quest perfectly this time.
Objective: Purchase 15 Lobsters from Seville

Name: Fishing Quest 1
Offer: Try to learn fishing, then you can catch some fish after you eat all the beef and pork at sea.
Objective: 10 Tunny, 4 Sardine Fishing Skill reaches 4

Name: Fishing Quest 2
Offer: The more skillful your fishing is,the higher efficiency it would be. Go practise your fishing.
Objective: 25 Tunny and 10 Sardine

Name: Mission of abstracting Pig Irons
Offer: Abstracting Pig Irons requires Impure Minerals, be patient to dig them, and then abstract Pig Irons from them.
Objective: 10 Pig Irons

Name: Mission of Pure Irons
Offer: Even you have mastered abstracting Pig Irons, you are still a far cry from a real Miner, go dig the Iron Ore and try to abstract Pure Irons out of them, it will help you take a step forward to be a Miner.
Objective: 10 Pure Irons

Name: Mission of Level 1 Log
Offer: Timber-felling is bored, but I have to do it for a living, can you do something for me?
Objective: 30 Level 1 Log

Name: Mission of processing timbers
Offer: Processing timbers is fuuny, but gathering logs is bored. Even that, I still need you to gather some logs and process them into timbers for me.
Objective: 10 Level 1 Timbers

Name: Mission of Level 2 Timber
Offer: I think you might had guessed it. Right! It's Level 2 Timbers after Level 1. Haha, but never feel that this is bored, because timber is crucial to the production of ships, you will understand it.
Objective: 10 Level 2 Timber

Name: Plant Linen
Offer: Planting hasn't been ceased from generation to generation, so you must master it too.
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Collect Catnip Seeds
Offer: I need some special seeds, can you please do me this favor.
Objective: 8 Catnip Seeds

Name: Train level 6 shipbuilding skill
Offer: Shipbuilding Skill is a very important skill to a voyager.
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Train level 11 shipbuilding skill
Offer: Better Ships require better materials.
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Quest Completed
Offer: You are really a great voyager!
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Train level 6 foundry skill
Offer: Strong Ships and Powerful Cannon lead to victory, that's why you need to master the advanced foundry skill.
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Train level 11 foundry skill
Offer: These materials are prepared for mastering foundry better,
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Quest Completed
Offer: hmm, I guess you have already mastered
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Train level 6 sewing skill
Offer: To learn Sewing, you need to prepare some materials.
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Train level 11 sewing skill
Offer: These materials are prepared for mastering sewing better,
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Quest Completed
Offer: As long as do, you will find sweing is actually easy like you think.
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Train level 6 alchemy
Offer: To get a better life, you should learn alchemy.
Objective: Talk to the Skill Instructor at Athens Dock

Name: Delicious Seafood
Offer: I like crab clamps with a little turtle blood. Disgusting? Hold on, young man, you can't decide so fast. Near the port in Athens, there are a lot of turtles and crabs. get me some crab clamps with turtle blood. I will give you a good price.
Objective: Go to Athens Port to kill 1 Turtle, and then kill Crabs to collect 5 Crab Pincers? After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor.

Name: Potion Purchase
Offer: You don't seem to do much exercise…you only ran a little while and you look pale now. Find Alchemist and bring me 2 potions.
Objective: Hand in 1 Low-level Healing Potion and 1 Low-Level Recovery Potion,the Alchemist is in downtown Athens. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Go Hunting
Offer: What a lovely day! Young man, do you want to go hunting? Near the suburbs of Athens, there are a lot of Pheasants and foxes.
Objective: Go to Athens Suburbs and kill 10 Pheasants and 10 Red Foxes? After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Short of Wool
Offer: Wool is our main export. However, recently many wild goats have eaten a large part of the grass in our pasture and our sheep can't eat well which leads to poor quality wool. Can you slay some wild goats, and bring me some wool.
Objective: Head for the Athens Suburbs and kill the Goat? Bellwether and collect 5 Fine Wool and 10 Wool? After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Collect Special Plants
Offer: With the weather becoming hot, I would like to wear clothes made of flax which can make me feel cool and comfortable. Near the suburb, there is a lot of Jute and Linen. Can you help me to get some of them?
Objective: Collect 4 Jute and 4 Linen. The Athens Suburbs produce Jute and Linen? After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Collect Production Tools
Offer: To dig mine, you need Inferior Pickaxe. To forge, you need Level 1 Mould. To sew, you need Inferior Sewing Kit.They can be bought from Blacksmith, and Tailor. Bring me the three tools.
Objective: Hand in 1 Inferior Pickaxe, 1 Level 1 Mould, which can be bought from the Blacksmith, hand in 1 Inferior Sewing Kit, which can be bought from the Tailor. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor.

Name: Dangerous Freak
Offer: Wanted! A freak named Walyze killed 5 lumberjacks near the suburb of Athens and escaped a few days ago. This freak is a major threat to citizens' security, so the king will give a big reward to anyone who can kill him. It's difficult for you to kill him, so you'd better find Skill Tutor and learn Bare-handed Fighting which will help you kill the freak easily.
Objective: Go to find the Skill Tutor and learn Bare-handed Fighting? After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor
GiverSource: GUESS report-to NPC of an "After completing the quest, report to" text

Name: Defeat Depressed Poet
Offer: Are you ready? As far as I know, Walyze may hide in the suburb of Athens near Temple of Parthenon. Take care!
Objective: Defeat the Depressed Poet in the Athens Suburbs After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Businessman's First Try
Offer: To become a successful businessman, eloquence is the trait you need to have. Go to find Trader and buy 5 seafood from him.
Objective: Hand in 5 boxes of seafood, which can be bought from the Trader in downtown Athens. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Prepare for Sailing
Offer: Well done. You have proved that you have the potential to be a good businessman. Now it's time for you to do business across the vast ocean. Apart from a good ship, you also need to recruit enough sailors and prepare enough provisions.
Objective: From the dockhand in the Athens Port, buy 1000 Provisions and recruit 50 sailors. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: The First Order
Offer: I got an order! Someone would like to pay a good price to buy baskets of olives. There are many cheap olives in Istanbul. Bring some back.
Objective: Hand in 10 boxes of olives, which can be bought from the Trader in the Istanbul Port. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Hunger Threat
Offer: I want you to do me one more favor. A ship loaded with wheat and necessities from Alexandria to here sank due to a storm. The wheat in market has been in short now, and no wheat will be shipped to here in a short term. I need you to go to Alexander and bring mutton and wheat back to help people to get through the hunger threat.
Objective: Find the Trader in Alexander City and buy 5 boxes of Wheat and 5 boxes of mutton. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Business Knowledge
Offer: It's time to learn something. Go to find skill tutor and learn eloquence stunt. Higher level eloquence will help you more in business.
Objective: Go to the Skill Tutor to increase the shopping skill of Eloquence to at least level 2. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor
GiverSource: GUESS report-to NPC of an "After completing the quest, report to" text

Name: Finance Management
Offer: It's too dangerous to carry the money with you. An accident could lead to the loss of all your hard-earned money. Venice Bank has branches in almost every city, so its quite convenient for you to draw and deposit money at Bank clerk.
Objective: Find the Bank Clerk to deposit at least 1 Silver Coin. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor
GiverSource: GUESS report-to NPC of an "After completing the quest, report to" text

Name: The King's Reward 1
Offer: Cretan Pirates have recently been attacking our navy. Since the terrain here is very complicated and not suitable for large scale battle, it is not easy to eradicate them. The king has announced that whoever defeats the pirate ships will obtain big rewards. Want to try? You need to find Shipyard Boss and buy some gear to arm your ship.
Objective: Find the Shipyard Boss in the Athens Port and buy 400 Cannon Balls, 1 Ship Armour and 70 cannons. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: King's Reward 2
Offer: Has your ship been armed? Cretan Pirates' nest is quite near the south of Athens. Their nest is actually called Crete Battlefield.
Objective: Head for the Creten Battlefield to destroy 10 Crete Peg Leg Armed Ships and 10 Crete Iron Fist Armed Ships. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Enhance Morale 1
Offer: Because of your effort, those loathsome pirates dare not attack our city anymore. But our citizens are still afraid of them – can you bring some pirates' heads back to enhance our morale? To achieve this, you need to learn Grappling to embark on enemies' ships during the sea battle.
Objective: Ask the Skill Tutor to improve grappling of Sea Battle to at least level 1. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor
GiverSource: GUESS report-to NPC of an "After completing the quest, report to" text

Name: Enhance Morale 2
Offer: Oh, I almost forgot to tell you that you also need to buy a Grappling. Go to the dock and find Shipyard Boss. Buy a Grappling Hook.
Objective: Find the Shipyard Boss in the Athens Port and buy 1 Grappling Hook. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Enhance Morale 3
Offer: Everything is ready. Defeat those pirates. I expect you to come back victorious.
Objective: Head for the Creten Battlefield to use Grappling and Close fighting to kill 1 Crete Peg Leg Ship Captain and 1 Creten Iron Hand Ship Captain. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor. The way to use Grappling: Open Instruction Column(CTRL+A), click "Sea" among "Social" "Land" and "Sea", then you can see the Grappling Skill icon, drag this icon to the shortcut at the bottom of the interface. After clicking the target ship, press a corresponding key or click the icon to use this skill. If you don't see the icon, maybe you haven't learnt Grappling yet. If the icon is red, it means that you haven't equipped the hook to your ship or your SP is too low.

Name: Genoa is seeking help 1
Offer: I've received a letter from Genoa, which says near the suburb of Genoa,many wolves have been eating the citizens. Can you go to there and slay 10 wolves of each kind.
Objective: Head for the Genoa Suburb to kill 10 Coyotes, 10? Jackals and 10 Wild wolves. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Genoa is seeking help 2
Offer: The wolves have left temporarily, but they will be back soon. If you can slay the wolf lord,they will not dare come back again.
Objective: Hand in 1 Wolf Lord Fang from Wolf Lord in the Genoan Suburbs. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Take the First Action
Offer: Recently, we have learned that Crete Pirates are planning to unite Gibraltar Pirates to attack Athens. Now, I need you to teach them a lesson so that they will not dare do that.
Objective: Head for the Gibraltar Battlefield to destroy 10 Steel Tooth Armed Ship and 10 Golden Eye Armed Ships. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Star Ocean
Offer: All right. You are a qualified captain now. There is nothing more I can teach you. I am gonna give you this magazine called Voyagers Times which contains the list of quests around the world, and I can also write a letter of recommendation for you so that many friends of mine may take care of you. Can you help me buy a piece of Ordinary letter paper from the Alchemist first?
Objective: Find the Alchemist and buy 1 Ordinary letter paper, After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor. After this all quests from the Profession Mentor are completed, you may now accept the next quests from the Voyagers Times.

Name: Hunt Goat(Repeatable)
Offer: Once you have killed 20 Goats and 20 Bellwethers, the ranchers will give you rewards, are you willing to do this?
Objective: Head for the Athens Suburbs to kill 20 Goats and 20 Bellwethers. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: Slay Pirates(Repeatable)
Offer: The King's Reward is still valid, are you willing to help us to defeat the Creten Pirates?
Objective: Head for the Creten Battlefield to destroy 10 Crete Peg Leg Armed Ships and 10 Crete Iron Fist Armed Ships. After completing the quest, report to the Profession Mentor

Name: The Silk Route to Riches 2
Offer: There you go! Deliver these or those aristocrats will have to wear flax clothes to the party.
Objective: Submit 20 boxes of classy silk

Name: Smuggler nameplate
Offer: How come people are found making money from smuggled Shortbread ingredients. Go kill them and bring their Smuggler nameplate back to me.
Objective: Submit 30 Smuggler nameplates to Beggar Event Envoy.

Name: Gold Rush 1
Offer: Dreaming of getting rich quick? Why not join the gold rush. It's said that a huge gold mine was found in San Francisco. The local government has now banned any individual from mining. But you can still see the locals excavating around the mine. They want someone to help them ship their gold. If you have nuts and ships, you can buy gold from Henry Kim and sell gold to Lopez at Zhigu Port.
Objective: Go to San Francisco and buy gold from HenryKim

Name: Findings Authentication
Offer: An Appraisal Expert is very resourceful and they know everything. Bring a Sheep Horn to Appraisal Expert Pascal at Athens, he will tell you the details about what kind it is and its habits.
Objective: Bring a Sheep Horn to Appraisal Expert Pascal,,and kill some Bellwethers to get the horn. (Notice: the quest is to bring a horn to Pascal,not to collect many horns. After Pascal checks out the horn, you should go to find Profession Mentor to finish the quest.)

Name: Gold Rush 2
Offer: Lopez buy the gold all the time in Zhigu Port.,if you sell gold to him,you will get the good price.
Objective: Go to Zhigu,sell the gold to Lopez
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Guide-Crete Instance Quest
Offer: You can now go to the Cretan inland and talk to Samaris to accept the Cretan Instance Quests. The quest may be accepted once a day.
Objective: Go to Crete inland and say hi to Samaris, as he is the one who can give you the Cretan Inland quests.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Guide-Madagascar Instance Quest
Offer: You can go to Madagascar and talk to Paul, he will be able to give you quests. You can accept these quests once each day.
Objective: Go to Madagascar and say hi to Paul, as he is the one who can give you the Madagascar quests.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Guide-Taj Mahal Instance Quest
Offer: You can now go to the outskirts of Bombay and say hi to Larry, he will be able to give you some quests. These quests may be accepted once each day.
Objective: Go to the outskirts of Bombay and say hi to Larry, as he is the one who can give you the Taj Mahal Instance Quests.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Kind Friar
Offer: Priest tole me a friar was prisoned because he blessed a new couple. It's rediculous. I think I need to visit that Kind Friar.
Objective: Go to Dungeon and visit Valentine

Name: Final Wish
Offer: Go to visit the Valentine in the Dungeon and know that he loves Wardern's daughter. He hope he can see her again. I promise I'll talk about it to the Warden.
Objective: Go to talk with Warden
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Valetine's Herb
Offer: Valetine told me he wanted to heal his loved girl's eyes with the herb. But Warden didn't agree with him. So he hoped I can help him.
Objective: Go to talk with Warden
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: God's Joke
Offer: 3 days later, the priest told me Eos' eyes is alright and warden wanted to hold a party to celebrate it. However, he also passed a death sentence on Valentine.
Objective: Go to Athens and visit Eos

Name: Priest's goods
Offer: Priest haven't got back his goods after it's reached. Docker hoped I can tell it to him.
Objective: Talk with the priest in Athens
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Skill Master
Offer: If you have no skills then there's no way that you will be able to survive here! Find Verne in Athens to learn about how you can go about becoming a qualified captain.
Objective: Find Skill Tutor and learn a skill. After that, return to Athens and talk to the Verne.

Name: A Favor
Offer: Verne has a friend in Athens who runs a tavern. Recently, he has been short of hands and his business is suffering. Can you go to there to help him?
Objective: Go to the tavern in Athens and find the boss.

Name: Delicious Seafood
Offer: I like a glass of wine, together fresh baked crab claws with a little olive oil and fresh turtle blood. Tunisian turtle blood, of course! Disgusting? Hold on, young man, you can't come to such a conclusion without first trying them. However, sadly I have run out of the ingredients to make the dish. If you would be so good as to collect some for me, then I would be more than happy to whip you up a batch.
Objective: Go to the Athens Dock and kill 1 sea turtles,then kill crabs to collect 5 Crab Pincers. After the quest has been completed, talk to Wendora (Press ALT+F to automatically attack any monsters nearby)

Name: Kind Wendora
Offer: Now that the quest has been completed, I must hurry to leave this tavern. Kind Wendora thinking that I must be exhausted, has given me some money to buy potions so that I can feel better.
Objective: Find Alchemist and buy 5 Low-level Recovery Potions and 5 Low-level Healing Potions. After the quest has been completed, talk to Verne.

Name: Go Hunting
Offer: After talking to Verne, he was very happy with me and started to teach me battle skills. He appointed me as the hunter of Pheasants and foxes around the outskirts of Athens. Their feathers and fur can be sold to Grant for a tidy sum.
Objective: Go to Athens Suburbs and kill 10 Pheasants and 5 Red Foxes.After completing the quest, report to Grant (Press ALT+F to automatically attack any monsters nearby.)

Name: Weird Sheep Horn
Offer: Bring your collected Sheephorn to Pascal for appraisal.
Objective: Bring the Sheephorn to Pascal for Appraisal. (Look for Pascal, and click on "Authenticate findings" or "Volume evaluation" to appraise your item.) Then, click on Pascal again to submit your quest.

Name: Grant's Supplies
Offer: Pascal paid handsomely for the horn, he also asked me to buy some stuff for Grant.
Objective: Go to Athens City and find Blacksmith to buy 1 inferior Pickaxe, 1 inferior felling Axe, and 1 Inferior Hoe, and then talk to Grant.

Name: Miners' Pickaxes
Offer: I gave all the tools to Grant but he then asked me to take them to the miners. He also told me to keep my eyes peeled for the elusive big deer that live around the outskirts of town.
Objective: Give the inferior pickaxes to Miners in the outskirts.

Name: Logger's Axe
Offer: After giving the pickaxes to miners, I must then give the axes to the loggers.
Objective: Give the inferior axes to loggers in the outskirts of Athens.

Name: Farmers' Hoes
Offer: After giving the axes to the loggers, I must then give the hoes to farmers in the farmland.
Objective: Give the hoes to farmers in the outskirts of Athens.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Collecting Seeds
Offer: The farmers' plants have been destroyed by all of the wild animals now they don't have enough seeds for planting. Are you willing to help them collect more.
Objective: Collect 2 Jute Seeds and 2 Linen seeds and give them to farmers in the outskirts of Athens.

Name: Grant's Backpack
Offer: After helping the farmers with their seeds, they asked me to deliver Grant's backpack to him.
Objective: Give the backpack to Grant
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Report to Verne
Offer: Grant was very happy to see his backpack once again. I returned to Athens after saying goodbye to him.
Objective: Talk to Verne
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Wanted

My honor and my name were at stake I knew I must return to Bombay to clear myself of these heinous charges.

Offer: I found the treasure and true to my word I planned on giving half to the young man from Semarang.

Name: Help others is another way to help yourself.
Offer: Yes, maybe I need a meal now. I miss Colin's meal so much. Can you help me to take a Colin's meal and a Sequoia twig which can bring luck to me, and my father will take for me every Christmas? Maybe I ask too more, but please help me!
Objective: Take a Christmas Meal from Colin in Athens and a Sequoia twig to Seville little girl Anna.

Name: Christmas March
Offer: A little girl entrust me to buy a Christmas Meal and a Sequoia twig, so please make a delicious meal as soon as possible so I can fulfill her wish fast.
Objective: Purchase a Christmas Meal and a Sequoia twig.

Name: Lucky Hammer
Offer: Opening the golden egg requires a special equipment, and I have it, but you need to pay two boxes of silver coin which you can buy from the Trader in Zhigu Port.
Objective: Buy two boxes of silver coin from the Trader in Zhigu Port.

Name: Raikin God's Blessings
Offer: TIGER is the mascot for next year, so Mr. Zhuge needs lots of Tiger Totems and gold to be the tribute for the fete.
Objective: Submit 50 Raikin Totems and 10 boxes of gold.

Name: Night Legend
TargetName: Aberrance Wolf Paws Thick-skinned Polar Wolves Collect 2 Aberrance Wolf Skins Blade Polar Wolves Collect 2 Aberrance Wolf Teeth Fury Polar Wolves Collect 2 vials of Aberrance Wolf Blood
Offer: The wolf shown on this card is out of it's mind, it's said that they were extremely fierce and often attacked human villages. People even swear that when they started to become so aggressive their eyes also changed... Maybe that is the key to understanding and maybe even curing their bloody transformation? It's definitively worth a try. Can you collect several samples of blood from the various wolves around here? They may just hold the answer we are looking for!
Objective: In North Islands Wild Polar Wolves collect 2 Aberrance Wolf Paws Thick-skinned Polar Wolves Collect 2 Aberrance Wolf Skins Blade Polar Wolves Collect 2 Aberrance Wolf Teeth Fury Polar Wolves Collect 2 vials of Aberrance Wolf Blood, give to Oslo Vircurs.

Name: Anmanda family history
Offer: This card describes the Anmanda family history in the card in short. It tells of how the family was led to ruin by a werewolf. The sacred wand holder of each clan has the responsibility of recording events; both good and bad on the family fur. So it stands to reason that if you want to find out more about the family story then you must first find that fur!
Objective: Collect 5 family history beast furs from the Anmanda clan wand holder in the North Islands Polar Tundra(copy) werewolf and give them to Oslo Vircurs.

Name: Vampire clan
Offer: This card describes how in the dead of night a dark shadow would drift into the bedroom, gradually turning solid the shadow would reach out it's cold, dead hands to grasp the throat of the sleeping victim. Then in an instant it would bite! Drinking down the victim's blood. The victim however, cannot bring themselves to fight back. There once was tell of a Vampire clan in the North, they were at one time very popular. But now they are very hard to find. But if you do manage to find one they are even harder to repel.
Objective: Go to North Islands polar tundra(copy) to collect 7 items of house ware from the Vampire's houses then give them to Oslo Vircurs.

Name: Shamanism
Offer: The ceremony of Shamanism is the most important event for the people of the North, this card describes the event in brief. But it seems that one of the most important parts of the ceremony is the shining cup which is placed on the altar.
Objective: Go to North Islands polar tundra(copy) Shaman to collect 9 Ceremonial Luminous Cups to Oslo Vircurs.

Name: Race war
Offer: This card depicts the huge war in the North. You can't possibly imagine the bloodshed and destruction it wrought. But it is necessary to never forget it. The Vampire clan and the Inuits both keep detailed records of the event to help prevent it from ever happening again.
Objective: In the North Islands Polar Tundra(copy),from Inuit evil Shaman get 2 Inuit warfare history incomplete books and 2 Vampire warfare history incomplete books, give them to Edo Akajima Kawasaki.

Name: Snowmen Secret History
Offer: This card shows a dark and cold pair of eyes on an emotionless white ball of a face. The whole creature looks soft and fluffy but the eyes tell a different story. It's a snowman. They hide out in the Snow Mountain where they can hardly be seen against the white backdrop. Learning about them can help us to find out more about the mysterious North.
Objective: Collect 10 Snowmen's ornaments from the North Island Snowmen and give them to Edo Akajima Kawasaki.

Name: Treasure of the three leaders
Offer: Obviously this card is part of an incomplete treasure map. The script below tells about the treasure of the three leaders of the cult shaman in the North. If only we could find all the pieces of the map then maybe we can find the treasure.
Objective: In the North Islands Inuit evil Shamen collect 5 treasure map pieces to Edo Akajima Kawasaki.

Name: Werewolf's fantasy
Offer: The card shows a werewolf howling at the moon. For no matter how strong a werewolf may be it will always be governed by the moon. This is the reason why Werewolf culture is closely linked to the moon.
Objective: Go to North Islands Polar Tundra(copy) to collect 7 werewolf Semi lunar ornaments and give them to Edo Akajima Kawasaki.

Name: Mermaid's Harp
Offer: We are able to tell that this is truly a Mermaid's Harp by comparing it to the examples of sculptures which still exist today in Atlantis. Because of this, this item is indeed of the greatest archaeological and research value.
Objective: Give the Mermaid's Harp to Seville Dubis.

Name: Asona's music book

Objective: Give Asona's music book to Seville Dubis.

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

Offer: This sword is fine enough that it must have belonged to a Captain of the Sword Guards. However, now it is badly damaged; the sawteeth have been blunted it and sheered and it seems as though half of the blue gems embedded in the handle have been lost or scavenged. There must be a tale of greatness hidden within its history.
Objective: Give the Broken Sword to Seville Dubis

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

Name: Fragments of Real Eyes
Offer: This is some kind of crystal-like blue scaly debris, it exudes a strange blue light. It is definitely magical in nature but with only fragment I can't say much more…

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

This armor may well hold the key to understanding, at least a little about, Atlantian technology.

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

Name: Old Wand

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

Name: Sacrificial Utensils
Offer: Obviously these utensils were used for sacrificial ceremonies. They also appear to have some kind of pattern engraved upon them but age and use have worn them so that we can't clearly make them out.
Objective: Give the Sacrificial Utensils Dubis.

RewardItems.Name: glory of the repression the rebels

Name: Instruments of torture

Name: Devil Emblem

Name: Explore the New World
Offer: We made a great achievements exploring the world, recently we found a new continent- the North Islands. They are an icy world with many undiscovered treasures. To that end several countries have joined forces to organize a Joint Expedition to explore. You don't want to miss out on this historical event. And as a Veteran Navigator you are a shoe-in to be accepted. Simply go to the leader of North Joint Expedition James.Tiago to sign up this event
Objective: Go and find the leader of North Joint Expedition in London dock James.Tiago to sign up for the explore event in North Islands

Name: Event funds
Offer: Because this event is being held by the Royal Family, you must pay some reasonable event fees to ensure that everything goes smoothly. You should travel to Downtown London to find the North Explore event holder and pay 1,000,000 into the event fund.
Objective: Find North Explore event holder Pay 1,000,000 into the event fund
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: March: North Islands
Offer: Ah good you're here. Well were happy to have you join in. The first thing you should do is to take your fleet the North Islands directly. There the Wellpus Colonel will be waiting for you to register with him.
Objective: Go to the North Islands Wellpus Colonel to register
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: New Crisis
Offer: You've arrived finally, after we arrived we were set upon by a sloth of wild bears. We tried to fight back but their fur was so thick that our bullets just bounced off, swords and all of our other weapons have proved to be just as useless. We must send word at once to James.Tiago. I am entrusting you with this task, please deliver this report to him poste-haste.
Objective: Return to London find James.Tiago report the situation in the North Islands
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Ask for help
Offer: Well…that is most unfortunate. It seems as though we must ask Queen Elizabeth for help. Now it is your duty to deliver this report into the very hands of our beloved sovereign. Don't let us down!
Objective: Go and look for Queen in Downtown London Elizabeth ask for help
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Forging Materials
Offer: We are in need of a number of new weapons for the expedition. Fortunately I have just finished the blueprints of some brand new designs. I just require the necessary materials to make them.
Objective: Help the Queen Elizabeth Buy 20 Bronze Ingots,10 Steel Ingots,10 Cold Ingot,20 Dark Gold.

Name: New Equipment
Offer: With your help we managed to finish the Expedition equipment far quicker than we had expected. However, we still need to deliver them... Which is where you come in! The completed weapons and equipment are in storage in the London dock. Go to see James.Tiago to get the equipment now.
Objective: Go to the London dock to find James.Tiago draw the weapons to be transported
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Wipe out the wild bears
TargetName: Wild Polar Bear 10、 Rock-skin Polar Bears 10、 Sharp Pawed Polar Bears 10、 Fierce Polar Bears 10
Offer: Now we have newer and more powerful weapons, the damnable north polar bears will be no challenge,ha-ha! I order you to wipe them out. And remember show no mercy!
Objective: Wipe out Wild Polar Bear 10、 Rock-skin Polar Bears 10、 Sharp Pawed Polar Bears 10、 Fierce Polar Bears 10,then Wellpus Colonel Report

Targets.Name: Wild Polar Bear 10、 Rock-skin Polar Bears 10、 Sharp Pawed Polar Bears 10、 Fierce Polar Bears 10

Name: Chef Kanad
Offer: Just after you left Chef Kanad hurried over to me and asked if you were really going to wipe out the wild bears. I told him that was indeed your mission, then he just started shaking his head sadly saying "tragic, tragic" I think you should go to see him to find out what the matter is.
Objective: Find Chef Kanad Ask him what you can do to help
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Improve Life
Offer: I am sick of eating the same frozen rubbish everyday. I long for some good old London food; jellied eels, steak and chips, meat pie and thick dark ale and whisky -slurp! Do you think you could be persuaded to travel back to London and bring back some of their delectable fare back for us? It would certainly boost our morale!
Objective: Return to London to transport 15 boxes of beef,15 boxes of Whisky to Chef Kanad.

Name: Console the wounded
Offer: The surrounding area here is fraught with danger! I was beginning to get quite worried about you. Especially since I heard that the Expedition Advanced group have met with trouble just after they started to explore. This time they were set upon by an even fiercer sloth of polar bears; with skin as hard diamonds. They put up a valiant fight against the beasts but many were badly wounded. Even the good and brave Captain Delano. I beg of you please deliver this nutritious beef soup to him; it is renowned for its recuperative qualities!
Objective: Give Chef Kanad's beef soup to Captain Delano.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Urgent ammunition
Offer: We have carried on with our exploration as best we could until we encountered another more terrible sloth of polar bears - the Rock-skin Polar Bears, as their name suggests they have a hide as hard as stone! Ordinary weapons have no effect on them. I need you to go to Hamburg and look for Brownman. You can buy special armor bullets from him that should do the job nicely. Here is the money please go as soon as possible otherwise we shall have to delay our exploration yet again.
Objective: Go to Germany Hamburg downtown to find Arms merchant Brownman buy the new armor bullets
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Pure extortion
Offer: To be honest, I'm a little nervous about selling these bullets to anyone at all. It seems that some unsavory sorts from the militia had bought some and use them to attack the military. So whilst I would love to hand them over, I fear you must first go to Ministry of the Interior and plead your case. With their permission I would be glad to sell you the bullets at a discounted price.
Objective: Find Minister of the Interior Intercede for the Arms Merchant Brownman
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Certificate of Pardon
Offer: Merchant Brownman won't be prosecuted for the loss of Arms and the military attacks. But please tell him that that was his last chance. He had better not mess up again otherwise we can't help him and the punishment is high. Give this certificate of pardon to him with our blessing.
Objective: Give the Certificate of Pardon to Arms Merchant Brownman.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: An even greater crisis
Offer: What! Are vicious bears the only inhabitants out here? Every sloth of them we meet seems to be even more dangerous than the one before. The latest furry devils are not only vicious but they have the sharpest claws imaginable. One swipe and your out. Many of our comrades have been slaughtered at their paws. But, I think you are more than a match for them. Go to kill them now! That's an order!
Objective: Destroy Sharp Paw Polar Bear 50,and return to Wellpus Colonel report.

Name: Violent polar bears
Offer: Will it never end?! Yet more bears have attacked us! I've had enough of this now. Go and destroy them immediately and without mercy.
Objective: wipe out Fierce Polar Bear 50,then report to Wellpus Colonel report

Name: Inuit village
Offer: So lucky, the Advanced group I sent out have found an Inuit village just in front, they're having a well earned rest now. You can go and find Corporal Jillmas to help.
Objective: Go to the Inuit Village Corporal Jillmas Sign up.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Visit the Village head
Offer: The Inuits are very friendly here and have given us all kinds of help. We haven't offered official thanks yet. But I would like you to go to see the Village Head, Drarsh as our representative and offer him our gratitude.
Objective: Visit Village Head Drarsh Express the thanks of the Expedition
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group
