TargetName: Wild Polar Wolves 10、 Thick Skinned Polar Wolves 10、 Blade Polar Wolves 10、 Fierce Polar Wolves 10
Offer: Excuse me, I would like to ask for a favor in return for our help. A pack of bloodthirsty Polar Wolves have been coming into our village of late. They steal our livestock and threaten our livelihoods. Could you please help us to get rid of them once and for all?
Objective: Help Village Head Drarsh wipe out Wild Polar Wolves 10、 Thick Skinned Polar Wolves 10、 Blade Polar Wolves 10、 Fierce Polar Wolves 10.

Targets.Name: Wild Polar Wolves 10、 Thick Skinned Polar Wolves 10、 Blade Polar Wolves 10、 Fierce Polar Wolves 10

Name: Collect the seeds of the North Pine
Offer: The plants in the North are very special, because they are able to bear cold. The Expedition wishes to collect their seeds to research.
Objective: Collect 15 seeds of North Pine Give to Corporal Jillmas.

Name: Help the villagers
Offer: We are very grateful for all of the villager's help. So we have decided to do something for them in return. It has come to my attention that Mogesan's home is facing danger of some kind, I wish you to go there and deal with it.
Objective: Find villager Mogesan See how you can help.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Mogesan's beast fur
Offer: I've been plagued by bad luck and misfortune. I'm a fur hunter by trade and when returning home with 30 fine pelts I was set upon by a pack of Thick Skinned Wolves. To save my life I had to lighten my load and run. So I dropped the Walrus skins, being the heaviest. But then after getting away I found myself cornered by a pack of Wild Polar Wolves I had no option but to throw my seal skins at them and leg it! I made it home shaken but in one piece. But without my pelts I can earn no money and so can buy no food for my family! Oh woe is me!
Objective: Help Mogesan Find 15 walrus skins and 15 seal skins.

Name: Important Discovery
Offer: We have made a very important discovery, we found a altar near here. From it's appearance we can surmise that is was used for some local religious ceremonies and it appears to be connected with the area somehow. I order you go to Captain Gotia at once and help him to investigate.
Objective: Go to the Altar and find Captain Gotia Sign up
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Eliminate threats
Offer: Our most urgent task is it to eliminate the Blade Polar Wolves. Before you arrival once of our men was killed by the fiends. Please make sure you eliminate them all!
Objective: Destroy Blade Polar Wolves 40,then report to Captain Gotia to report

Name: Mystery book
Offer: We have made great progress with the dig, we found a book written in Inuit characters. But we are unable to translate it. I want you to give this to Corporal Jillmas, see if he can help.
Objective: Give the Mystery book to Corporal Jillmas.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: New state
Offer: The exploration is still going on. Some of our teamates have reported there are some white objet moving in the front snow mountain, but it's too far to see it cleary. They got attacked by some cruel wolves when they moved on, please help them to remove the obstacles.
Objective: Destroy Fierce Polar Wolves 50,then report to Captain Gotia report

Name: Supply demand
Offer: Though the supply of food for Inuit Village hasn't been interrupted it isn't enough to provide for us all. The advanced group in particular need more due to the strenuous nature of their jobs. It is down to us to kill some Polar Wolves to provide for ourselves.
Objective: Collect 30 Wolf Meat to Captian Gotia.

Name: Urgent notice
Offer: I have just received an urgent order from Corporal Jillmas, he orders you go to him immediately, there is something urgent he needs your help with.
Objective: Go to the Inuit Village Corporal Jillmas Sign up.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Study the North bear group
Offer: We have analyzed the mysterious book it seems to detail a mysterious religion in the North. The altar we found is also connected to it and it's ceremonies. Interestingly it also tells of a mysterious North Bear. So I hope you can collect samples of many different bear's blood so we can track down the bear to study further.
Objective: Collect three bottles of Sharp-pawed Polar Bear's blood and Fierce Polar Bear's to Corporal Jillmas.

Name: Study the North wolf group
Offer: The book also goes into some detail regarding a variation of the North wolf group, we hope you could collect samples of many kinds of North Wolf blood for us to compare and study.
Objective: Collect three bottles of North Blade Polar Wolf's blood and Atrocity Polar Wolf's blood to Corporal Jillmas.

Name: Further study
Offer: We are limited to how much action we can take; but obviously its not enough. I hope you can deliver this box to Wellpus Colonel, ask for further orders.
Objective: Take the box of samples to Wellpus Colonel and sign up.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Return: London
Offer: Well…we can't do any more sophisticated research due to currency and manpower troubles. So, I think the best way to proceed would be to send these materials to the Royal Scholar Fandmont,he can study them in greater detail.
Objective: Go to London look for the Royal Scholar Fandmont Sir, tell him why you came.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: More sophisticated instruments
Offer: I have no interest in doing this research without the correct and more sophisticated instruments. So you must go to Athens and search out the Manufacturer Paul·Deloach to get the necessary instruments. However I have heard that he doesn't like to sell his instruments to strangers. Anyway you can give it a shot.
Objective: Go to Athens look for the Manufacturer Paul·Deloach Discuss the problem.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Small request
Offer: It is true I do possess all of the things you need, but I have a small request for you to do first if you want me to sell you these instruments. It's not difficult, I merely require you to deliver this letter to a girl named Ailoty. She lives in Seville. Don't worry though if she doesn't accept I won't refuse to sell I just need to know her reaction.
Objective: Give the letter from Paul·Deloach to Seville Ailoty.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Ailoty's reply
Offer: Please give this letter to Paul·Deloach, I hope he reads its contents and realizes that I no longer wish for any contact with him.
Objective: Give Ailoty's reply to Paul·Deloach.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Angry Paul
Offer: I'm so angry! Who is she to talk to me like that? I'll soon show her! If you want to buy my instruments I need you to do one more thing. Go and collect Perilla frutescens and Poacynum. Don't ask me what they are for just do it. Don't worry it's not to cause her any pain.
Objective: Help Paul·Deloach Collect 100 perilla frutescens and 100 poacynum.

Name: Find Pharmacist Kennon
Offer: I have something I need you to give to the Pharmacist Kennon. The last I heard of him was that he was investigating the plants on the island of Sicily.
Objective: Give the box from Paul·Deloach to in Sicily Island Kennon
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Necessary ingredient
Offer: I can help Paul, love is blind, that woman…sigh, but I still need another necessary ingredient - Rosemary, I hope you can help me to get some.
Objective: Collect 100 Rosemary and hand over them to Kennon

Name: Mystery drug
Offer: Well, finally done, you can take it back to Paul·Deloach now. It's strange though I never would have expected him to think of this.
Objective: Give the Mystery drug to Paul·Deloach.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Friend Hassad
Offer: Please give this box to my friend Hassad, he lives in downtown Istanbul, please help him if he needs. I promise, I'll sell these instruments to you no matter what the result.
Objective: Give the box from Paul·Deloach to in downtown Istanbul Hassad.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Revisiting Ailoty
Offer: I have a presumptuous request, I hope you can give this flower to Ailoty in Seville, I am sure she will give you something to deliver to Paul·Deloach. Please make sure that you do!
Objective: Give Hassad's flower to Ailoty Lady.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Little Paul's picture
Offer: Here is a picture of Little Paul, here you are take it.
Objective: Give little Paul's picture to Paul·Deloach.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Return the precision instruments
Offer: Thanks,oh my sweet son, thanks for your help. I have already prepared the instruments that you need. Just take them.
Objective: Give the precision instruments to the Royal Scholar Fandmont Sir there.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Weird test data
Offer: It's weird, these animals seem to be a mutated from the blood test data. But I can't sure about the factors of the mutation, maybe you can give this data to Jack, in Beirut, he is the famous data analyzer around. I hope he can find something.
Objective: Give the weird test data to data analyzer in Beirut Jack.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Evil Organization
TargetName: Inuit evil Shamen 15、 Inuit Shaman apprentices 15
Offer: I'm so angry at those evil Shaman. I had believed that they only taught evil thought, not actions as well! They have been studying evil magic to bring about mutations in the fauna around the North Region. Many of my people have been gravely injured even killed as a result. These deviants are going to feel the wrath of my righteous indignation. But you will help too, won't you?..
Objective: Kill Inuit evil Shamen 15、 Inuit Shaman apprentices 15 then tell Shaman.

Targets.Name: Inuit evil Shamen 15、 Inuit Shaman apprentices 15

Name: Extermination
Offer: It's not enough to just punish the evil Shamen, they have too many apprentices who will quickly rise up the ranks now that their masters are gone. They must be dealt with too!
Objective: Kill Inuit Shaman apprentices 40 then tell Shaman.

Name: Another crisis
Offer: You'd better hurry over to Corporal Jillmas to sign up. I heard that the advanced group are in trouble again and this time it's critical that they get help or they all may be done for! He's really worried!
Objective: Go to Corporal Jillmas to sign up.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Polar bear leader
Offer: Recently we discovered that even though they have great differences in ability and looks all of the Polar Bears belong to the same clan presided over by their leader - Pinosty. When he was just a cub an Inuit had badly beaten him for no reason and from that day on he has harbored a vicious hatred and lust for revenge on all Inuits. If he discovers that we are in league with the Inuits he may well order his clan to attack. It would be better if we got to him first and did away with him.
Objective: Kill the bear leader Polar Bear More,then report to Wellpus Colonel report

Name: Lead wolf
Offer: These Wolves are gregarious and under the control of the wolf leader. Through careful study we have discovered that this leader is know as Shadow Teeth and he is indeed a formidable foe. It was he who ordered the attack on our expedition. We must find and assassinate him before he can order more attacks.
Objective: Kill the wolf leader Polar wolf Shadow-teeth,then report to Village head Drarsh.

Name: Help Gotia
Offer: I have just received word from Captain Gotia. He has found some new life-forms and wishes you to go and help him investigate them.
Objective: Go to the altar camp, help Captain Gotia investigate the unknown life
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: New species
Offer: We have found a brand new species! It is a pure white creature that is large in stature and fierce in nature. They are also very aggressive. We have decided to call them Snowmen as that is what they resemble the closest. But due to their behavior we have no choice but to exterminate them, if we want to make any further progress.
Objective: Kill 7 Cool-teeth Snowmen,then report to Captain Gotia

Name: Beautiful fur
Offer: Did you think that the fur of the Snowmen is beautiful? I do! And it looks so cozy too. Could you get some Snowmen fur for me, if you are free that is? I think the Angry Snowmen have the best fur, that's what I really want.
Objective: Collect 15 furs from the Angry Snowmen to Alog.

Name: Higher quality
Offer: Silly me! It's the Evil Snowmen that have the best fur. Can you get me some of that as well please?
Objective: Collect 15 furs from the Evil Snowmen to Alog.

Name: Powerful enemy
Offer: Unfortunately we have now come across the most malevolent Snowmen of all. The fury Snowmen. I think you should go and eradicate them all without a second thought!
Objective: Kill 7 Fury Snowmen,then report to Captain Gotia to register.

Name: King of the Snowmen
Offer: The Snowmen were all under the control of a fiend named Fence, he had organized several attacks before. It looks as though he must be dealt with. Go now and show him who's the boss!
Objective: Kill Snowmen Fence,then report to Captain Gotia to register

Name: Counterinsurgency mission
Offer: I heard that those nefarious pirates have been causing frequent chaos around the outskirts of Hamburg. It has gotten so bad that it is effecting the day to day lives of the people there. I only mean for you to go there to deliver a warning to them but if they protest you can do whatever you want to the despicable curs!
Objective: Kill 5 pirates leaders from the outskirts of Hamburg, then report to Minister of the Interior report

Name: Counterinsurgency mission
Offer: I heard that those nefarious pirates have been causing frequent chaos around the outskirts of Hamburg. It has gotten so bad that it is effecting the day to day lives of the people there. I mean for you to go there to butcher them.
Objective: Kill 25 Pirates from the outskirts of Hamburg Pirates Leader then report to Minister of the Interior report

Name: Soul of devil
Offer: Actually the Shaman family have been hiding a big secret for a long, long time. They found out that the mutations on the North Islands were caused by the Devil. Do you remember the strange altar we found? Well it was used by Vircra, one of the evil Shamen, for the purposes of the Devil. It is said that he was tricked by the Devil and lost his soul. Now he must follow every command given by the evil one. It is a great pain to me to see so many innocent deaths. We have no choice but to kill him and set his soul free.
Objective: Go Yiglu Cave to kill Vircra in normal mode, then report to Shaman report.

Name: Sad news
Offer: Bad news has come from the Gibraltar strait far away, that more and more fleets have disappeared in the past few months only to suddenly appear on a small island in Gibraltar sea. Now when any ship passes by that area they can hear a cacophony of screams and wails. No-one wants to go there anymore and as a result no one is coming here. It's making life really hard here in the Seville docks!
Objective: Go to Seville, to dock boys ask for information about the island which appeared in the Gibraltar sea.

Name: Go to the Merchant Guild
Offer: The tragedies that have happened in Gibraltar have greatly affected the trade of the Merchant Guilds recently. The principals of the Seven Seas Joint Merchant Guild and the Seville Merchant Guild are calling their most important members together to discuss how to resolve this matter.
Objective: Go to the Seville Seven Sea Joint Merchant Guild Principal of Merchant Guild to see if you can help
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Volunteer
Offer: I'm sorry for all of the tragedies at sea recently. To try to solve the problem the Merchant Guild has decided to organized an expedition to investigate. Maybe they can find out what caused these frequent shipwrecks. We require a powerful and experiences navigator to help us to finish this difficult mission. If you're interested please go to the Lisbon dock to look for Rogers to sign up.
Objective: Go to Lisbon Rogers to sign up join the explore event
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Route coordinates recorder
Offer: I found out recently, the one of the ships that crashed in Gibraltar had lost their route coordinates. Lost them and then crashed. We need a new navigation device to ensure our safety. I heard that the inventor in Amsterdam Mond·Raphael has invented a new route coordinates recorder that might well be the ticket!
Objective: Go Amsterdam, from Mond·Raphael to get a new route coordinates recorder

Name: Distant blessing
Offer: I just have to ask you a small favor my dear. You see it will soon be my good friend, Dollivey's birthday and I do so want to give him this card. But as you can see I am quite, quite busy so I won't be able to celebrate with him in person. Perhaps you could deliver it to him in Seville for me? Hmm?
Objective: Go to Seville and give Mond·Raphael's letter to Seville Dollivey.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Grapevine
Offer: Hey guy, I'm afraid you have to return to Lisbon immediately, as I know the exploration event is starting right now. I'm afraid you will miss the event if you don't go now.
Objective: Return to Lisbon find Rogers to register
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Ancient craft
Offer: I'm worried about this expedition, sea monsters have been reported in the seas around Gibraltar recently. And that makes for a very unpredictable journey! I think it will be better if we could take charge of Nage's refuge, it can protect us from the sea monsters. But the only one who can make them emigrated to Dakar a long time ago. His names is Lurtas,I believe that it is necessary for us to get hold of him and ask him for one.
Objective: Go to Dakar to find Lurtas.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Necessary ingredient
Offer: Are you talking about Nage's refuge? This figurehead needs to be crafted from some very specialized material, Perilla frutescens gathered after a storm. If you can provide me with some then I'd love to help you to make this adornment.
Objective: Give Lurtas 100 perilla frutescens

Name: Go to the Palace
Offer: The King of Athens, Aioria was looking for you. He must need your help urgently. Hurry up go to Athens and report to him. Don't keep the king waiting!
Objective: Talk to the kingAiolia.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Utopia
Offer: For thousands of years in Europe there has been a legend about Gibraltar: at the "Hyrocurs column" outside the Atlantic Ocean, where there is an ancient empire - Atlantis with an area bigger than North Africa but smaller than Asia. I postulate that the recent occurrences in Gibraltar are somehow related to Atlantis. I hope you can find the historian Atos.Willtay to verify my information.
Objective: Find historian in downtown Athens Atos.Willtay to verify what Aioria said.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Tell the King
Offer: We have recently carried out some research about this matter and I must concur. Several other scholars and myself have all drawn the same conclusion - it is all linked to Atlantis! Please let the King know that we should all regard this as a fact now.
Objective: Return to Aioria to report the results of the verification of Atlantis.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: King's care
Offer: It looks as though things are not as easy as we had previously thought! I can feel that something is amiss. I feel that it may be necessary to remind Rogers about Atlantis,please help me to do so.
Objective: Tell the related information about Atlantis to Lisbon Rogers.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Target: Bimini Island
Offer: Our current preparations should be able to handle any unforeseen changes. Now it's time we weighed anchor and set sail! Let's go my brave explorer!
Objective: Go to Bimini Island to Captain Plerdy get together.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Bimini Lions
Offer: Watch out for the lions. Carol got eaten by one. Many other people have also ended up as lion food. We must destroy these brutes and if we are lucky some of those who attacked Carol will bear the brunt of my anger. I believe that they are skulking around in that valley over there.
Objective: Kill Dying Bimini Lions and Dying Bimini Lioness then report to Captain Plerdy to report this matter.

Name: Possedonia?
Offer: Did you notice the villain that is being held by our security? We caught him just as we arrived on the Island. The crazy fool tried to attack us! During interrogation he told that he comes from a place called Possedonia and that it can only be reached by traveling through a secret sea bed cave. A few days ago we sent out an advanced group tp check out the veracity. I hope you can catch up to them to offer your help.
Objective: Go to meet the advanced group Captain Gondara get together.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Night killer
TargetName: Huge Steel-teeth Crocodile 1 Bimini Red-raphe Crocodiles 4
Offer: Hey I'm glad you're here. We are having real trouble on this cave; there is a float of cunning crocodiles lying in wait here. Whenever we let our guards down they attack. So we have had to split up our group so that some can stay here to stop them while the others keep moving. The one known as the Steel-teeth crocodile seems to be the leader. It would appear that the best cause of action would be to do away with him and leave the rest in chaos!
Objective: Kill Huge Steel-teeth Crocodile 1 Bimini Red-raphe Crocodiles 4 and Bimini Steel-teeth Crocodiles 4,then report to Captain Gondara report

Targets.Name: Huge Steel-teeth Crocodile 1 Bimini Red-raphe Crocodiles 4

Name: Go to Possedonia
Offer: I think that it's time we left for Possedonia, Agosou should be waiting for us there.
Objective: Go to Possedonia Agosou get together.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Meet the King
Offer: See, this is Possedonia, is it as beautiful as you imagined? Over two thousand years ago the civilization of Atlantis was already this advanced. Surprising yes?!!! I think it's time for you to meet the King of this great country.
Objective: Meet King of Possedonia Bodisis.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Letter from Bodisis
Offer: Hello stranger, I'm not surprised by your visit. Even though Atlantis had the reputation of only being a legend for thousand years, it did indeed exist. But this is because we kept ourselves to ourselves for fear of exploitation by other landers. Over time we have realized that isolation may not be the best choice for us. So now we ask you to take this letter of introduction to your leader so that he may help us to gradually reveal ourselves to the world.
Objective: Give the letter from Bodisis King to Captain Plerdy.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Report to Rogers
Offer: Hmmm, this is very serious, we should report to Rogers first. Please deliver these materials to him immediately.
Objective: Return to Lisbon and give this Bimini report to Rogers.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Letter to Plerdy
Offer: Well I never! It's really beyond my expectations that the reason for the appearance of Bimini Island is all down to one particularly ambitious Possedonian man. I must report to joint fleet and ask other countries for help at once! Please return soon so you can deliver this letter to Plerdy.
Objective: Give the letter from Rogers to Captain Plerdy.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Help Bomule
Offer: The rebel from Possedonia may well cause a global war which no country could avoid. It's down to us to help the King of Possedonia to pacify the rebels. Tuis is Rogers's command, you should help Bomule in Possedonia the resolve the crisis.
Objective: Go to Atlantis Bomule to help him.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Bosela rebels
Offer: Bosela is the key member of the rebel group and they are at their most powerful just now. Some of them have even leaked outside of Possedonia, you should go and deal with them first.
Objective: Destroy Bosela Pikemen 7、 Bosela Patrol Dogs 7,then report to Bomule report.

Name: Bomule's trick
Offer: Though we have temporarily hurt the Bosela rebels' elan, it doesn't resolve the situation in Possedonia, there is a senior command office of Bosela rebels to the west of Possedonia. It is known that the two main Military counselors from the rebels, Akendy and Ashina, are there. Take them out and the others would be lost for orders, go and kill them now!
Objective: Kill Akendy and Ashina then report to Bomule report this matter.

Name: General Harmuni
Offer: Harmuni is a bellicose man but he has outstanding ability too. Though the Bosela rebels lost their wisdom, we still not be as powerful as them. If you can kill him and his elite troop, then I think Bosela will be greatly set back in his plans.
Objective: Kill Bosela Long-lance Soldiers 10、kill Harmuni general, then report to Bomule report.

Name: Dead Wood Natives looking for asylum
Offer: The Zomdo clan is a species which evolved entirely in the ecological environment of Atlantis. They are forever entwined with the history of Atlantis, now their lives' have been threatened, their patriarch has asked us for help. I am sending you to do this task, don't let them down!
Objective: Go to Zomdo clan headquarters, just outside Possedonia Sherim patriarch to discuss help needed.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Evil faith
TargetName: Evil Indigenous Long-lance Soldiers 、5 Evil Indigenous Dart Soldiers
Offer: The native clan has believed in the Dermer God for a long time, but a small splinter group hold belief in the evil Tamgando god. These believers signify their faith by carving grotesque images into their skin all over their bodies. Someone must exact our revenge on these heathens. Tamgando can provide them with evil to make them really powerful. And their leader Yalujay loves to get his hands bloody, this really is the only option.
Objective: Help the Sherim patriarch to kill 5 Evil Indigenous Long-lance Soldiers 、5 Evil Indigenous Dart Soldiers then tell Sherim patriarch.

Targets.Name: Evil Indigenous Long-lance Soldiers 、5 Evil Indigenous Dart Soldiers

Name: Restitution
TargetName: in the valley east of Possedonia treasure box of Zomdo native Give
Offer: That cur Yalujay, he took all of our wealth in order to obtain weapons and other items for war. I know that he stores it all in the valley east of Possedonia, I hope you can help us to get our wealth back.
Objective: Find 5 in the valley east of Possedonia treasure box of Zomdo native Give to Sherim patriarch.

Targets.Name: in the valley east of Possedonia treasure box of Zomdo native Give

Name: Grim
Offer: As a real Archon of the Evil clan, Grim commanded his evil servants to kill many of our brothers. I must avenge them. I hope you will help me.
Objective: Kill Grim then tell Sherim patriarch about this matter.

Name: Yalujay's biological force
TargetName: Yalujay Falchion Skeletons 5 Yalujay Sword Skeletons 5 Yalujay Axe Skeletons 5
Offer: Yalujay was once the most famous biochemist in Possedonia,but he began to use his discoveries to create biological forces. It was his aim to conquer the whole world. At present he and his gang of cronies occupy the east of Possedonia. This means that our transport lines there have been cut. Please help us resolve this matter.
Objective: Kill Yalujay Falchion Skeletons 5 Yalujay Sword Skeletons 5 Yalujay Axe Skeletons 5,then report to Bomule report.

Targets.Name: Yalujay Falchion Skeletons 5 Yalujay Sword Skeletons 5 Yalujay Axe Skeletons 5

Name: Soul-control master
Offer: Are the biological forces really hard to defeat? I guess so. It is true they are not concious, but Yalujay's soul-control troop can control them completely. In order to stop them we must first destroy the soul-control troop. If we want to destroy Yalujay's biological force it's the only way to do it.
Objective: Kill 10 Yalujay Soul-control master then report to Bomule report.

Name: Kluyas
Offer: Kluyas is the only one of the biochemical skeletons that is distinctive for he is conscious. He is the pride of Yalujay's demonic collection and most loyal servant too. It is said that they are studying Kluyas to make more just like him. We must stop this abomination now!
Objective: Kill Kluyas 和10 Yalujay Biochemist then report to Bomule report.

Name: Yalujay Biochemist
Offer: Donia is the most famous prophet in all of Possedonia. He has predicted something major recently and requires the skill of a warrior to help him with something to do with it. I recommend you go to help him.
Objective: Go to Donia help him.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Dreamweed
Offer: As a prophet I need many special and rare items such as Dreamweed. It is a special type of leaf that when burnt the ash will fly into the air and with the use of magic it will form prophetic shapes. I have often used it for my predictions and it is usually very accurate. I have been using it to predict the future of Possedonia,but I haven't been able to divine anything conclusive. But now I have run out of Dreamweed. I am hoping you can get some more for me, it grows just outside of Possedonia.
Objective: Collect 10 Real grass give to Donia.

Name: Evil Natives' Totem
Offer: I have divined bad news from the prediction. I believe that the Evil god worshipped by the immoral natives intends to harm us.. However, I saw the way to call him through the ashes. You must collect 12 evil totems from the Evil Natives right now and give them to me.
Objective: Collect 12 evil totems from the Evil Natives Donia.

Name: Go to Atlaszon
Offer: I think it's time to aim a critical strike on the rebels. Now we know how to beat the biological forces I think we should go to Atlaszon to kill Yalujay, then rescue Digos Town. General Apino is leading an advanced troop to Atlaszon first, go and meet him!
Objective: Go to Atlaszon Apino General get together.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Biochemical black spider
Offer: Damn Yalujay, I never expected him to have created such a fierce biological force. There are so many Black spiders in front of us? We can't move an inch! Go and kill them!
Objective: Kill 15 Biochemical black spiders then report to Apino General.

Name: Biological variation
Offer: Don't get too cocky these Black Spiders are mere puppets compared to the Mutant Dapple Poisonous spiders nearby. They're the real killers, they have their own minds and know how to attack! Go and kill them now!
Objective: Kill 10 Mutant Dapple Poisonous Spiders then report to Apino General report.

Name: Night Gazer
Offer: I must tell you that the most fearsome of all of these demonic arachnids is the Night Gazer. They are crueler, fiercer and much smarter than any we have come up against so far. If one bites you, you will be dead in seconds! Many of my men have fallen to it.
Objective: Kill Night Gazers then report to Apino General report.

Name: Reinforcement Digos Town
Offer: Please reinforce the Digos town immediately! I think general Botiven can no longer hold down the fort alone.
Objective: Go to Digos Town,reinforce Botiven General.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Yalujay legion
Offer: I think you may have already seen Yalujay's soul force outside the town. The worst are those Soul Prayers, they job is to manipulate the soul and guide it into doing evil. They have simple minds and fierce character, so we should kill them first if we want to take the whole lot down. Once they are gone the others may well resort to killing each other!
Objective: Kill 5 Soul Prayers then report to Botiven General.

Name: Fatal blow
TargetName: Yalujay Skeleton Saberers 、3 Yalujay Skeleton Swordsmen
Offer: As far as I can tell the new biological forces haven't had their minds attached properly yet. It's the best time for us to attack them. Go and destroy them now!
Objective: Kill 3 Yalujay Skeleton Saberers 、3 Yalujay Skeleton Swordsmen and 3 Yalujay Skeleton Axmen then report to Botiven General report.

Targets.Name: Yalujay Skeleton Saberers 、3 Yalujay Skeleton Swordsmen

Name: Requiem Andrew
Offer: Andrew is the leader of the Soul Prayers, he has a book filled with knowledge about how to manipulate the souls of the biological forces,kill him and take the book.
Objective: Kill Requiem Andrew,and hand the book to Botiven General.

Name: Traitorous indigenous
Offer: I never expected that the Dead Wood Natives would have deserted us when we really needed them! We were almost killed! They must be punished!
Objective: Kill 5 Dead Wood Natives soldiers and 5 Dead Wood Natives elders then report to Botiven General.

Name: Shame of the clan
Offer: I never would have believed that Joanru would betrayed our promise. But I must admit that I was worried when he began to led our clan. In order to regain our honor, I hope that you will help me to kill him!
Objective: Kill Joanru then report to Old Sheikh of Dead wood.

Name: Pledge of Allegiance
Offer: Please give this Pledge of Allegiance signed by our whole clan to General Botiven. Our clan has always remained loyal to Possedonia.
Objective: Give the Pledge of Allegiance from the old sheikh of dead wood to Botiven General.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Urgent mission
Offer: Please go to Poseidon bay immediately, give this urgent letter to General Borant. He is fighting with the Bosela rebels.
Objective: Give the urgent letter from Bodisis to General Borant in Poseidon Bay.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Tenia ambassador
TargetName: Tedia ambassador give the help letter
Offer: These Evil Natives are much more cunning that we first presumed. The diplomatic envoys you stopped last time were just a decoy! While our forces were dealing with them the real envoy slipped through the cracks! He managed to get his letter through the Bosela Headquarters and into the hands of the Tedia Ambassador. Please, you must stop him before he reaches the main Bosela camp!
Objective: Kill Tedia ambassador give the help letter to Borant general

Targets.Name: Tedia ambassador give the help letter

Name: Letter from home
Offer: The war always makes people sentimental, the soldiers miss their families back home in Possedonia. Please help us to deliver their letters to the Postal Administration. From there they can be given to the waiting families.
Objective: Give the soldiers' letters to Possedonia Bodisis.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: King's call
Offer: My dear friend, King Bodisis is calling for you. He wishes to see you poste-haste.
Objective: Go to Bodisis to see what can you do for the King.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: End of an era
Offer: The new information has arrived from Atlaszon, it seems the Yalujay rebels have almost been destroyed! I hope you can go there and help General Botiven deal with the stragglers.
Objective: Go to Atlaszon and help General Botiven.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Evil elite
Offer: Welcome my young friend. I see you have arrived just in time to take the final curs down in a blaze of glory. But it won't be too easy these devils are the elite of the elite - the - Evil Indigenous Sharp-lance Soldiers. But I now we can do this. On my mark one, two, three, charge...
Objective: Destroy Evil Indigenous Sharp-lance Soldiers 7,then report to Botiven general.

Name: Death pitcher Teeros
Offer: It makes me so sad every time I recall my little son's death in the war by Teeros. A horrible legend, he is also known as the death pitcher, anyone who gets caught by him has no chance of escape. But I must avenge my son! Could you please help me?
Objective: Kill Death pitcher Teeros then report to Botiven general.

Name: Evil leader
TargetName: Evil Natives leader Duderam kill Attendants of Duderam 7
Offer: Finally! The time has come to destroy the Evil Natives. We know that their leader is hiding out in the east valley, with his remaining servants, go and kill him! Finish off the evil clan.
Objective: Kill Evil Natives leader Duderam kill Attendants of Duderam 7,then report to Botiven general.

Targets.Name: Evil Natives leader Duderam kill Attendants of Duderam 7

Name: Help General Apino
Offer: General Apino is leading his elite troop resist the strike of the Yalujay legion in the north. We have to go there and help him!
Objective: Go to the North of Atlaszon General Apino to help him.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Request reinforcements
Offer: We never thought that we could resist Yalujay's attacks for so long. But now we are almost done, his biological forces are almost endless. You must return to Possedonia immediately, tell the King our situation and ask him to send reinforcements! Please give this letter to him!
Objective: Return to Possidonia, give the letter from General Apino to Bodisis.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Tell Borant
Offer: For reinforcements I think we must ask Borant. Maybe we can transfer some of his legion to help Apino. Give this transfer order to Borant, he will know what to do.
Objective: Give the Transfer Order to Poseidon bay General Borant.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Return to Atlaszon
Offer: Don't worry about the reinforcements I will deal with that. You'd better go back to Atlaszon to help General Apino.
Objective: Return to Atlaszon and help General Apino.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The source of sin
Offer: It is Yalujay's day to day! We have his exact location; a cave in the north where he and his cronies are cowering. Go and put them out of their misery.
Objective: Kill Yalujay and Attendants of Yalujay 5,then report to General Apino

Name: War call
Offer: You have made great contributions towards peace in Atlaszon. But you can't rest yet; there is more to do in Poseidon Bay. Go and find General Borant, he will explain.
Objective: Go to Poseidon bay, help General Borant.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Bosela pioneers
TargetName: Bosela Battle Dogs 5 Bosela Sharp-lance Soldiers
Offer: The Bosela pioneers are really a formidable foe. They stride onto the battlefield with their battle dogs leading the way. When they team up with the Bosela Sharp-Lance Soldiers they are almost unstoppable. Please help us to put a stop to them now.
Objective: Kill 5 Bosela Battle Dogs 5 Bosela Sharp-lance Soldiers then report to General Borant report

Targets.Name: Bosela Battle Dogs 5 Bosela Sharp-lance Soldiers

Name: Cruel Mora
Offer: Mora is the commander of the Bosela Sharp-lance soldiers, he is very cruel specially to his captives. Many of our men have survived being captured only to be tortured to death by him! We must put an end to his sadistic ways. Will you help us kill him?
Objective: Kill cruel Mora then report to Borant General.

Name: Source of the sea species
Offer: Sea monsters are a very mysterious species in Possedonia. They have existed in the ocean for millennia and always got on peacefully with man. But Bosela somehow managed to corrupt them turning them to follow his every whim. Now we have no choice but to eradicate them.
Objective: Go to the Northwest of Poseidon bay, kill 5 Blood Seasprites 5 Water Seasprites and 5 Soul Seasprites then report to General Borant to report.

Name: Latent chess
Offer: Bosela never found out about my secret forces hidden in the Poseidon Bay valley. My most elite soldier Jarode has been hiding there for quite a while now. He has just been waiting for this opportunity to arise. You should go there to help him.
Objective: Go to the bottom of valley in the centre of Poseidon bay to help Jarode.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Residual Evil
TargetName: Evil Indigenous diplomats 3 Evil Indigenous Dart Soldiers
Offer: I hadn't counted on Bosela getting his hands on the Evil Natives' remains. Now they have been mutated and possess great power. We must cut them down before they have the chance to join their new master, To the Valley!
Objective: Kill 3 Evil Indigenous diplomats 3 Evil Indigenous Dart Soldiers then report to Jarode report.

Targets.Name: Evil Indigenous diplomats 3 Evil Indigenous Dart Soldiers

Name: Biotechnology
Offer: It seems as though Bosela has gotten hold of Yalujay's biotechnology. Luckily for us he does not have nearly the same skill when using it! We must destroy all of the experiments and any information we can find about it. According to current Intel the biotechnology is being controlled by the Soul Prayers, so we must deal with them too!
Objective: From Soul Prayer get biotechnology material and give to Jarode and kill 5 Bad Biochemical spiders.

Name: Unknown enemy
Offer: Recently we came across a powerful Bosela troop, their equipment is different to that which we have ever seen before with the Bosela rebels. They are called the Elite-lance soldiers. Their leader is a very smart man by the name of Sebato. I hope you can destroy this group before they have the have the chance to amass their forces.
Objective: Kill Sebato and 5 Bosela Elite-lance Soldiers then report to Jarode.

Name: Two leaders
Offer: The Bosela elite-lance soldiers and Bosela sharp-lance soldiers are meeting in the south of Poseidon bay to join forces and launch an attack. The two leaders are having a pow-wow right now. I want you to intercept them and break up their plans.
Objective: Kill Sharp-lance Soldier's Leader and Elite-lance Soldier's Leader then report to Jarode.

Name: Last battle
Offer: The last stand is upon us. Bosela and his elite are hidden in the island to the southwest of Poseidon bay. Go and kill them, end the rebels!
Objective: Kill Bosela and 5 Attendants of Yalujay then report to Jarode.

Name: Remains of a Species
Offer: We are inundated by remains of unique species in Atlantis. We really want to be able to identify them all. We have cards that show what these creatures would have looked like when they were alive, so now we just have to match them. So searching for more remains has become a very meaningful pastime.
Objective: Collect 2 mermaid's pictures from Poseidon bay, collect 2 unicorn's pictures from Atlaszon, give them to the archaeologist in Genoa Batti·Tobuta.

Name: Tramp's music
Offer: Troubadours were an important part of Atlantian history. They were known throughout the country. It was their job to spread the beauty of the world through song to the common man. Often they recorded historical events too. Sadly, they have all disappeared now and only their song books remain.
Objective: Collect 5 troubadour's music books from the Bosela rebels and give them to the archaeologist in Genoa Batti·Tobuta.

Name: Traces of War
Offer: Nobody can avoid war, no matter what country or what time. But we don't know anything about ancient Atlantian wars. Maybe we can find out something by examining more artifacts?
Objective: Collect 5 broken weapons from the Yalujay skeleton force and give them to the archaeologist in Genoa Batti·Tobuta.

Name: Map of Atlantis
Offer: Just how big is Atlantis? So far nobody knows, this map of ancient Atlantis is incomplete, but it doesn't mean we can't find more pieces.
Objective: Collect 4 Atlantis map pieces from the Dead Wood Natives and give them to the archaeologist in Genoa Batti·Tobuta.

Name: Faith
Offer: Faith is necessary for every nation, but the main faiths of each nation in Atlantis are still unknown. Maybe we should find some artifacts of worship to study to gain an understanding.
Objective: Collect 5 articles of worship from the Soul Prayers and give them to the archaeologist in Genoa Batti·Tobuta.

Name: Outfit
Offer: We can learn about a nation's culture from their clothes So we must find some to study!
Objective: Collect 6 pieces of clothes from Evil Natives and give them to the archaeologist in Genoa Batti·Tobuta.

Name: Religion
Offer: If every nation needs a faith, then the performance of that is religion. But we do not know the main religion of Atlantis. Go and collect some religious artifacts immediately.
Objective: Collect 3 evil spirit figureheads from the Evil Natives, collect 2 Pious Figureheads from the Dead Wood Natives and give them to the archaeologist in Genoa Batti·Tobuta.

Name: Evil Spirit
Offer: If everything has both good and bad then it follows that so did the Atlantians. Even the most perfect of them made mistakes. I believe that they had evil spirits hidden in their souls.
Objective: Collect 4 Saints emblems from the Bosela rebels and give them to the historian in Laspamers Made·Christ.

Name: Source of the strange sea species
Offer: This species has never been seen before. What exactly is it? If nobody knows we must take action immediately!
Objective: Collect 5 Luminous scales from the Blood Seasprites, the Water Seasprites and the Soul Seasprites and give them to the historian in Laspamers Made·Christ.

Name: Wisdom
Offer: We can judge the intelligence of a species by looking at their tools. I believe that if you really want to understand them then the tools must be looked at first!
Objective: Collect 2 Sharp lances from the Evil Natives, collect 2 Long Wooden Sticks from the Dead Wood Natives and give them to the historian in Laspamers Made·Christ.

Name: Great sage
Offer: There were many great sages in Atlantian history, but their belongings and writings are held by someone unknown. To better understand Atlantis, we should get these things back.
Objective: Collect 5 remains of the Sages from the Soul Prayer and give them to the historian in Laspamers Made·Christ.

Name: Neptune's influence
Offer: Maybe they exist just to prove that their god exists. It is clear that they are closely related to the power of nature. Does this mystery intrigue you?
Objective: Collect 4 ocean hearts from the Deep Sea Rock Man and give them to the historian in Laspamers Made·Christ.

Name: Shadow
Offer: There is a deviant species known as the perpetrators of massacre. They hide in the darkness with only their cruel dead eyes showing gin the gloom. Beware!
Objective: Collect 5 eyes from the Mutant Dapple Poisonous Spiders and give them to the historian in Laspamers Made·Christ.

Name: Thoughts
TargetName: Hangings of the Bosela Battle Dogs
Offer: Biotechnology has it's advantages and disadvantages, many species are sent insane during death but if the body is reanimated that insanity can stay with it...
Objective: Collect 4 Hangings of the Bosela Battle Dogs and give them to the historian in Laspamers Made·Christ.

Targets.Name: Hangings of the Bosela Battle Dogs

Name: A Life at Stake
Offer: It's readily apparent that the British navy doesn't have the complete picture when it comes to Spain. It seems they've been mislead by their outward appearance. Spain is planing a war against the British, which may bring the country to the verge of total defeat. You must hurry to Britain and hand over your latest report about the Spanish to Knight Drake.
Objective: Return to London and report to Knight Drake on the latest information in the Spanish military dispatch.

Name: Tricks Exposed
Offer: *Leafs through the report from Barcelona* Ha! I knew it - Knight Parma is nothing but a liar! Time to expose his little guise, and you shall have the honor, my friend! Take this report directly to the Queen!
Objective: Give the military information about the Spanish army to Queen Elizabeth.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Ammo Collection
Offer: Ahoy mates, I want to express gratitude on behalf of Her Majesty for your great contribution to our country's security. War is about to break out, but we don't have enough ammo on hand. Can you collect some for us?
Objective: Collect 400 provisions, 600 High-Explosive Projectiles and 100 Secondary Medic Kits, then give them to Knight Howard.

Name: Port Defense(Instance)
Offer: Our army is well trained for sea battles. But, if the Spanish navy sneaks an attack on our port, we will lose the distinct advantage we have at sea. Our entire country is at stake and we cannot afford to lose this fight. Hurry to the port and help us get rid of these barbarous invaders!
Objective: Defeat 3 Cruisers, 3 Command Ships,and 3 Provision Ships, then report to Lieutenant Snyderman about your success.

Name: Big Lesson(Instance)
Offer: Time to teach these Spanish invaders a lesson they won't soon forget! Get rid of Medina-Sidonia's Flagship first!
Objective: Destroy the Medina-Sidonia's Flagship, then report to Colonel Carmelie.

Name: Special Feed
Offer: A special kind of pet feed consisting of 1 part dragon food, 1 part feline food, and 20 parts pet food. Gather the above stated items and I'll reward you handsomely!
Objective: Gather 1 food well-liked by dragons, 1 food well-liked by felines, and 20 Compounding Pet's Food and hand them to Exotic Pets Trader located at Seville Port.

Name: Gather The Infantry
Offer: The King is fretting over the rebels hiding out at the Poseidon Temple, and wishes for brave warriors to step forth to take on this task.
Objective: Look for King Bodisis and convey your wish to defeat the rebels in his stead.

Name: Frant's Messenger
Offer: We have been on his track for some time now, and we are almost sure that they are in search for something of utmost importance. As to what that is, we believe Frantz's messenger holds that knowledge. We must retrieve the letter he holds.
Objective: Kill Frant'z Messenger and retrieve the letter he holds. Hand it to Borant when done.

Name: Eliminating The Threat
Offer: The rebels hiding in the temple cannot be left as they are, for their very existence threatens the safety of the kingdom. Please go forth and eliminate their leader.
Objective: Charge into Poseidon Temple and slay Frantz. Then, report to Officer Herter.

Name: A True Warrior
Offer: Demonic beings and their powers cannot smite down a true warrior. Prove your mettle by defeating these beings!
Objective: Slay Manadee, Ailoty and Karter. Then, report to Officer Herter.

Name: A Pirate's Life
Offer: Haha! Real pirates wouldn't even dare to come within cannon range of this port! This is just a play. But then again, how real pirates survive in the harsh environments they live in is truly admirable. You look incredulous! Tell you what - how about you step forth and experience it for yourself?
Objective: Collect 20 Reishi, and sink the pirate ship, "Wandering Soul", located in the vicinity of the Crete Offshore. Report your findings to Galus on board the pirate ship docked at Seville Port.

Name: Gather 'Em!
Offer: Looks like you are quite something yourself! How about helping us with a menial task?
Objective: Purchase 5 Cutlass and 5 Male Pursuing Captain's Garment (Old). Hand them to Galus on board the pirate ship docked at Seville Port.

Name: Emperess
Offer: Thank you for finding me, friend! Before we go, however, there is one small favor I need to ask of you. Those trinkets the Siren don are so shiny and pretty! Can you get some of those for me, so I can bring home to my girl? She would be very happy indeed!
Objective: Slay Siren Empress for their trinkets, and give them to Simons.

Name: Pandora's Desire
Offer: One mystical treasure map, split into 5 pieces, scattered throughout the world. Gather them, and mayhpas I can do something for you.
Objective: Gather 5 Pandora's Desire Fragments, and hand them to Maria in Lisbon Tavern.

Name: Augur's Request
Offer: I can help you with this menial task, but there is no free lunch in this world - I want some of those gifts, waddya say?
Objective: Gather 15 Chamomile and 15 Crinum Lily. Hand them to Maria in Lisbon Tavern.

Name: Storing materials
Offer: It is crucial to keep a store of materials, as you never know what tomorrow will bring.
Objective: Collect 50 Catnip, 50 Linen and 50 Sisal Hemp for the Guild Admin.

Name: Medal of Honor
Offer: Our guild has embarked on many adventures all around the world, like the famous North Islands expedition. As we often go on such voyages, we are always looking to enhance safety. Also, members that are sent on foreign missions often encounter dangerous situations.
Objective: Rid the Cretan Port of pirates, or ensure the guild exploration team is protected from the attacks of the North Snowmen. Obtain 10 Medals of Honor and submit them to the Guild Admin.

Name: Assassination
Offer: The Crete pirates have been quite ambitious of late, for we have gotten wind of their nefarious plans to assassinate our leaders. Quickly, you must act to eliminate their leader before their plan comes into fruition!
Objective: Protect Captain Tajid of Crete Port by foiling the pirates' plans. Kill 20 Cutthroat Pirate! (If insufficient enemies show, simply click on the quest NPC to refresh the quest.)

Name: Demonweed
Offer: In our recent explorations near Sardinia, we discovered a miraculous type of plant called the Demonweed - despiate of its name, it has amazing medicinal effects. We would dearly like some of its seeds for further research.
Objective: Head to Sardinia and collect 2 Demonseed. Hand them to Apothecary Donodi in Athens City once you have them.

Name: New Products
Offer: Come try this new product out, and tell me what you feel!
Objective: Look for Tomasi in Athens Port after you've tried out the new product.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Mercenary (Combat)
Offer: The owner of the farms in Beirut, Mona, wishes to engage our services in keeping away the various beasts roaming around these parts.
Objective: Slay 3 Savage Coyote to ensure the safety of the farmers. Then, look for Mona in Beirut City for your reward.

Name: Mercenary (Agriculture)
Offer: Ah, your arrival is timely indeed! Well, the thing is, we've developed a new strain of Demonweed, but it seems to be able to thrive only under similar conditions to its native habitat. The farm at Cyprus Island would be the most ideal,m but it's too dangerous for us to go alone.
Objective: Plant these seeds at the farm in Cyprus Island, and bring back 2 modified Demonweed to Athens City. Look for Apothecary Donodi.

Name: Any News?
Offer: If Arian happens to be still alive when you find him, will you please help me ask him if he has any progress on my request to him?
Objective: Look for Arian and ask him about Pia's request.

Name: Mordrei's Stone
Offer: New things are just waiting to be discovered every single day! Check out this new ore we found in the valley! Let's get more of them!
Objective: Collect 10 Mordrei's Stone and hand them to Shinpuris.

Name: The person is dead.
Offer: This is a day where families gather together for reunion. And here I am, spending it all alone. My little brother should have been here, but alas! He had such an explorer's streak in him. He longed to see the big world beyond our home, so he travelled far and wide...only to meet his demise in the hands of goblins on foreign lands. In the faraway Indian Ocean, there lies an ancient city called Basra. The cursed goblins reside in the ruins lying around the city! I yearn for revenge to avenge him but my weak body does not allow me to do so. Will you help me grant this wish of mine?
Objective: Go to Basra Suburb and kill 5 Jungle Goblins, 5 Spearman Goblins, 5 Dart Goblins and 1 Poison Dart Goblin.

Name: Lord of Shadows
TargetName: minion of the Lord of Shadows
Offer: Possedonia once had the grandest temple of all Atlantis! However with the fall of the Atlantian people, Poseidon himself had deserted this temple. What was once full of grandiose and gold have now fallen into the hands of the barbaric and evil monsters, under the rule of the Lord of Shadows. To prevent the Atlantian people from taking back what is rightfully ours, he had a barnacled minion keep watch over the temple with a special horn. When the horn is sounded, the Lord of Shadows will ascend from the depths of hell! Bring me the horn! This minion is said to be amongst the guardians.
Objective: Clean out the Poseidon Temple. Defeat the minion of the Lord of Shadows and hand its horn to Gaedeus.

Targets.Name: minion of the Lord of Shadows

Name: Trials and Tribulations
Offer: Go the Fayard and find a secluded place. Change into your authentic Gucci Robes. Those who go through the trials and tribulations by themselves can come back to claim their rewards.
Objective: Equip with Gucci Robes and defeat the Trials and Tribulations Beast.

Name: Mediterranean Sailboat Tournament (Barcelona Stop)
Offer: Welcome to the very first Meditarranean Sailboat Tournament in Voyage Century! The following is the route for this competition. Barcelona (Embarkation point) - Seville - Lisbon - Algiers - Tripoli - Alexandria - Beirut - Istanbul - Athens - Venice - Genoa - Barcelona (Destination point). Make haste, for every second is crucial to the final victory! Handsome rewards await those who finished in top 10. There will be participation prizes for everyone who took part in the tournament as well.
Objective: Follow the route as shown and go to the timekeeper in each city to obtain a signed card. Reach the final destination point at Barcelona and claim your reward.

RewardItems.Name: The signed card of Meditarranean Sailboat Tournament (Barcelona)

Name: Mediterranean Sailboat Tournament (Seville Stop)
Offer: Welcome to the very first Meditarranean Sailboat Tournament in Voyage Century! The following is the route for this competition. Name: Mediterranean Sailboat Tournament (Beirut Stop)
Offer: Welcome to the very first Meditarranean Sailboat Tournament in Voyage Century! The following is the route for this competition. Barcelona (Embarkation point) - Seville - Lisbon - Algiers - Tripoli - Alexandria - Beirut - Istanbul - Athens - Venice - Genoa - Barcelona (Destination point). Make haste, for every second is crucial to the final victory! Handsome rewards await those who finished in top 10. There will be participation prizes for everyone who took part in the tournament as well.
Objective: Follow the route as shown and go to the timekeeper in each city to obtain a signed card. Reach the final destination point at Barcelona and claim your reward.

RewardItems.Name: The signed card of Meditarranean Sailboat Tournament (Beirut)
