Name: Asking for enlightenment
Offer: I yearned for a life of voyage. Langer has advised me to approach the Veteran for guidance.
Objective: Go to find Veteran for guidance in Athens Port.

Name: Prepare for Sailing
Offer: The port is important,please go to ther for prepare.
Objective: Go to find Docker purchase 1000 provision,then go to talk Veteran for guidance

Name: Lesson One
Offer: The Veteran has began teaching me some naval war tactics. Incredibly, I'm beginning to trust that old fella. Hmm, I'd better follow his advice and stock up on supplies.
Objective: Head to Shipyard Boss and buy 70 Cannons, 1500 Cannon Balls, 1 Ship Armor, then report back to Veteran.

Name: Initiating Attack
Offer: The perils of the sea are both deadly and exciting. I'm not going to live my life like a coward. Where there is battle, there will be me! I've heard of a Crete Battlefield here. Sounds dangerous to me, just the way I like it! I'll take a tiny peek there...
Objective: Press CTRL+Z to open Ship Attributes Interface. Choose Inventory, left click on the Cannon in Inventory and equip it on your ship. Head to Crete Battlefield and sink 3 Cretan Peg Leg Armed Ships and 3 Crete Iron Fist Armed Ships. Report back to Veteran.

Name: Bellwether Hunting
Offer: The previous commotion left me feeling somewhat uneasy. I always feel like someone's following me, especially when I'm preparing to go out to sea... The Veteran is worried for me too. Guess I'll stop going out to sea for a while. Let's see what the mainland has to offer.
Objective: Press CTRL+C to open Character Attributes Interface. Choose Inventory, left click on a weapon to equip.(Press ALT+C to open Quick Equipment Shift Interface. There will be 3 setting interfaces for equipment and items. Click on the middle Change item Set to quickly equip the items in the interface.) Then, kill 1 Bellwether and obtain 1 Authenticating Article Sheep Horn (Random drop). Report back to Veteran.

Name: Weird Sheep Horn
Offer: The Veteran told me to bring the Sheep Horn to an Identifier for authentication. He advised me to find out know more about authentication from the Identifier.
Objective: Find Identifier (Athens) and speak to him. Choose Findings Authentication and authenticate the Sheep Horn.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Alleviate worry
Offer: This is great! The Identifier will be of great aid to me in many authentications to come in my voyages. Hmm, but first I'll need to help out a damsel in distress. There's a lady by the name of Wendora whom the Identifier seemed to fret about. Perhaps alleviating her woes would be of advantage to me when I approach the Identifier for help in future.
Objective: Speak to Wendora (Athens Tavern)
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Forerunner
Offer: Wendora needs a well-deserved rest. I know of a little island where lush greenery abounds. It's a secluded place and will be an ideal spot for her to take a break, if not for the pack of savage wolves residing there. I'll have to find a way to solve this problem.
Objective: Enter Thasos Island and kill 1 Lord of Wolves; or to Lemnos Isle and kill 1 Lord of Wolves, Then report back to Veteran.

Name: The Brash Youth
Offer: That Veteran gave me a horrible lecture again on the dangers of the sea and ranted at me for going out to sea. I'm tired of being treated like a child! That's it! I've had enough! I'll show him I do have what it takes! I'll go to Lemnos and gather some Graceful Jessamine Herb to prove him wrong!
Objective: Enter Lemnos and gather 1 stalk of Graceful Jessamine Herb. Bring it back to Veteran.

Name: Retraining
Offer: Due to my recklessness, the pirates have managed to sneaked in and launch attacks on us. And the Veteran was wounded as a result. Argh, it's all my fault. I need to train myself all over again so I can be even stronger. Time to head to the Skill Tutor!
Objective: Look for Skill Tutor and speak to him. The General Skills Interface will pop up. From the General Skills Interface, look under Stunts. Choose Sea Battle Skills. Under Sea Battle Skills, learn Grappling. Speak to Shipyard Boss and buy 1 Grappling Hook, then report back to Veteran.

Name: Crete Iron Hand Ship
Offer: I need to hone my skills to the sharpest I can! Let's go look for some pirates, shall we? Practices are no good without any sandbags to punch on, heh.
Objective: Equip Grappling Hook and head to Crete Battlefield. Sail to Crete Iron Hand Armed Ships. W,when your ship is near the enemy fleet, use the skill Grappling. Once you've boarded the enemy fleet successfully, kill the Captain and report back to Veteran.

Name: The Cost
Offer: Drats! They really attacked! The Veteran will be hopping mad if he knows about this. But no matter what I have to get even with them.
Objective: Find Veteran and speak to him.

Name: Defending Glory
Offer: I shall not be bound to anyone nor bind anyone to me. I will go forth in my own way!
Objective: Sink 1 1 Crete Iron Hand Smuggling Ship and report back to Veteran.

Name: Bidding Goodbye to the Veteran
Offer: What's done is done, what's gone is gone. I finally understand this saying. I really should not trouble the Veteran further. He's a pretty good old fella, actually. A little grouchy, but certainly a good mentor. I'm going to join the Warrior Alliance. Time to stock up on supplies!
Objective: Head to Alchemist and buy 5 bottles of Low-level Healing Potion; 5 bottles of Low-Level Recovery Potion. Report back to Ares Warrior Alliance Master (Athens).

Name: Profession merchant
Offer: Veteran for guidance seems is a man of great abilities, he can let me meet Merchant Guild Master.I would like to see him, maybe he can give me something.
Objective: Talk to Merchant Guild Master
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Businessman's First Try
Offer: Can't believe that was a lesson... To be honest, I didn't expect there is so much to be learnt about Trading! Well, my Purchasing may not be high, but asking me to purchase on the spot... isn't this task a bit too easy for me?
Objective: Go to Athens and look for Trader to buy 5 Seafood, then head back to Merchant Guild Master.

Name: Business Knowledge
Offer: The Merchant Guild Master told me the Skill Tutor can help me level up my skills. I should look for him.
Objective: Find Skill Tutor and speak to him. From the General Skills Interface choose Stunt, then choose Eloquence. Under Eloquence, level up the Purchasing to Level 2, and head back to Merchant Guild Master.

Name: The First Order
Offer: New tasks right after my training! And it's Overseas Trading no less. Ha! I may be gifted in this!
Objective: Look for Trader in Istanbul and buy 1 basket of Olives. Hand it to Merchant Guild Master in Athens.

Name: Reply Veteran
Offer: The jobs at the Merchant Guild are pretty easy stuff. All done! Hey, I actually miss the Veteran a little. Shall I drop by and have a chat with him?
Objective: Find Veteran and speak to him.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Grace of the Battleship(Instance can only be attempted by parties.)
TargetName: Edward's Pirate Fleet Golden Eye Pirate Ship
Offer: Despite the Veteran's warnings of the perilous sea, I yearn for the thrill that only seafaring voyages can bring me. Besides, the Cretan Pirates are wreaking havoc everywhere! Let me at them, who knows what excitement lies in store for me?
Objective: Form a party and enter the Instance Cretan Pirates Instance. Sink 3 Edward's Pirate Fleet Golden Eye Pirate Ship. Repoer back to Ares Warrior Alliance Master (Athens).

Targets.Name: Edward's Pirate Fleet Golden Eye Pirate Ship

Name: Attack and Defense of Gibraltar (Instance can only be attempted by parties.)
Offer: Wilfred told me of a passing rumor he heard on his travels. Sounds like an instance, so I'm going to check it out. The enemies sound really strong though, I'd better get some help along the way.
Objective: Strait of Gilbraltar Instance is located at the sea south of Seville. Form a party and enter the Instance to kill 1 Ottoman Turkish Tiger Pirate Ship. After that, look for Wilfred.

Name: Revenge!
Offer: Ever since the Ottoman Turkish Navy became tyrants on the seas, any ships associated with Christians have suffered at their hands. They won't even let a frail old man like me off! My children have all died in the hands of the cursed Iron Hand Edward... Will you avenge them for me?
Objective: Kill the head of the Cretan Pirates, Iron Hand Edward. He's at the Pirate's Den situated at the east of Crete Island.

Name: For the glory of Lord!
TargetName: fleet of the head of Ottoman Turkish Navy
Offer: As the children of God, as devout Christians, as the men of our good King, it is our duty to eliminate all Islamic heretics. Reinstate peace and harmony to the world and the Lord himself will wash away our sins on Judgment Day. Those cursed heretics are thwarting our Iberian Peninsula restoration project, even planning to invade Gilbraltar and attack passing Christian fleets from there! The scroundrels are tainting the holy land of Christ and we must put a stop to their blasphemous deeds! Gentlemen! Grip your ship's wheels and follow me into the fray! For the glory of the Lord!
Objective: Defeat the fleet of the head of Ottoman Turkish Navy. It's situated in the battle of the Gilbraltar straits.

Targets.Name: fleet of the head of Ottoman Turkish Navy

Name: Working is the most honorable thing a man can do.
Offer: Uncle Tuu is holding the event "Labor, the Ultimate Honor" to commemorate Labor Day! Gather the plants he needs and rewards await!
Objective: Gather 20 Linen, 20 Catnip and 20 Sisal

Name: Exterminate the Norwegian pirates!
Offer: Since the English Navy defeated the Spanish Armada, the waters from the North Sea to the New World have been safe to navigate for our trading ships. But recently a group of Norwegian pirates have been discovered along the trade route to the Russian Empire. They now control the Skagerrak Straits, obliterating any ships that dare go near. Show your courage and defeat them!
Objective: Search and destroy the Zeus, flagship of the Norwegian Pirate Captain, Karr Emmanuel. He stalks the sea route between London and Stockholm.

Name: Wiping Out Barbarians
Offer: Taiwan is filled with Barbarians. Seek out the strongest of them all and defeat him to prove your bravery!
Objective: Head to Taiwan and kill a Barbarian Champion

Name: Hunting Down Golum Knight
Offer: The Golum Knights on the second floor of the Imperial Mausoleum are giving me a headache! Could you help me get rid of these ghastly robots?
Objective: Head to second floor of Imperial Mausoleum and kill a Golum Knight.

Name: Spidery Nightmare
Offer: Argh, I hate spiders with a passion! These foul and disgusting creatures just make me sick to the core. I hear you are a pretty capable captain. Will you be able to help me get rid of Black Widow, the leader of the Cretan Spiders? I will reward you handsomely!
Objective: Enter the Cretan Instance to kill the Black Widow.

Name: Headshaking Lizards
Offer: Those headshaking lizards likes to dish out malicious bites to humans, posing a danger to the surrounding civilians. Will you help us exterminate the leader of these pesky lizards?
Objective: Enter the Mallorcan Instance to slay the Giant Lizard.

Name: The Labyrinth Minotaur
Offer: A poor monster has been blundering abound the maze sine many year ago, you can go to help him to "fix" this problem eternally. Heihei.
Objective: Enter the Cretan Instance 2nd Level to kill the Minotaur.

Name: Killing Wandering Soul
Offer: Have you heard of the notorious Cretan pirates? They have ravaged the Aegean Sea for ages... We have been looking for a courageous and strong captain like you to help quash their "Wandering Soul".
Objective: Defeat a Cretan Wandering Soul

Name: The Berserk Bears
Offer: Bears do not attack people unless provoked. But recently, some bears on Mallorca Island seemed to have gone berserk and attacked travellers! Known as Fury Bears, these creatures have been giving us a lot of trouble. Could you help us get rid of them?
Objective: Kill a Frenzied Bear

Name: Wiping Out Vikings
Offer: The Vikings are known to be a bloodthirsty bunch of savages. Their unity makes them a threat that is hard to be quelled. But if you take down their Lord, they should be a lot more easier to defeat.
Objective: Kill a Viking Lord

Name: The Fayard Sea Battle
Offer: The Fayard pirates have been growing in power lately. We have to quash them before they pose any serious threat! Captain, hurry and head to Fayard Sea, teach these varmins a good lesson!
Objective: Defeat a Fayard Pirate Ship

Name: King Kong
Offer: King Kong is a creature filled with highly destructive powers. We must get rid of it before it begins to do any serious damage!
Objective: Kill a King Kong

Name: Madagascar!
Offer: The Madagascar pirates have been in cahoots with the pirates from Cape of Good Hope in the recent plundering and pillaging of merchant ships. We need your help, captain. Their forces must be quelled. Go and destroy the Flagship of the Madagascar pirates!
Objective: Defeat a Madagascar Pirate Flagship.

Name: The Haunted Taj Mahal
Offer: The Taj Mahal has been haunted by many spirits and phantoms recently. This is atrocious, how can a world wonder like her be plagued and blasphemed in such a vile manner? O brave one, we hope you can help the Taj Mahal exorcise the devils within and let her resume her grandiose glory!
Objective: Kill a Phantom Lord

Name: Foray into Imperial Mausoleum
Offer: The Mausoleum Guard Captains are notorious for their legendary strength. Break through their defense and show the world what you are made of!
Objective: Kill a Mausoleum Guard Captain

Name: The Guardian Beast
Offer: The Guardian Beasts within the Mausoleum are known to be creatures of terror and death. Killing them will earn you honor and glory!
Objective: Kill 3 Guardian Beasts

Name: Kratos' initial test
Offer: The first training session and I have to run to Semarang. But I can have no complaints. This is my first test, a hero's test for me.
Objective: Go to the outskirts of Semarang and collect prayer beads from the Mechanical Buddhas. Hand them to Kratos

Name: Kratos' second test
Offer: This time, the target is that ridiculously huge Lizard on Mallorca Island. *sigh* I don't like killing frivolously, but its for training.
Objective: Head to Mallorca copy, kill a Giant Lizard, then report to Kratos

Name: Kratos' third test
Offer: Finally, a test that looks challenging! Really, I did not even break a sweat for the first 2. Good, now I have to get serious!
Objective: Head to Crete copy and kill the Crete Giant Tarantula and the Black Widow. Collect Poisonous Nets and Venomous Nets and submit them to Kratos

Name: Kratos' final test
Offer: Its time for the final test. Kratos gave me this thing and told me to head to Thassos Island.
Objective: At Thassos Island, use the Sorrow of War, and defeat the opponent that appears. Then report back to Kratos

Name: Sea Incarnate
Offer: Glaucus, known as the "Sea Incarnate". Retired from the Navy. Possessing extraordinary preperception, his fleet struck fear in the hearts of many a pirate. To improve my sea battle skills, I have to learn from him.
Objective: Find Glaucus in the city of Barcelona and seek his mentorship.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Glaucus' first test
Offer: The pirates on the Baltic sea aren't worth their salt, but they are the first obstacle in my sea battle training.
Objective: Go to the Baltic Sea Battlefield and destroy 5 Hades ships and 5 5 Devil ships, then report back to GlaucusE

Name: Glaucus' second test
Offer: This time, the opponent is Edward, the famous pirate of Crete. I cannot afford to be careless.
Objective: Head to Crete copy and destroy Edward's Devil ship, then report back to Glaucus

Name: Glaucus' third test
Offer: The enemy is the scourge of Gibraltar, the Ottoman Pirate Fleet. Finally, a worthy opponent!
Objective: Head to Gibraltar copy and destroy the Lord, the flagship of the pirate Bolukbashi. Then report back to Glaucus

Name: Glaucus' final test
Offer: The Norwegian pirate king, Karr Emmanuel? This might be out of my league.
Objective: Head to the North Seas copy and destroy the Zeus, flagship of Karr Emmanuel. Then report back to Glaucus

Name: Golden Tower Challenge
Offer: Now that you're a lot stronger than you originally was, do you want to test your mettle? There is a Golden Tower at the Seville outskirts which might prove a challenge with its countless strong guards. Remember to bring back a Proof of Battle.
Objective: Challenge the guardians of the Golden Tower and bring back a piece of Proof of Battle (Grade 1) and give it to the Veteran

Name: Canyon of the Sun
Offer: Written on the card: The golden Sun soars over the plateau, the fishes bask among the green of the pond, the millet ripens into a rusty brown, and the rays of the sun pierces the shrouded canyon a-bright.
Objective: Obtain 1 Sun Brooch from Selina and give it to Novalis

Name: Local Specialty
Offer: Every locale has its specialty. Portobello is no exception. It has the finest Bananas not found anywhere else. Hurry and gather some.
Objective: Obtain 4 bunches of Delicious Bananas from the Town Berzerker and give it to Novalis on the Madeira docks.

Name: Mysterious Faith
Offer: Every culture has its unique faith. What do the people Portobello believe in? Perhaps we can learn a fair bit from their Miraculous Crystal.
Objective: Obtain 1 Miraculous Crystal from the Town Hunter and give it to Novalis on the Madeira docks.

Name: Minotaur's Accessory
Offer: The people of Portobello worship Quetzacoatl. Yet this card tells of this card tells of the legend of the Minotaur. I wonder if Novalis can find out why this is so from the Minotaur's Accessory.
Objective: Obtain 1 Minotaur's Accessory from the Town Conqueror and give it to Novalis on the Madeira docks.

Name: Waning Moon Pendant
Offer: Written on the card: The forests still echoes of the clamor of clashing weapons and blood-letting. The moon glistens on the razed hamlet.
Objective: Obtain 1 Waning Moon Pendant from Cynthia Renne and give it to Novalis on the Madeira docks.

Name: The Accursed
Offer: A poem written on the card: The plague taints her blue robe on the floor, the shadowy guest shuts the door. Through the lattice the black maple fruit falls through the gloom, her eyes, heavy with sorrow. The boy combs her raven hair in bloom, his shining tears roll down the brows knitted a-furrow, into her eyes, hollow.
Objective: Obtain 2 Accursed's Brooch from the Town Executioners and give them to Novalis on the Madeira docks.

Name: Knight
Offer: The Lord into his heart sets a gentle flame flicker. His footsteps silently threading into a city in rain and bluster. He cries: “I, pledge my life to knighthood!”
Objective: Obtain 1 Knight's Lance from Krausa Renne and give it to Novalis on the Madeira docks.

Name: Lightning Falcon Wood Carving
Offer: Wild geese fly over the blue pond into the distance, while icy winds seem to blow from the stars in the twilight sky.
Objective: Obtain 1 Wooden Eagle Statuette from Alf Barton and give it to Novalis on the Madeira docks.

Name: Reclaim the lost territories
Offer: The city of Portobello has been occupied by the Renne siblings and their cronies! Defeat them and reclaim the lost territories!
Objective: Enter the Portobello city district and eliminate Alf Barton, Aus Rico, Captain Selina and the Renne siblings. Then report to Quintana.

Name: Day 1, Collect Logs
Offer: For the first of the Logistics Weekly Quests, you have to collect 60 Logs. Work hard everyone, this is just the start.
Objective: Collect 60 Logs

Name: Day 2, Collect Impure Copper Ore
Offer: Copper is often used by mariners, for the production of weapons and ships.
Objective: Collect 60 Impure Copper Ore

Name: Day 3, Practice Planting
Offer: Have you been intrigued with the seemingly infinite variety of flora while traveling around the world? Wish to grow some of the seeds you collected? Then you will need the Planting skill, why don't you work on it a little?
Objective: Collect 60 Jutes

Name: Day 5, Practicing Foundry
Offer: Buying weapons from a store will never feel as confortable in the hand as one custom forged, just for you. Try forging a Broad Saber.
Objective: Collect 1 Broad Sabre

Name: Day 6, Practicing Sewing (Male)
Offer: The hides and furs of various beasts often make exquisite materials for beautiful apparel, try sewing one for yourself.
Objective: Obtain 1 Merchant Prince Hat

Name: Day 6, Practicing Sewing (Female)
Offer: The hides and furs of various beasts often make exquisite materials for beautiful apparel, try sewing one for yourself.
Objective: Obtain 1 Merchant Princess Hat

Name: Day 7, Practicing Alchemy
Offer: This will be your toughest test yet, and also something that will help you the most in the heat of battle.
Objective: Collect 10 Low-level Poison

Name: First Day of an Adventure
Offer: I heard you have a taste for adventure, so how about if you obtain 1 Authenticating Article from the Giant Sea Serpent for me?
Objective: Obtain 1 Authenticating Article from the Giant Sea Serpent

Name: Second Day of an Adventure
Offer: Bring 1 Authenticating Article from the Caveman Champions to me and you will be rewarded your due.
Objective: Obtain 1 Authenticating Article from the Caveman Champions

Name: Third Day of an Adventure
Offer: I heard that there are Bronze Buddhas that can move about as though they are alive, I wonder if they are myth or real
Objective: Obtain 1 Authenticating Article from the Animated Bronze Buddhas

Name: Final Day of an Adventure
Offer: Do creatures like the Foxdevils exist? Show me proof of their existence.
Objective: Obtain 1 Authenticating Article from the Foxdevils

Name: Exploration Weekly Event
TargetName: Map of the Mediterranean East Coast
Offer: Have you been to the Mediterranean East Coast? Obtain a copy of the map of the Mediterranean East Coast for me
Objective: Collect 1 Map of the Mediterranean East Coast

Targets.Name: Map of the Mediterranean East Coast

Name: First Day of the Land Battle Event
Offer: The mission for the first day is easy enough, just collect 5 Level 1 and Level 2 Leather each.
Objective: Collect 5 Level 1 Leather and 5 Level 2 Leather

Name: Second Day of the Land Battle Event
Offer: It might be slightly harder than yesterday, but don't fail this.
Objective: Collect 5 Level 3 and Level 4 Leather each

Name: Third Day of the Land Battle Event
Offer: Here comes the real test, think you are up for it?
Objective: Collect 5 Level 5 and Level 6 Leather each

Name: First Day of the Sea Battle Event
Offer: My ship still needs a Fire Swordfish Figurehead, help me find one will you?
Objective: Collect 1 Fire Swordfish Figurehead

Name: Second Day of the Sea Battle Event
Offer: The Figurehead you got for me is too small, I need a bigger one
Objective: Collect 1 Fire Dolphin Figurehead

Name: Third Day of the Sea Battle Event
Offer: I need the Fire Sea Horse Figurehead for the long voyage ahead
Objective: Collect 1 Fire Sea Horse Figurehead

Name: Fourth Day of the Sea Battle Event
Offer: Drats, my ship was sunk by pirates, help me find a Fire Lion Figurehead, I will need it to take revenge on thos sea-currs
Objective: Collect 1 Fire Lion Figurehead

Name: Fireworks Exchange
Offer: Collect the words "Strength" and "& Prosperity" and submit them along with 500000 silvers to the Founding Anniversary Fireworks Engineer at Seville Port to receive Founding Anniversary Fireworks
Objective: Set the Founding Anniversary Fireworks off to bring a little festive cheer to the occasion and even receive a Lost Document

Name: Escort the Moon Rabbit.
Offer: Escort the Moon Rabbit back to Chang-er.
Objective: The Moon Rabbit gest lost, please escort it back to Chang-er in Beijing, but you need to hand over three moon cakes first, or the Moon Rabbit will not move.

Name: Forging Materials
Offer: We are in need of a number of new weapons for the expedition. Fortunately I have just finished the blueprints of some brand new designs. I just require the necessary materials to make them.
Objective: Help the Queen Elizabeth Buy 10 Pure Silver, 10 Level 7 Timber, and 1 Level 7 Mould.

Name: Halloween Host
Offer: Every monster has a random chance to drop "Tasty Treat" upon defeat.
Objective: Collect 10 Tasty Treats and submit them to the Halloween Host

Name: Adorable Child
Offer: Every monster has a random chance to drop "Tasty Treat" upon defeat.
Objective: Collect 20 Tasty Treats and Pumpkin Heads and submit them to the Adorable Child

Name: Captain Jacques
Offer: The "Lv1 Melting Stone" is Captain Jacques' latest innovation. But the materials needed to make one are very rare. I have some of them but I need you to help gather the rest. Can you help? I will give you one of these Lv1 Melting Stones if you do!
Objective: Collect a Melting Stone, one Exact Apparatus, and 10,000,000 Silver Coins

Name: <Mysterious Continent>
Offer: The Castellan of Tortuga City has learned that the Open Sea Treasure Map along with the <Mysterious Continent> Exploration Logbook are in the hands of the Armed Merchant Ships that sail the seas in the vicinity of Tortuga City. The Castellan expects you to hunt down these ships and wrest the Treasure Map and the Exploration Logbook from the hands of their captains. Deliver the Exploration Logbook to the Hall Steward. Speak with the <Mysterious Continent> Teleporter to teleport to Tortuga City. Reminder: Only Ruby Level, Sapphire Level, Gold Level, Black Diamond Level Armed Merchant Ships will carry the Exploration Logbook.
Objective: Collect a copy of the <Mysterious Continent> Exploration Logbook

Name: <Calm Before The Storm>
Offer: Hordes of Tyrannosaurus Rex and Gorillas are rampaging the beaches of Hurricane Island. It seems they are guarding young dragons. Kill these Young Drakes, or they will menace the city when they are full-grown. Deliver any Exploration Logbooks you acquire to the Hall Steward. Speak with the <Calm Before The Storm> Teleporter to teleport to Hurricane Island.

Name: Queen's Decree
Offer: The constant development of the American colonies has progressively expanded till the East Coast region. By Decree of Queen Elizabeth, I am to head to the North American East Coast to aid the newly developed colony by the James River - Jamestown.
Objective: Go to the newly established Jamestown and report to Governor John Smith.

Name: Persuade The Indians
Offer: After arriving in Jamestown, I discovered the grim state of affairs here from the Governor: on account of the settlers being unable to adapt to their new environment and climate, agricultural production has been terribly low. He requested that I approached the Indian Chief living nearby to retrieve the book <<American Farming Basics>>.
Objective: Go to Jamestown outskirts and locate Indian Chief.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The Chief's Conditions
Offer: The Indian chief has amiably received me, but has expectably refused to provide unconditional aid: He wishes for me to retrieve some Cougar pelts in exchange for their Indian wisdom.
Objective: Kill the Cougar King, Male Cougars and Female Cougars in Jamestown outskirts to obtain 10 Puma Pelts for Indian Chief.

Name: Reporting to the Governor
Offer: Now that I've finally got the <<American Farming Basics>> from the Indian Chief, I'd better hurry back and give it to Governor John Smith.
Objective: Return to Jamestown and speak to John Smith.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The Origins of Thanksgiving
Offer: With the help of the Indians, the settlers have obtained the means to survive in this harsh new environment. In order to thank them, Governor John Smith has instructed for me to retrieve some Turkey to roast for the Indians as a token of appreciation.
Objective: Go to Jamestown outskirts to hunt 20 Turkeys, then return to Jamestown and speak to Governor John Smith\.

Name: New Settlers
Offer: The Governor has told me that Jamestown can't rely on farming alone for growth. Due to a lack of settlers and by extension manpower, Governor John Smith has requested that I returned to London to request for more settlers from the Queen, and bring them back here.
Objective: Go to London and speak to Elizabeth.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Tussle For Slaves
TargetName: Slave Ship or West African Pirate Ships
Offer: When I spoke to the Slave Trader in Dakar, it turns out that his last batch of slaves have been bought by the Tortuga Slave Master and left in the Slave Ship, and the next batch of slaves would only be due in another three months. Since I can't wait that long, I decided to go after the ship and get some slaves from there. Should I fail, I'll just have to go to look around Las Palmas to try my luck, and see if I can't get some slaves off the West African Pirate Ships.
Objective: Sink the Slave Ship or West African Pirate Ships, obtain 10 Slaves, and bring them back to Jamestown to John Smith.

Targets.Name: Slave Ship or West African Pirate Ships

Name: Building Fortifications
Offer: Wild animal attacks and conflicts with the Indian tribe are giving Governor John Smith a headache. He wants me to talk to Captain Blair, who is in charge of constructing fortifications.
Objective: Speak to Captain Blair in Jamestown.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Wood Shortage
Offer: After talking to Blair, I found out that there is a shortage of wood, and the Indians think that we are ruining their forest and offended their gods. Everytime we send our woodcutters for wood, they get driven out by the Indians. I agreed to help Blair settle the problem.
Objective: Go to Jamestown outskirts and reach a consensus with the Indian Chief.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: New God
Offer: I spoke Indian Chief in hopes of reaching a solution, but unfortunately he is obstinately deep-rooted in his faith. So, I instead decided to fool him into believing that the one that protects them is not the Tree God, but the great white-furred Bear God. Unable to believe that a white bear exists at all, the Indian Chief doesn't believe me. Thus, I promised to show him a white "Bear God".
Objective: Go to Polar Tundra (Elite) Instance and capture a Krute, then bring it back to Jamestown outskirts and give it to the Indian Chief.

Name: Tree Chopping Cert
Offer: The Indian Chief prostrates himself in front of the "Bear God". He now believes me and is grateful to me for finding the tribe's "true god". He gave me Tree Chopping Certs, which meant that Jamestown is now allowed to obtain lumber from the forest here.
Objective: Speak to Indian Chief.

Name: Reporting back to Captain Blair
Offer: After finally settling things with the Indians, I should hurry back and report to Captain Blair so he can send out woodcutters again.
Objective: Bring the Tree Chopping Cert back to Blair in Jamestown.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Suspicious Indian Girl
Offer: While returning, I caught a glimpse of an Indian girl sneaking and peering about. Suspecting that she might be a spy from a tribe planning to attack Jamestown, I decide to capture and question her.
Objective: Go to Jamestown outskirts and find the suspicious Indian Girl.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Uncovering the Truth
Offer: I returned to Jamestown and ask John Smith the truth of the matter. He seems deeply moved and tells me that he remember Pocahontas. He was unable to express his gratitude back then because of the wrath of the Tsenacommacah tribe. And now that she is in trouble, he cannot leave her in the lurch.
Objective: Return to Jamestown City and speak to Governor John Smith to verify Sana's story.

Name: Locating the Princess
Offer: The people of Jamestown still need John Smith, so he is unable to leave. He tells me to help him look for the princess and save her. He suggest to look for Hammil at the tavern, as he's an information treasure trove.
Objective: Speak to Governor John Smith in Jamestown.

Name: Discovering Clues
Offer: Upon Governor Smith's suggestion, I went to gather information from the Indians of Jamestown outskirts.
Objective: Speak to the Indian Chief.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: A Break in Relations
Offer: When I visited the Indian Chief to ask about Pocahontas, I instead found that the "Bear God" Krute that I brought to them had killed many of their tribesmen. In his anger, the Indian Chief declared war on Jamestown. I must hurry back and report this to the Captain Blair.
Objective: Return to Jamestown and inform Captain Blair about the Indians' intent to attack the town.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The Element of Surprise
Offer: Captain Blair has hatched a plan to surprise the Indians with an attack before the battle heats up. As a surprise attack cannot be done with too many people, I will be the one to draw the first blood of this battle.
Objective: Go to Jamestown outskirts and kill Indian Rave and Indian Brave, then return to Jamestown to report to Captain Blair.

Name: Continuing the Search
Offer: Having completed my task in aiding Jamestown's defense, I continue on my original task in pinpointing Pocahontas' location, and decide to try my luck at the Jamestown Tavern.
Objective: Speak to Hammil at the Jamestown Tavern.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: New Amsterdam
Offer: I went to the Tavern and asked Hammil for news on Pocahontas, but to no avail. However, he suggested to look in New Amsterdam, a bustling, chaotic city. According to him, the New Amsterdam Tavern is a treasure trove of information, and I only need to seek out the boss, Francis, to access it. But, to get him to talk, we'll have to give him a little gift of Rhino Meat. Let's go hunt some American Rhinos, then.
Objective: Go to Jamestown outskirts and kill American Rhino, obtain 10 Rhino Meat, then go to New Amsterdam and seek out Francis.

Name: Visiting General Howell
Offer: The first definite piece of information comes from Francis, who tells me that the tribes that wiped out the Tsenacommacah tribe were in turn defeated by the British Expedition Soldiers, and they are all now captives. Pocahontas should be among them. I should pay General Howell a visit.
Objective: Go to New Amsterdam outskirts and speak to General Howell.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Shrewd General
Offer: I located General Howell in the New Amsterdam outskirts and discovered Pocahontas' whereabouts. It turns out that she is in the hands of General Howell, but he is unwilling consider handing her to me unless I wiped out the French Expedition Soldiers for him.
Objective: Head to the French Expedition Camp in the New Amsterdam outskirts and kill French Expedition Soldier and General Simon, then report back to General Howell.

Name: Challenge after Challenge
Offer: I've wiped out the French expedition force and reported back to General Howell, earning his appreciation and an invitation into the ranks of the British Army. I have declined this offer and told him that I am only concerned about Pocahontas' well-being, and implored that he released her immediately. He insists that he would release her, but only if I have also wiped out the Dutch force and brought him army supplies.
Objective: Head to the French Expedition Camp in the New Amsterdam outskirts and kill Dutch Expedition Soldier and General Ronnie\. Then go to New Amsterdam, seek out George Locke and complete the Military Firearms Exchange Quest to obtain 20 Militarian Firearms and 100 Military Rifles. Report back to General Howell afterwards.

Name: Trading With The Arms Merchant
Offer: Arms Merchant Locke says that he has the items in stock, but he wants me to get him White-headed Vulture Claws, Canadian Cougar Pelts and American Bear Gall Bladders for him.
Objective: Go to New Amsterdam outskirts or Jamestown outskirts and gather 10 White-headed Vulture Claws, 10 Canadian Cougar Pelts and 10 American Bear Gall Bladders, then head back to George Locke in New Amsterdam to exchange them for weapons.

Name: Insatiable Greed
Offer: I have wiped out the Dutch expedition force and reported back to General Howell. He is elated, and once again requests that I helped him disarm the citizens. I refused this task, warning him that if he was to fool with me any further, I would wipe his army out the same way I did the others: 3 days; release the princess, or die.
Objective: Speak to General Howell at the New Amsterdam outskirts to complete the quest.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The Governor's Message
Offer: I received a letter asking me to go to New Amsterdam to meet with Governor Bob Adams.
Objective: Talk to Governor Bob Adams in New Amsterdam to complete the quest.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Mysterious Petrel
Offer: Governor Bob Adams has found out of my exploits in the New Amsterdam outskirts under the manipulation of Howell, and that his next target is the very citizens of New Amsterdam. As such, he met with me hoping I would stop helping Howell, and also given me means to obtain the information I require. I am to contact the spy organization - Petrel.
Objective: Speak to Marta Haylee at New Amsterdam Harbor to complete the quest.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Marta Haylee's Request
Offer: Marta Haylee promised that she will recover news about Pocahontas from the British Expedition Army in the shortest amount of time. Meanwhile, she has requested that I retrieved a Fire Wolf Heart and a Silver Wolf Heart to treat an ailing friend of hers, so we may together save Pocahontas as well as Marta's precious friend.
Objective: Go to New Amsterdam outskirts and kill Fire Wolf King and Silver Wolf King, obtain the Fire Wolf Heart and Silver Wolf Heart, and bring them to Marta Haylee.

Name: The Truth
Offer: As promised by Marta Haylee, her spies' efficiency has amazed me. According to her information, Pocahontas wasn't even in British custody, but was instead whisked away by a Lieutenant Commander Berke Cromwell even before she had reached the camp. Howell had been playing me for a fool all along. Knowing that she is on Hurricane Island, I had better hurry over... but not before I punish Howell's troops a little.
Objective: Go to New Amsterdam outskirts and kill British Expedition Soldier, then speak to General Howell to complete the quest.

Name: Return to Jamestown
Offer: Bring Pocahontas back to Jamestown, to Governor John Smith.
Objective: Go to Jamestown Port and speak to John Smith to complete the quest.

Name: Household of Sin
Offer: Although you have killed the sinful pair of siblings, the Reyes Royal Fleet has appeared at Portobello Bay in an attempt to make a comeback. Tip: Guild Members can obtain Vigor points from this quest. (The more members participating, the more Vigor you get) Information on Vigor: Bottom Right Corner - Interaction - Guild - Guild - View Guild Benefits
Objective: Kill Ricardo Reyes, and teach the Reyes family a lesson!

Name: Heartless
Offer: Mizra... I had given her my heart, but all she gave me in return was eternal darkness in my left eye! I am no longer a match for her. Please get rid of her for me. Tip: Guild Members can obtain Vigor points from this quest. (The more members participating, the more Vigor you get) Information on Vigor: Bottom Right Corner - Interaction - Guild - Guild - View Guild Benefits
Objective: Enter Battled Forest Instance and kill Corporal Mizra.

Name: Relief
Offer: They say time heals all wounds, and indeed I have gotten used to this peg leg of mine. But I can never forget that Boris and Primera are to blame for my misfortune. I believe you will be able to return the favor. Tip: Guild Members can obtain Vigor points from this quest. (The more members participating, the more Vigor you get) Information on Vigor: Bottom Right Corner - Interaction - Guild - Guild - View Guild Benefits
Objective: Enter Battled Forest Instance and kill Sergeant Boris, then go to Auchi Level 2 and kill Staff Sergeant Primera.

Name: Vengeance
Offer: Schmitz and his lackey Thomas must be the culprits behind my suffering. You know what to do: Kill them, and I'll reward you when you get back. Tip: Guild Members can obtain Vigor points from this quest. (The more members participating, the more Vigor you get) Information on Vigor: Bottom Right Corner - Interaction - Guild - Guild - View Guild Benefits
Objective: Enter Battled Forest and kill Staff Sergeant Thomas and Traitor Schmitz at Auchi Level 2

Name: Victory in the Land Battle!
Offer: Only the strongest paves their way into the Battle of Petro Fortress! Win a battle in Petro Fortress and carve your name into immortality!
Objective: Obtain a victory in the Battle of Petro Fortress

Name: Victory in the Sea Battle!
Offer: Only the strongest paves their way into the Battle of Labrinton Coast! Win a battle in Labrinton Coast and carve your name into immortality!
Objective: Obtain a victory in the Battle of Labrinton Coast

Name: Inter-server Siege Warrior
Offer: Only the strongest paves their way into the Inter-server Siege War. Eliminate 1 enemy to claim your hero status.
Objective: Eliminate 1 enemy in the Inter-server Siege War.

Name: Return to Origins
Offer: You're back? Isn't it depressing to deal with this cruel world everyday? It's good you're back. I have some things here that might help you.
Objective: Speak to Veteran at Athens Port.

Name: Retraining (II)
Offer: Ho? Looks like the outside world has honed your mettle. Let us continue! Go to Madagascar Instance and kill Caveman Chief.
Objective: Kill the Caveman Chief, then report back to Veteran.

Name: Retraining (III)
Offer: Not bad! You'll have to travel a little this time round, but I'm sure you'll be fine. Go on to the Taj Mahal Instance and kill the Phantom Lord.
Objective: Kill the Phantom Lord, then report back to Veteran.

Name: Retraining (IV)
Offer: Keep at it! Go to Bimini Island and kill the Bimini old Lion.
Objective: Kill the Bimini old Lion, then report back to Veteran.

Name: A New Expedition
Offer: Complete the last bit of training, then leave this place. You are one that cannot be separated from danger for too long. Ah, I almost forgot, you can seek out Doke here to purchase a King's Shield. Tip: Guild Members can obtain Vigor points from this quest.
Objective: Go to Portobello Bay on Bimini Island and look for Desolate Valley Instance (Normal). In there, you may use the Judgement Blade to kill the Ghost Pioneer, then report back to Veteran. Note: You may only use the Judgement Blade in the Desolate Valley Instance (Normal).

Name: Leveling Up
Offer: First, if you want to be a guild member, you can go to any city's Guild Manager to apply to join a guild. After joining a guild, you can then go to Guild Manager to enter the Guild Hall and accept Goods Storage Quests from Guild Admin in order to earn large amounts of Profession Experience and Agriculture Build Permit by submitting plants to him. Remember to first obtain Rally Forms from the Guild Token Envoy, and also use the Guild Chat found at the bottom left corner to interact with your other guild members and ask for help, such as how to perform Auto-planting. Tip: Guild Members can obtain Vigor points from this quest.
Objective: The Goods Storage Quests among the Guild Quests are a good way to level up! Complete 20 Goods Storage Quests and obtain 20 Agriculture Build Permit to redeem rewards from the Guild Token Envoy!

Name: Trade Points Card Exchange
Offer: Trade Points Cards can be exchanged for amazing rewards via the Trade Points Exchanger in Barcelona. To earn Trade Points Cards 1, visit the Daily Trading Clerk (In Athens Port or Hall of Memories) to accept and complete quests, or 2complete Daily Trends (Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Exchange System).
Objective: Obtain an Attack Stone (Superior) from Trade Points Exchanger in Barcelona and show it to Glaucus.

Name: Equipment Upgrade Materials
Offer: Charms and Equipment can be upgraded through their respective NPCs, and their attributes will be improved greatly after upgrading. Land Battle Equipment: Compound Grandmaster from Seville Port. Sea Battle Equipment: Naval Equipment Enhancer from Genoa Port. Tip: You can place your equipment into the bottom area of the game's Gear Enhancement System to undergo refining, and view the respective required Upgrade Materials. Tip: Guild Members can obtain Vigor points from this quest.
Objective: Obtain a Refined Magnetic Ore (Ordinary) and an Ancient Stone (Old) from Suit and Suit Material Exchange Clerk in Seville Port and show them to the Daily Instance Quests Giver. You'll be rewarded handsomely!

Name: Treasure Hunter
Offer: Decades ago, pirates worldwide have buried their countless treasures, which are merely there for the taking today. You're all ready to go get them, so don't miss out! ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")
Objective: Look for Gonzales in Barcelona to find out about this Quest's details. At levels 110, 125 and 135, you can get new treasure map quests from Gonzales.

Name: Set Forth On A Journey
Offer: A Level 1 Inland Treasure Map might not be of much value, but finding it would at least prove your potential! Go locate one!
Objective: Compound a Level 1 Inland Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: Raise Your Sails
Offer: A Level 1 Open-Sea Treasure Map might not be of much value, but finding it would at least prove your potential! Go locate one!
Objective: Compound a Level 1 Open-Sea Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: A Long Trip
Offer: Finding a Level 2 Inland Treasure Map isn't as simple as finding a Level 1 Treasure Map! Work hard for your dreams, kid!
Objective: Compound a Level 2 Inland Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: Against The Flow
Offer: Finding a Level 2 Open-Sea Treasure Map isn't as simple as finding a Level 1 Treasure Map! Work hard for your dreams, kid!
Objective: Compound a Level 2 Open-Sea Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: Land Delicacy
Offer: Locating a Level 3 Inland Treasure Map would establish your professional qualifications! Don't disappoint me!
Objective: Compound a Level 3 Inland Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: Deep Sea Treasure
Offer: Locating a Level 3 Open-Sea Treasure Map would establish your professional qualifications! Don't disappoint me!
Objective: Compound a Level 3 Open-Sea Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: Clear The Land
Offer: Locating a Level 4 Inland Treasure Map isn't something anyone could do, but since you're so insistent, you ought to work hard to find it!
Objective: Compound a Level 4 Inland Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: Break The Waves
Offer: The sea is filled with many unknown dangers but as a saying from the East put it, "Nothing ventured, nothing gained". Greater rewards naturally come with taking greater risks.
Objective: Compound a Level 4 Open-Sea Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: Treasure Finder
Offer: A Level 5 Treasure Map is much sought after by many. I have high hopes that you will get it!
Objective: Compound a Level 5 Inland Treasure Map at the Treasure Hunter in Barcelona, then go look for Gonzales. ("As for how to Treasure Hunt after combining Treasure Map, refer to: Bottom Right Corner of Game - Electronic Book - Treasure Hunt System - Treasure Hunting Process")

Name: Home Sweet Home - Beijing Night Tour
Offer: Autumn is the season of rememberance where people think of their relatives. It is said that tonight Beijing will be crowded, maybe I should join in on the crowd and soak in the atmosphere.
Objective: Go to Beijing City and speak to Grandma Chen

Name: Home Sweet Home - A Long Distance
Offer: When I was young, I used to be the one in charge of supplying the palace with mooncake. It's been 3 years since I have met my son who had went to sea on business. Seeing today is the Mid-Autumn, will you be kind enough to bring these mooncakes to my son far away at Malacca?
Objective: Bring Grandma Chen's mooncakes and look for her son Chen Zhong in Malacca
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Home Sweet Home - Wanderer's Feelings
Offer: Is this what my mother got you to bring for me from Beijing? Thanks a lot! Having been away for such a long time, I can't help but wonder if she is good shape. This is a letter that I wrote for my mother, can you please bring this to her?
Objective: Return to Beijing and hand the letter to Grandma Chen.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Home Sweet Home - Grandma Chen's Recipe
Offer: After having been away from home for such a long time it seems like my child has grown up. I wish he would return earlier, all the wealth cannot compare to the security of living with your loved ones. Thank you again kind one, I will gift you my family's Mooncake Blueprint.
Objective: Look for the Antique Collector for a chat
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Home Sweet Home - The Chen Heritage
Offer: This blueprint seems a little old, lets look for an Identifier to authenticate it.
Objective: Look for the Antique Collector for a chat

Name: New Tangyuan
Offer: Quanzhou tavern's Master Tsang would like to come up with a new kind of Tangyuan, can you help him get some of the spices that he needs?
Objective: Give to Quanzhou's Master Tsang 30 Cases of Spices

Name: The Best Trader
Offer: Congratulations on reaching level 120! After reaching level 120, the true test of your trading skills will begin where you can accept Businesses through the Voyagers Times. Completion of each business will grant you with great rewards so be sure to pay close attention to the Voyagers Times!
Objective: Take a look at the Voyagers Times!

Name: <<Rogue Pirate Ship>>
Offer: Lately, a bunch of rogue pirates have appeared at Aden Harbor. You need to go to the St. Anderlaide pirate nest to sink a Rogue Pirate Ship. Once you do, four little lifeboats will appear! Destroy the real rescue boat!
Objective: Destroy the real Escape Boat

Name: <<Traitors On Faial Island>>
Offer: This is a cursed gold coin. Break this coin on Faial Island and a group of men will appear. They are all traitors who betrayed their country. Kill them and then report back to me.
Objective: Kill the 5 traitors

Name: Teacher And Disciple
Offer: This is a time of both high risk and reward where plots and murders are common everywhere. How can a rookie survive? How can an expert pass on his beliefs?
Objective: Look for a Master and head to Athens Port Coaching Quest Guide. Seeking a Master Click on the "Master" icon on the top left and select a player from the Master column on the right and click on "Apply to be Apprentice". Note: You can have up to 5 Masters, feel free to ask them for help.

Name: Path Of Training
Offer: This is a world where only the fittest survive, going about without a plan in mind is just suicide! You need to change your mindset!
Objective: Go to Athens Port and look for Coaching Quest Guide and turn in quest.

Name: Requesting Guidance
Offer: With the land filled with experts, a rookie like you need to be be training hard and more importantly you need a master with a lot of experience. With a master you will be able to progress a lot faster than those without one. What are you waiting for? Go on and find a master now! Seeking a Master Click on the "Master" icon on the top left and select a player from the Master column on the right and click on "Apply to be Apprentice". Note: You can have up to 5 Masters, feel free to ask them for help.
Objective: After you find a master, head to Athens Port and look for Coaching Quest Guide and turn in quest. Click on the "Master" icon on the top left.

Name: Memories
Offer: When I first started out, it was really tough as I don't have a guidance of a master. I wonder if I will be much stronger than I am now if I started out with a master. With the chaos the world is in at the moment, I wonder how many talents are out there without a master to guide them.... I should stop feeling hurt, this is not my usual self.
Objective: Go to Athens Port and look for Coaching Quest Guide and turn in quest.

Name: Passing On Your Combat Skills
Offer: Having fight for my entire life, occasionally there has been a flash of tiredness. A warrior my entire life, there are times of doubt where I wonder if I should have lived my life differently.
Objective: Look for a disciple and ensure that your someone inherits your spirit of combat! Head to Athens Port when you are done and look for Coaching Quest Guide and turn in quest.

Name: <<Save Pinte>>
Offer: Rajit's brainless brother absentmindedly entered the Hurricane Island mine cave (Expert) and got captured! You have to kill Taskmaster Rowan then rescue him.
Objective: Kill Taskmaster Rowan

Name: Pirate Baroness
Offer: The rank of Count in the Kingdom's Peerage is similar to that of a Skeleton in the Pirate. There must be reasons besides personal interest for a pirate like Katarina to use such naming convention.
Objective: Enter Crete Pirates Instance, kill Pirate Baroness Katarina's Flagship and collect Pirate Baroness's Log

Name: Missing Defense Layouts
Offer: The Defense Layout of Malta has been stolen! All of the military secrets of the Maltese are written on it, should it fall into the wrong hands the result will be disastrous. As of now Hasan is the most likely suspect who has stolen it, get it back from him.
Objective: Enter Malta Instance, kill Hasan and Collect Missing Defense Layouts

Name: Zeus
Offer: Among many mythlogies Zeus has always been considered the King among Gods. Carl Emanuel who must have imagined himself to be that powerful has christened his own ship with the name Zeus. Put a stop to his daydreaming by stealing his ship's figurehead.
Objective: Enter North Sea Pirates Instance, destroy Carl Emanuel's Zeus and Collect Zeus's Figurehead

Name: Ricardo's Weather Report
Offer: As the weather plays a big part in a Sea Battle, getting Ricardo's Weather Report from Portobello Bay will prove to be of great help to our attack of the bay.
Objective: Enter Portobello Bay Instance, destroy Ricardo Reyes' Flagship, collect Ricardo's Weather Report

Name: Katarina's Drainage Survey
Offer: Understanding the drainage situation is important for a Sea Battle, getting Katarina's Drainage Survey from Portobello Bay will prove to be of great help to our attack of the bay.
Objective: Enter Portobello Bay Instance, destroy Katarina Reyes' Flagship, collect Katarina's Drainage Survey

Name: Collect Command Ship Blueprints
Offer: The pirates' Command Ship operates under strict orders which enables their army to perform at well with great combat efficiency. Obtain some information regarding this aspect and find a way to disrupt their operation.
Objective: Enter Portobello Bay, destroy Command Ship, collect Command Ship Blueprints

Name: Frigate Blueprints
Offer: The pirates' Frigate operates under strict orders which enables their army to perform at well with great combat efficiency. Obtain some information regarding this aspect and find a way to disrupt their operation.
Objective: 进入 Portobello Bay, destroy the Frigate, collect Frigate Blueprints

Name: Destroyer Blueprints
Offer: The pirates' Destroyer operates under strict orders which enables their army to perform at well with great combat efficiency. Obtain some information regarding this aspect and find a way to disrupt their operation.
Objective: Enter Portobello BayE, destroy Destroyer, collect Destroyer Blueprints

Name: Wanted: Hurricane Island Puppet Captain
Offer: The Golden Pirates have occupied Hurricane Island for many years, destroy the pirates out at sea and open the door to Hurricane Island.
Objective: Kill a Puppet Ship Captain from Hurricane Island

Name: Wanted: Atlantic Jackal Ship Captain
TargetName: Jackal Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)
Offer: As soon as night falls the pirates begin to smuggle essential goods, affecting the trade of lawful merchants. Kill a Jackal Smuggling Ship Captain.
Objective: Kill a Jackal Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)

Targets.Name: Jackal Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)

Name: Wanted: Altantic Falcon Ship Captain
TargetName: Falcon Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)
Offer: As soon as night falls the pirates begin to smuggle essential goods, affecting the trade of lawful merchants. Kill a Falcon Smuggling Ship Captain.
Objective: Kill a Falcon Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)

Name: Wanted: Atlantic Tiger Ship Captain
TargetName: Tiger Ship Smuggling Captain (Outskirts of Crete)
Offer: As soon as night falls the pirates begin to smuggle essential goods, affecting the trade of lawful merchants. Kill a Tiger Smuggling Ship Captain.
Objective: Kill a Tiger Ship Smuggling Captain (Outskirts of Crete)

Name: Wanted: Atlantic Skeleton Ship Captain
TargetName: Skeleton Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)
Offer: As soon as night falls the pirates begin to smuggle essential goods, affecting the trade of lawful merchants. Kill a Skeleton Smuggling Ship Captain.
Objective: Kill a Skeleton Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)

Name: Wanted: Atlantic Devil Ship Captain
TargetName: Devil Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)
Offer: As soon as night falls the pirates begin to smuggle essential goods, affecting the trade of lawful merchants. Kill a Devil Smuggling Ship Captain.
Objective: Kill a Devil Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)

Name: Wanted: Atlantic Hades Ship Captain
TargetName: Hades Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)
Offer: As soon as night falls the pirates begin to smuggle essential goods, affecting the trade of lawful merchants. Kill a Hades Smuggling Ship Captain.
Objective: Kill a Hades Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)

Targets.Name: Hades Smuggling Ship Captain (Outskirts of Crete)

Name: Scholar's Brush
Offer: With the Spring Festival drawing near, the pasting of Couplets is an intergral part of the festival that is not to be missed. The people were hoping that this year's Top Scholar could write out the Bottom Couplets but without his brush there was nothing he can do about it. Recently at the Beijing outskirts, Fresh Bamboo have been spotted growing Bamboo Piece would make a good material for creating the brush. Cut down some bamboo and hand them to Top Scholar.
Objective: Cut a Fresh Bamboo and get a Bamboo Piece and pass it to Top Scholar

Name: Gifting of Red Packets
Offer: The annual Spring Festival is approaching, the elder will be giving out Gift Money wrapped in Rose Paper as a form of blessing to the young. Almost all of the Rose Paper in Beijing City have been stolen by the Mini Nian Beast You should know what to do. Remember to place money in the Red Packet, it would be rude to give just an empty packet isn't it?
Objective: Hunt the Mini Nian Beast for Rose Paper and 1000k Silver Coin and give them to Liu Mingcai

Name: Paper Cuttings
Offer: During the Spring period every household will put up Paper Cuttings. Despite it's exquisite details, the materials and tools used to create the Paper Cuttings are extremely simple but currently only a small number of people possess the skill to create Paper Cuttings exist. It is said that Grandma Chen living in Zhigu is one of them. Bring Grandma Lee the Rose Papers required and Grandma Chen will gladly create those elegant Paper Cuttings for you.
Objective: Hunt the Mini Nian Beast for Rose Paper and give them to Grandma Chen

Name: New Year Fireworks
Offer: Hey? You can have these Fireworks for your own amusement. Don't be shy, the New Year is about enjoying ourselves. Do remember that you can only launch them after the event has began though. Stay safe!
Objective: Get 3 New Year Fireworks

Name: Envoy's Challenge (1)
Offer: This is so frustrating, the market has sold out of berries, how can you have for dessert without berries?
Objective: Defeat the outlaws who have taken over the berries at the outskirts of Barcelona and bring them back to the Valentine's Day Envoy.

Name: Envoy's Challenge (2)
Offer: I can never thank you enough for all your help! I can't imagine a dinner without berries! I still require some barrels of Rum, would you kindly go get some for me from the Exchange? (Sold in Hamburg)
Objective: Go to the Hamburg Exchange and buy 5 barrels of Rum and give them to Seville Port's Valentine's Day Envoy.

Name: Envoy's Challenge (3)
Offer: In the past, before a local girl's wedding her parents will gift her with a Jade Streamer as their blessing. However, this sort of jade and other gems have been pillaged completely by the devil Lance living on Hurricane Island. There has also been gossips of him coming over to attack the local girls during Valentine's Day. Captain can you help us with this situation?
Objective: To kill Lizard man Lens in the Hurricane island lizard cave,Then go to find Valentine's Day Envoy.

Name: Envoy's Challenge (4)
Offer: It's another Valentine's Day! In order to deal with the increasingly rampant pirates, the Zhigu Officials have issued an order that prevents any ship setting sail. Many of the foreign merchants who wish to return to their loved ones are now stuck here. Rumor has it that the pirates have been spotted near the outskirts of Semarang and should someone manage to defeat them, the officials might let the merchants home.
Objective: Go to the deeper part of Semarang outskirts and kill 20 Ryukyu Pirates. After you're done report back to Seville Port's Valentine's Day Envoy.

Name: Envoy's Challenge (5)
Offer: Thanks a lot! I have received news of you defeating the pirates. The other thing that has been troubling me is that recently during a battle with the Eyam Partiarch my family's heirloom weapon has been damaged.
Objective: Kill a (Normal) Eyam Patriarch*1 and Ghoul Pioneer*5 at the King's Tomb. After you're done report back to Seville Port's Valentine's Day Envoy.

Name: Collecting Sacrifices
Offer: Tomb Guardian\: "I received orders to guide you along in this ritual of the Emperor's. Here is the list of sacrifices you will need, my thanks."
Objective: Go to Beijing Tavern Assistant and collect the White Horse, Go to Zhigu Tavern Assistant and collect the White Cow, Go to Quanzhou Tavern Assistant and collect the White Goat (This quest can only be accepted once!)
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Delicious Dumplings
Offer: The Guardians of the Golden Tower have these tasty Fruit Dumplings that restore your health! If you manage to get them and don't want them, trade them with me!
Objective: Collect 20 Fruit Dumplings dropped by the guards in the Golden Tower.

Name: Delicious Dumplings II
Offer: The Guardians of the Golden Tower have these tasty Fruit Dumplings that restore your health! If you manage to get them and don't want them, trade them with me!
Objective: Collect 50 Fruit Dumplings dropped by the guards in the Golden Tower.

Name: Delicious Dumplings III
Offer: The Guardians of the Golden Tower have these tasty Fruit Dumplings that restore your health! If you manage to get them and don't want them, trade them with me!
Objective: Collect 100 Fruit Dumplings dropped by the guards in the Golden Tower.

Name: Kratos' initial test
Offer: Learning martial arts is not something that can be done in a day and requires a lot of willpower. To test our sincerity, we were asked to go to a mine at the Athens outskirts to gather some mineral that are required to craft weapons.
Objective: Go to Athens City's Skill Tutor to learn the Mining Skill (at least Ore Study Level 1), at Blacksmith and after purchasing a Pickaxe and equipping it Athens outskirts's local Mine Collect 10 Impure Minerals and give them to Kratos

Name: Glaucus' First Trial
Offer: Fishing is a basic skill that allows you to survive on the open sea. Even though it might be a simple task, Glaucus would want us to focus all of our efforts into completing it.
Objective: Go to Athen City's Skill Master to learn the Fishing Skill (At least Level 3 Fishing), at Athens Port Shipyard Boss after buying and equipping the Inferior Fishing net, enter Athens Offshore and catch 10 Tunny and 3 Sardine and look for Glaucus to report to him
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Labyrinth Treasure Hunting
Offer: Do you know that Europe is filled with legends of pirates and their treasures? Many are making a living as pirates since the discovery of a treasure makes them rich overnight! You need more training in this aspect!
Objective: Go to Kratos and speak with him.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: High Sea Treasure Hunting
Offer: Treasure can be found not just on land but under the sea too where the treasure of sunk ships remain. I should give you a chance to try your luck.
Objective: Go to Glaucus and speak to him
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Exploration of Horse Island
Offer: Since a long time ago, when Madagascar had first begun to drift apart from the African continent, some ancient flora and fauna had survived on the island, and evolved over time. Now, with the rediscovery of this island, these unique species are like no other in the world.
Objective: Head to Madagascar,and enter Madagascar Instance and kill the Caveman Chieftain. Once you're done look for Madagascar's Sarta

Name: Silk Road of the Sea (1)
Offer: The Silk Road of the Sea was formed largely because travelling by sea was largely easier and faster, thus prompting maritime development. Additionally, the land route was susceptible to influence by landforms and covered large expanses of inhabitable area, whereas the monsoon winds of Autumn and Winter were favorable for sailing, thus making the sea route much more preferred. As such, this route was made much more popular due to the traders' exchanges and conversation between Southeast China inhabitants.
Objective: At Aden Port go to Aden Port Trader and buy 2 cases of Spice and at Bombay Port go to Bombay Port Trader and buy a Chest of Ivory at Toulon Port go to Toulon Trader and buy a Bag of Aloe At Kabulari of Quanzhou, the Silk Road of the Sea, Old Trade fleets from the Pacific Ocean, South Pacific and Indian Ocean join the countries of the Mediterranean Sea the Sea Trade Route

Wir sind seit jeher für die Versorgung mit Getreide, Obst und Gemüse verantwortlich.Räuber des holländischen Schiffes Leblanc haben unser Dorf überfallen. Hinweis: Gildenmitglieder können durch abschließen dieser Aufgabe Gildenvitalität erhalten (je mehr Leute, desto höher der Bonus) Informationen zu Vitalität: Untere Rechte Ecke - Interaktion - Gilde - Gilde - Gildenvorteile anzeigen

Name: Incarnation of Neptune
Offer: Glaucus, known as "Incarnation of Neptune", had been in the Navy and had a great sense of foresight. He led a fleet that terrified countless pirates. In order to find a breakthrough in naval warfare, I must find him and ask him for advice.
Objective: Go to the Barcelona city and ask Glaucus for tips on naval warfare.

Name: Glaucus's first trial
Offer: Fishing is the basic skill to start a career at sea, and although it is too easy for me, whatever Glaucus orders is worth my best effort.
Objective: Go to Skill Tutor to learn the Fishing skill in Athens city. After purchasing and equips Inferior Fishing Net from Shipyard Boss at Athens port, Enter Athens offshore and catch 10 Tunny and 3 Sardine, then talk to Glaucus.

Name: Treasure hunt on the highsea
