Name: Ship Merchant Maihiwa
Offer: Maihiwa is a famous Ship Merchant in England. He seems to be in dire straits recently. He invited us to talk.
Objective: Go to Downtown London and talk to Maihiwa

Name: Roses Are Blue?
Offer: Maihiwa: Ha! You're back! It's been a long time since you came here to Renovate a ship! The Dutch Company is assembling a fleet. They need a lot of ships. I was going to make a small fortune, but the English Queen put a restraint on exports. I heard you were close with the Queen's Handmaiden - Jone. Can you help me ask a favor. Give her this rare blue rose. I'm sure she'll like it.
Objective: Give the rare blue rose to Jone
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Powerless
Offer: Jone: Hello. Thank you for the flower! But this is a heavy matter. The Queen sees it as greatly important. It's not something a handmaiden like me has any say in. I can possibly help you get a chance to meet the Queen, though. A band of unusual pirates appeared in the outskirts of London. Get rid of them and the Queen will meet with you.
Objective: Go to the London outskirts and clear out the Viking Pirate Axemen. Then report to the Queen
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Hidden Agenda
Offer: Queen: Welcome! My handmaiden has already informed me of your reason for coming. Our nation is not on good terms with the Dutch. Wars often break out, as you must you. But Maihiwa, that profiteer, just wants to make money. Not punishing him is already tolerant enough. Don't worry about him. I have something to ask of you. Go find James.Tiago. He has some things to tell you.
Objective: Go to the London Dock and look for James.Tiago
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Tavern Banter
Offer: Tavern Boss: You look a little down in the dumps. This cup is on the house! There's an easterner that wants to talk with you.
Objective: Talk with He Bin in the Tavern.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Favor For Information
Offer: He Bin: Hello! I am He Bin. I'm sure you've already noticed I am from the Far East. I've taken notice of you, ever since the first time you came to Amsterdam. I think we are after the same thing. It's not easy getting info on the Dutch Company, but it looks like they aren't as on guard around easterners. That's why I was successful. I can share some information with you, but I hope you can help me out with something. When you have time, help some people in Bombay. I need to continue collecting information about the Dutch Company.
Objective: Go to the London Dock and give the information to James.Tiago
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Interception
Offer: Akbar: You must be He Bin's warrior? This situation here is bad. The invaders harmed so many of our people already, and more are coming. We must stop them.
Objective: Sink a ship on the way to attack Holland in the open waters around Bombay. Report to Akbar.

Name: General William
Offer: Akbar: Thanks for your help. We've temporarily cut off their forces. We have to seize this chance to deal with the enemies ashore. Go find General William. He'll give you more information.
Objective: Talk with General William.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Striking Back
Offer: General William: Honestly, I didn't really trust you foreigners, until you prevented those ships from coming ashore. I think the final battle will take place on land. Let's give those Dutch invaders the strict punishment they deserve!
Objective: Kill 10 Dutch Raiders and report to General William

Name: Their Weapons
Offer: General William: Me and my people are totally convinced of your valor, but we aren't like you. The Dutch equipment is hundreds of years more advanced than ours. We hope to be able to resist by ourselves. I hope you can help us out with that.
Objective: Collect 5 weapons from Dutch Raiders and report to General William

Name: Predator
Offer: General William: The Dutch brought more than war and destruction. They brought hunting dogs. The dogs are as vicious as their masters. They kill our livestock and attack our people.
Objective: Kill 5 Dutch Hounds and report to General William

Name: Letter from Afar
Offer: Thank you for your hard work recently. We have the power now to resist foreign invaders. You have won our friendship. You are always welcome here, friend. Our friend got a letter. I hope you can take a look.
Objective: Talk with General William, and get He Bin's letter.

Name: Farther East
Offer: I already knew about your deeds in India. Really admirable. But these are not happy times. The Dutch company just passes by India. Their real target is further Easter. Our country. They actually already made it there. This cannot wait. You must go now.
Objective: Go to Quanzhou and talk with General Zheng
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: It's All Good
Offer: Ha ha! Why didn't you take it out earlier? I've been friends with He Bin for years. I got his letter a few days ago and knew someone would come to help. I'm just not sure who it is. Otherwise why did you think you could leave her in peace?
Objective: Give the translated letter to General Zheng
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: New Request
Offer: We need a battleship that can carry troops and do battle, but we don't have enough time to design one. He Bin says you're familiar with Europe. Maybe you can think of something.
Objective: Talk with Kabulari and have him take you to London to look for Maihiwa and ask about the new battleship.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
Offer: A new battleship? To carry troops and do battle? General Zheng has high requirements. It's good you found me. The plan is here. I'll give you 20% off, how's that?
Objective: Collect 8000000 Silver and buy the new ship plan from Maihiwa. Have James.Tiago help you get to Quanzhou and give it to General Zheng

Name: Weather Report
Offer: I need to confirm the time to embark. The few ships I sent out before encountered a typhoon and had to turn back. There people here have a better understanding of costal weather. Go ask them.
Objective: Ask the Zhen Village Girl about the weather.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: New Intelligence
Offer: Did General Zheng send you? Tell the general that the best time to set sail during this season is between 9 - 11 in the morning. Also, while fishing near Yizhou, my father discovered that the Dutch are building defenses near the Yizhou coast. They might be for threatening General Zheng. Please remind General Zheng.
Objective: Give report to General Zheng
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Clearing a Path
Offer: The intelligence you collected is very important to our army. The defenses on the other side really are trouble. I have to first send you to strike the enemies on the other side of the coast. Clear out those fortifications for us.
Objective: Kill 10 Dutch Cannoneers in Inland Taiwan and report to General Zheng in Inland Yizhou.

Name: Landfall
Offer: Thanks to your hard work, our entire army has already made it to land. It's ours now. Let me handle the next battles. Good news! He Bin has returned. Go say hello!
Objective: Talk with He Bin (Inland Yizhou) in Taiwan
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: On Track
Offer: This assassin has Sun Changqing's approximate whereabouts on him. Looks like the enemy has already begun. I must find him before the enemy.
Objective: Talk with Sun Changqing (Inland Yizhou)

Name: Breakout
Offer: I cannot endure these disgraces any longer. There will be troops from court sent to rescue this place. It's a great chance for revenge. I will not give up. Can you help me escape this place and give the referral to the Ming general?
Objective: Kill 5 Triad Searchers and report to He Bin (Inland Yizhou)

Name: A Referral
Offer: Great! You finally brought him back safely. General Zheng needs you. Take my referral and go report.
Objective: Talk with General Zheng (Inland Yizhou)
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Impending Battle
Offer: Mr. He always knows what I want. His suggestion to send out troops towards the rear mountains was great. But I don't have any extra troops for you. You have to form a troop yourself. I can provide some help with weapons and equipment.
Objective: Talk with General Zheng (Inland Yizhou)

Name: Mazu Portrait
Offer: Mazu is the historic goddess of sailors, seamen, merchants, and fishermen. In ancient times, sailors would often die from heavy winds and waves. The safety of the crew became a major problem among sailors, so they put their hopes on the protection of gods. Before setting sail, they would offer sacrifice and pray for protection and safety. A Celestial god was also set up aboard.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Triad Followers. Collect 1x Mazu Portrait, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Town God Portrait
Offer: The Town God is called Granpa Town God in some places. He is the local official of the Underworld. His rank is similar to the mayor of the mortal world. The Town God grows along with the development of the town. The Town God came from ancient sacrifices and became a local protector.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Dutch Soldiers. Collect 1x Town God Portrait, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Pas-ta'ai Headwear
Offer: Pas-ta'ai is the main ritual of the Saisiyat people. It is carried out every other year after one third of the upland rice has been harvested. It occupies a place of supreme importance to the Saisiyat People. There are very important elements from other ethnicities. It is a ceremony that places the Short People of another ethnicity as the focus.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Triad Guards. Collect 1x Pas-ta'ai, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Tsou People Hide Hat
Offer: The Tsou people widely use animal hide, which can be seen from the unique craftsmanship of their attire. Most hides come from Muntiacus reevesi, mountain goats, and deer to make shirts, sleeveless shirts, shawls, boots, and leggings. They also use animal hide to make headwear. A small hole is left in the crown to tie a pheasant tail feather. The headwear symbolizes: 1. a sign of maturity; 2. responsibility and willpower
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Triad Cadres. Collect 1x Tsou people Hide Hats, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Bunun Arrow
Offer: The Bunun people have a "Malahodaigian" ritual every April (also known as the "shooting the ear"). The men of the village view a boy's ability to shoot an arrow through an animal's ear as a sign that the child will grow up to be a great warrior. They pray for good hunting in the coming year and for safety. Girls cannot take part of witness the ear shooting ritual. There is another rite after the Malahodaigian ritual, followed by the Malastapan.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Altered Yaru Bears and Bear Kings. Collect 1x Bunun Arrow and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Chamilia Beads
Offer: Chamilia Beads are important ornaments for the Rukai people. The Ancestor Urn is their important vessel. But Rukai People cannot make the Chamilia Beads or Urns. These items have been passed down for generations by their ancestors and are very important.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Vice Admiral Guards and Dutch Hounds. Collect 1x Chamilia Beads, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Sika Deer Skin
Offer: The Sika Deer was once prominent across Taiwan in the 17th century. Their skin was sold to Japan and other counties, so over hunting drove them to the brink of extinction.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Advanced Dutch Cannoneers. Collect 1x Sika Deer Hide, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Eternal Flame
Offer: Due to the commonly practiced Antaisui custom, many people will go to the temple according to their Zodiac and implore the Antaisui god. They also set up an Eternal Flame. A ceremony is held at the temple to pray for good fortune.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Camp Guards. Collect 1x Eternal Flame, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Puppet
Offer: Hand puppets are also known as "Scene Plays," "Flower Shows," and "Palm Center Shows". It's a kind of puppet show. Zhangzhou hand puppet shows are a kind of comprehensive art that includes wooden puppet performances, plays, music, wooden puppet production, costumes, props, and scene creation. Puppet shows embody the specialties of many kinds of arts.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill Boardwalk Guards. Collect 1x Puppet, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Cherry Salmon
Offer: Generally known as the Cherry Salmon or Masu Salmon, it is also called the Oncorhynchus masou, Taiwanese Trout, or Bunban. It is the only temperate fish found in the subtropical region of Taiwan. It is a special Taiwanese subspecies of fish. Due to its rarity and unique habits, the Cherry Salmon is now on the brink of extinction. Some want to call it the "National Treasure Fish" of Taiwan.
Objective: Enter the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance and kill the Shaman Leader or Shaman. Collect 1x Cherry Salmon, and give it to the Yizhou Cultural Exploration Officer on inland Taiwan

Name: Take the Stronghold
Offer: The Dutch and their flunkies have occupied the village at the bottom of the mountain. That's the only path to the Boardwalk. They have a positional advantage now. To avenge our fallen comrades, we must make it through.
Objective: Kill Imam Chen Sihua and Inspector Torrence on the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance.

Name: Kill the Enemy
Offer: Chen Simiao, he killed my father, sold out the Soul Puppet. He's the cult leader and the a lackey of the Dutch. His many identities are exceeded only by the number of his crimes. I cannot fully express my hatred of him! I have to kill him!
Objective: Kill Imam Chen Simiao on the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance.

Name: Take out the Criminal
Offer: There is a Dutch Lieutenant Colonel called William. He has many troops at his disposal. He killed many of my people during the invasion of Yizhou. To avoid the Ming Army, he hid in a fort on the mountain and waited for reinforcements. He must pay the price.
Objective: Kill Colonel Williams on the Yizhou Boardwalk Instance.

Name: Rare Treasure
Offer: General Zheng: The Garnet is a very rare treasure. It can modify equipment. After modification, equipment can have a new attribute - Dexterity. It also greatly increases power. I will tell you how to use it soon.
Objective: Talk with General Zheng (Inland Yizhou) and study how to use Garnets.

Name: Eastern Smelt
Offer: General Zheng: Your performance on the battlefield was commendable, but your weapon isn't up to your standards. He Bin told me that the Western Forge Master requires a lot of materials for one forging that greatly changes equipment, but that won't do for what we need. We have a method of upgrading equipment that doesn't take many resources. You will need to go to the Equipment Upgrade Master to perform final modifications. I can teach you this method.
Objective: Talk with General Zheng (Inland Yizhou) and study how to use upgrade equipment.

Name: JiXiaoXinShu
Offer: Qi Jiguang's summary of training and managing troops during the war.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a JiXiaoXinShu, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: MaShang Zuo
Offer: Delivering the North-South Military affairs,Enjoying the scenery all over the world,For most of the year,always living in the Battlefield.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a MaShang Zuo, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: Daming Law
Offer: An epoch-making code in the history of China's legal system.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a Daming Law, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: Zheng He Voyage Chart
Offer: Zheng He's voyage route map that Dutch Army found in Yizhou.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a Zheng He Voyage Chart, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: Study on the Marine Guards formation
Offer: Research on formation of Japanese frigate in protecting main ship at sea.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a Study on the Marine Guards formation, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: Small Flagship Practice Plan
Offer: A plan to reduce cost to create a flagship function
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a Small Flagship Practice Plan, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: Mine Research Plan
Offer: The Study on Japanese army's enhancing mine damage and sustained explosion proposal
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a Mine Research Plan, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: Antiaircraft Gun Research Plan
Offer: A research plan for the Japanese army to improve the target of long distance strike
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect an Antiaircraft Gun Research Plan, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: Japanese Torpedo Research Plan
Offer: Torpedo research plan for Japanese Navy to accurately target targets
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a Japanese Torpedo Research Plan, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: Mechanical Hook Technology
Offer: A material technology for strengthening the strength of Mechanical hook
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy, collect a Mechanical Hook Technology, and give it to the JiaWu Cultural Exploration Officer in ZhiGu.

Name: The war began suddenly
Offer: When the JiaWu war broke out, the war on the East China Sea fell and the situation was serious. We need your support urgently.
Objective: Talk to Zhujing in ZhiGu.

Name: Kill the Biry Warship
Offer: The captain of the Biry Warship is the intelligence chief of the Japanese pirates. He is very cunning but very timid. Capturing him will help the Ming army's next strategic plan.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy and sank Biry Warship, then talk to Zhujing.

Name: Kill the ChiCheng Warship
Offer: The captain of the ChiCheng Warship did not have such a good deal as Shidan. Defeating him can further open the march of the Ming army.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy and sank ChiCheng Warship, then talk to Zhujing.

Name: Kill the Westward Warship
Offer: The Westward Warship is the main warship of the Japanese pirates. The combatants on the ship are the elite of the Japanese pirates.We muse be careful.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy and sank Westward Warship, then talk to Zhujing.

Name: Kill the Songdo Warship
Offer: The Songdo Warship is the flagship of the Japanese pirates which with heavy armor and the most violent artillery fire.Only by defeating him can we win.
Objective: Enter the JiaWu Bay copy and sank Songdo Warship, then talk to Zhujing.

Name: Mourning the national heroes
Offer: Guard Wang is an old soldier who has been in the army for decades. During the Qingming Festival, Guard Wang would pay a sacrifice to his good friends who were killed in the war. Give him a pot of wine.
Objective: Buy 1 Yellow Wine and bring it to Guard Wang in the Beijing Suburb.

Name: A fluttering flag
Offer: The Mysterious Tailor:With my hand made tailoring skills, I can sew up a banner of great flag for you, just give me the materials you need.
Objective: Collect 1 Cotton Fabric and 1 Linen, hand it to the Mysterious Tailor

Name: War Flag?
Offer: Is this the flag? Take him down!
Objective: Talk to The Mysterious Tailor

Name: Bring Down Despotism
Offer: 14th July is French National Holiday, the same day on 1789, citizens of Paris brought down Bastille, the sign of Despotism.
Objective: Beat the guards of Monarch, and get National Badge and get it to Jacque.

Name: Yeast
Offer: east is the most important ingredient for brewing beer, but the pirates robbed all my yeast! I can not lose it! Please help me to get it back!
Objective: Beat the North European Pirates outside of the city, and return the yeast to Beer Festival Officer.

Name: The Mystery
Offer: I heard something strange happened in Tianjin Province. Find the Inspector in Tianjin Province if you wish to learn more about the situation.
Objective: Go to Tianjin and talk to the Zhigu Inspector.

Name: The Interrogation
Offer: Priest Ma excels in pharmacology and has cured many complicated diseases. He might have a cure for memory loss. Go ask him.
Objective: Go to Beijing and talk to Priest Ma.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Silent Grass
Offer: Upon learning that someone has memory loss, Priest Ma had me go to the Beijing Mausoleum to search for a rare herb, Silent Grass, which has healing properties. It is rumored to be heavily guarded by Guard Hu of the Beijing Mausoleum, which makes it hard for outsiders to obtain.
Objective: Go to the Beijing Mausoleum and kill Mausoleum Guards to get Silent Grass. Bring one back to Beijing and talk to Priest Ma.

Name: Catalyst
Offer: The medicine is ready, but to further bring out the properties of the Silent Grass, you need Lingzhi as a catalyst when taking it. I heard it grows in some hidden places on Taiwan. In order to restore the poor man's mind, let's pick some as soon as possible.
Objective: Go to Taiwan Island to collect 1 Lingzhi. After that, go to the Beijing Outskirts to talk to the Middle-Aged Man.

Name: An Act of Justice
Offer: After taking the medicine, the Middle-Aged Man gradually regained his memory, and remembered why he lost his memory in the first place. His family amulet was been stolen by nearby thieves. These thieves have been running rampant for a while now. I've wanted to teach them a lesson for a long time, and I shall do so today.
Objective: Kill the Bandits on the Beijing Outskirts to reclaim the Middle-Aged Man's amulet. After that, report back to the Middle-Aged Man.

Name: Making Offerings
Offer: Instead of being happy, the Middle-Aged Man felt even sadder when he regained the amulet. The Middle-Aged Man said he was worried about the safety of his people and wanted to make sacrifices and pray for the rest of the clan to escape safely. He wanted me to collect some meat for him.
Objective: Help the Middle-Aged Man by going to Toulon to gather 3 pieces of Pork. After that, go to the Beijing Outskirts and report to the Middle-Aged Man.

Name: Mystery of the Religious Group
Offer: The Middle-Aged Man's past has something to do with the Catholics. The doctrines of Catholicism don't seem to be evil, and may have been misused by those with ill intentions. A group of missionaries recently arrived to investigate these people. I must investigate if this collusion is real or not.
Objective: Defeat the Catholic Missionary on the Beijing Outskirts to obtain 1 Intel on the Japanese Pirates. Go to Tianjin and report to Zhigu Inspector.

Name: Catholic Followers
Offer: I did not expect the Japanese Pirates to expand their power under the guise of Catholicism. No wonder they've been more arrogant recently. Sentinel warships have been sighted in the vicinity of Zhigu Port. The Tianjin Inspector asked me to disrupt their plan.
Objective: Conceal yourself at Zhigu Port (Open Sea) and destroy 1 Japanese Pirates' Sentinel Battleship. Return to the Beijing Outskirts and talk to the Middle-Aged Man.

Name: The Bandit Chief
Offer: Something terrible happened to the Middle-Aged Man. He is injured and unable to move. I have to keep investigating. I will raid the Bandit Chief's den.
Objective: Defeat the Bandit Chief on the Beijing Outskirts and report back to the Middle-Aged Man.

Name: Edo Investigation
Offer: The Middle-Aged Man saw me easily defeat the thieves and was impressed with my strength. He gave me his family amulet, hoping I could find and rescue his people. Since the person behind the abduction of the Middle-Aged Man's family is somehow related to the Japanese Pirates, I shall go to Edo to investigate. I will go to a tavern as they are best places to seek intel!
Objective: Go to Edo and talk to the Edo Tavern's Boss.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Restock
Offer: Traders rarely visit Edo nowadays, which has caused a serious shortage at the tavern. The tavern owner didn't tell me this until he asked me to help him transport some goods.
Objective: Go to Seoul and purchase 5 crates of Kimchi. Pass them to Edo's Tavern's Boss.

Name: Arrow of Death
Offer: Purchase 2 Jars of Rice Wine in Edo and talk to the Edo Inspector.
Objective: Purchase 2 Jars of Rice Wine in Edo and talk to the Edo Inspector.

Name: Provender Purchase
Offer: Upon learning of the Lee clan's situation, His Majesty agreed to delay the attack, and prioritize food distribution. I am grateful for His Majesty's decision, and quickly agree to His Majesty's request that I deliver rations to the troops. I will settle this quickly then save the Lee clan.
Objective: Go to Toulon to buy 5 crates of Pork 5. Go to Edo to buy 5 portions of Vegetables and hand them to the Military Department Officer in Beijing.

Name: Eliminating the Japanese Pirates
Offer: The Japanese Pirates have blockaded Quanzhou. I need to obtain intelligence, but the Ming Navy will soon attempt to break the blockade. I have no way of asking His Majesty to hold off the attack.
Objective: Go to Quanzhou Port near the open seas and defeat 1 Japanese Pirate Wolf Fang Ship to obtain the intelligence manual detailing the Japanese Pirates' plans in the sea. Give the manual to the Military Department Officer in Beijing.

Name: Bounty
Offer: Murakami Moritsuna is enraged, and has offered a huge reward for catching the murderer. The reward doesn't really matter to me, and I will investigate regardless. He says there are some strange people hiding in the general's house.
Objective: Go to the Edo General's Residence and defeat 5 Mysterious Intruders. Then, go to Edo and talk to Murakami Moritzuna.

Name: The Missing Teen
Offer: I didn't get much information from the Mysterious Intruders, but Murakami says something has happened in Nagasaki. A group of Wanderers kidnapped the tavern owner's son. Could they be working for the traitors? Just how powerful are they?
Objective: Go to the Nagasaki Outskirts and defeat 3 Poor Wanderers. Return to Nagasaki and talk to the Tavern's Boss.

Name: Venomous Frog
Offer: After rescuing the tavern owner's son, I discovered he was poisoned by frogs. Can the legs of toxic frogs cure frog poison? It's a strange remedy, but I don't have another option. I will trust the local doctor and find some frog limbs. I don't have much time, and a life is at stake.
Objective: Go to the Nagasaki Outskirts and defeat the Venomous Frog. Obtain 1 Frog Leg and then return to Nagasaki and talk to the Nagasaki Tavern's Boss.

Name: What's Next
Offer: The tavern owner's son is out of danger. The tavern owner persuaded Mitsuetsu Hattori to find me. Does he know something? Is he a friend or foe? I must see for myself.
Objective: Go to Nagasaki and talk to Hattori Mitsuetsu.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Proof of Loyalty
Offer: Mitsuetsu Hattori asked me to kill the Mysterious Samurai in the outskirts. Hattori is not with the traitors or the Mysterious Samurai. There are too many groups of unknown origin. Is there a mastermind behind all of this?
Objective: Go to the Nagasaki Outskirts and kill 3 Mysterious Samurai and in Nagasaki. After that, talk to Hattori Mitsuetsu.

Name: Poisoned Minds
Offer: Mitsuetsu Hattori said these samurai were brainwashed by Catholic fanatics. The mastermind must be the leader of the Catholics here. This bastard used Catholicism to deceive people. I don't care what his plans are, he must stopped.
Objective: Go to the Nagasaki Outskirts and kill 3 Catholic Fanatics. After that, go to Nagasaki and talk to Hattori Mitsuetsu.

Name: Master of Intel
Offer: After killing the Catholic fanatics, Mitsuetsu Hattori has complete trust in me. He knows I've been investigating, and has asked me to go to the Intel Master Sumi Kurokawa, but only after preparing gifts for the greedy Dutch people. I have no idea why the people here are all like this.
Objective: Go to the Nagasaki Outskirts and kill the Greedy Dutchmen. After getting the antique, go to Nagasaki and talk to Sumi Kurokawa.

Name: Gifts for Info
Offer: After Sumi Kurokawa accepts my presents, he has the nerve to ask me for some Tea Leaves from Quanzhou. How greedy. Greedier than those Dutchmen, I think. I have no choice but to tolerate this for the sake of intel. If he can't give me anything concrete after doing so much for him, I'll make sure he pays.
Objective: Go to Quanzhou and purchase 3 portions of Tea Leaves and then talk to Sumi Kurokawa.

Name: Endless Torment
Offer: Sumi Kurokawa is not satisfied with the Tea Leaves. He wants me to get some Bear Paws for him from the outskirts. And he has the guts to call it an act for public good! When will I be done with him? This guy's greed knows no bounds! Bear Paws from the outskirts? That's easy for him to say. This is the last time, and if he doesn't tell me something useful, things will get ugly.
Objective: Go to the Nagasaki Outskirts to kill Plump Bears. After getting 2 Bear Paws, talk to Kurokuwa Sumi in Nagasaki.

RewardItems.Name: Blood Rose Fragment#*200, \LShowItem CWCL0209.ini#Serpentine Rock Fragment

Name: The Patriarch
Offer: Sumi Kurokawa has finally given me something useful. Just as I thought, the mastermind is the leader of the Catholics, and he commands a batch of masterful archers. I bet I can find something out from these archers.
Objective: Go to the Nagasaki Outskirts to kill the Idle Archers. Get a map detailing a route to the Lees' location and talk to the Patriarch on the Nagasaki Outskirts.

Name: Strong Poison
Offer: After defeating the Idle Archers, I've gotten a map that points to where the Lees are hidden. However, they are poisoned and under the control of the mastermind, acting against their will. To rescue them, an antidote to their poison must first be administered. I believe Priest Ma can concoct an antidote based on the poison sample the Patriarch gave him.
Objective: Bring the Patriarch's poison sample back to Beijing and ask Priest Ma for help.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Making the Antidote
Offer: Go to the Beijing Outskirts to gather 1 Recovery Leaf and hand it to Priest Ma in Beijing.
Objective: Go to the Beijing Outskirts to gather 1 Recovery Leaf and hand it to Priest Ma in Beijing.

Name: Potent Medicine
Offer: The antidote is ready, but Priest Ma says that we need to wrap wolfskin around the antidote. This helps preserve its medicinal properties. I can manage a few wolves by myself.
Objective: Kill the Agile Wolf on the Beijing Outskirts to get a perfect piece of Wolfskin. Bring the antidote to Nagasaki and talk to the Patriarch.

Name: The Snitch
Offer: Looks like the antidote is working. I never expected there would be traitors among the Lees. Guess we should never judge a book by its cover. Since they are willing to stand on the side of evil, I will help the Patriarch get rid of them.
Objective: Kill 3 Rebels on the Nagasaki Outskirts and talk to the Patriarch.

Name: Tokisada Masuda
Offer: So the man behind all this is Tokisada Masuda. He used to devote himself to serving the people and once led the farmers in an uprising. Nobody could've predicted he would go astray after his failed uprising. His confidante is outside, keeping the Lees under strict surveillance. I need to get rid of him first before he causes any trouble.
Objective: Kill 1 Tokisada's Confidante and report this to the Nagasaki Inspector.

Name: The Japanese Pirates' Flagship
Offer: Looks like the Nagasaki Inspector has some idea of what's going on. The ships of the Japanese Pirates have begun moving again. Since the Lees need some time to recuperate from the poison, I'll teach those arrogant pirates a lesson and inform His Majesty to prepare troops to annihilate them on a large scale.
Objective: Go to the Open Seas near the Ports of Zhigu, Seoul, Nagasaki, and Edo, and defeat 4 of Tokisada Masuda's Rogue Flagships. Report to the Emperor in Beijing.

Name: Return to Ming Dynasty
Offer: His Majesty knows of my present situation and will send troops to challenge the pirates. I imagine the Lees' poison has more or less subsided. I must fetch them quickly.
Objective: Go to the Nagasaki Outskirts where the Lees are and talk to the Patriarch.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Crush the Ambush Troops
Offer: Now that Tokisada's prized weapon is beyond his control, he will not take it lying down. He will send battleships to ambush me. Heh, let him come!
Objective: At the Open Sea near Nagasaki Port, defeat 1 of Tokisada's Ambush Battleships. Go to the Beijing Outskirts and inform the Middle-Aged ManE that his people are safe.

Name: Mend the Map
Offer: The Middle-Aged Man is delighted after knowing his people are rescued and they can meet soon. Having known I cannot piece the broken map together, he tells me he can restore the map using honey. He asks me to kill some Giant Bees nearby to obtain some Honey.
Objective: Kill Giant Bees on the Beijing Outskirts to gain 1 Honey. Then, talk to the Middle-Aged Man.

Name: The Battle of Higurashi
Offer: After the Middle-Aged Man pieces the map together, he recognizes the place on the map to be Higurashi, where the mastermind, Tokisada, lurks. To prevent him from endangering innocents, the Middle-Aged Man hopes I can visit Higurashi to investigate further and eventually defeat Tokisada Masuda.
Objective: Go to the Higurashi Instance on the Nagasaki Outskirts to kill 5 Wanderers. Enter the 2nd Floor of the Higurashi Instance - Coulee Island - to kill 5 Coulee Hounds and report to the Nagasaki Inspector at Nagasaki Port.

Name: Cold-Blooded Instructor
Offer: Aloof Rose is one of the finest archers in the Lee clan and has grown tired of the injustice suffered by her people. She believes only Tokisada Masuda can help the Lee clan gain global recognition. Thus, she became his servant, aiding him in building an army of archers.
Objective: Go to the Higurashi Instance. Kill Archer Instructor "Aloof Rose" and report to the Nagasaki Inspector.

RewardItems.Name: Crystallized Xuanwu RockE\# *1, \LShowItem DJ009218.ini#Higurashi Exploration Times

Name: Ninja Duo
Offer: Although they are famed in the ninja circle, few people have seen this pair of ninjas in real life. Legend has it that they are a male and female duo with unparalleled chemistry, and their methods are decisive and fearsome, killing with one strike. Word has it they have never failed. Nobody could have known that their master is Tokisada Masuda. If Tokisada is to be challenged, this duo stands in the way.
Objective: Go to the Higurashi Instance. Kill the Ninja Duo, “Darkness” and “Shadow”, and report to the Nagasaki Inspector.

RewardItems.Name: Crystallized Xuanwu RockE\# *1, \LShowItem DJ009218.ini#Higurashi Exploration Times

Name: Accomplice
Offer: The mysterious right-hand man of Tokisada Masuda whose duties are to oversee daily matters, manage intel, and train troops for his master. In truth, most people have only met Pin, and not Tokisada Masuda. It's common knowledge within the troops that Pin unequivocally represents their master, Tokisada. Killing Pin is akin to clipping Tokisada's wings and crippling Higurashi's operations.
Objective: Go to the Hirugashi Instance. Kill Lieutenant Pin and report to the Nagasaki Inspector.

RewardItems.Name: Crystallized Xuanwu RockE\# *1, \LShowItem DJ009218.ini#Higurashi Exploration Times

Name: ChristmasI
Offer: Santa Claus: Oh, no, my gift bag is torn, I would need some linen to fix it.
Objective: Go to Lisbon, and buy 3 linen from the Trader and give them to Santa Claus.

Name: ChristmasII
Offer: Santa Claus: After my gift bag torn, some gift are missing. I think one of them was lost in Battle Field. Please go and beat the boss find it for me.
Objective: Beat the Boss Schmitz and reply to Santa Claus.

Name: ChristmasIII
Offer: Santa Claus: After my gift bag torn, some gift are missing. I think one of them was in Portbello Bay. Help me to beat Rene.
Objective: Beat Rene and reply to Santa Claus.

Name: The Strongest Valour
Offer: Talking with Palenque Battle Explorer in the Sanctum of Memories when you finish a Palenque Battle.
Objective: Defeat one player in Palenque Battle

Name: Madeira news.
Offer: Madeira came to the news, where a group of mysterious refugees came, causing a lot of local commotion.
Objective: Talk with Leo in Madeira Port.

Name: Missing heirloom
Offer: Leo: You don't care about the refugees, my ancestral vase is missing! I can't find it. I can't eat and sleep for two days.
Objective: Find Leo's Heirloom according to the map and Talk with Leo.

Name: Discuss!
Offer: Leo: FortWinaltely, you are there. I also suspect that those refugees did it, but they have so many people, and rashly questioning may cause conflict. This matter still has to be discussed with the mayor.
Objective: Talk with Cuesmes in Madeira City.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Accept!
Offer: Cuesmes: Thank you for helping to deal with some incidents in the town. These refugees are not good at all, but for God's sake, I am willing to give them some help, allowing them to live here temporarily, as long as they no longer harass us.
Objective: Bring the Residence Permit to Mayan refugees leader.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Appreciation.
Offer: Winal: I really didn't expect you to accept us. My name is Winal. Now I am the leader of these tribes. I am sorry for the unhappiness brought by my people these days. This is something we gave you as compensation.
Objective: Bring Winal's Property to Cuesmes.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: What's this?
Offer: Cuesmes: It seems that this mysterious refugee can still communicate. Let me see what's in it, um... Gold doesn't need to come to the captain, um... you won't be interested in this gems, right?! What is this slate? Maybe it’s an incredible antique! Mr. Captain, this is yours!
Objective: Ask Leo about the origins of slate.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Mysterious slate
Offer: Leo: You are asking the right person, what strange things I have never seen before?! This slate, I don't know how those people call it, but it seems to greatly strengthen your equipment. It seems to be useful!
Objective: Ask Winal about the slate.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Blank memory
Offer: Winal: This slate is a major secret to my family, but both of me and my people are exiled. Our memories have been touched by people and cannot remember the key things. It would be great if you could help us recover our memories.
Objective: Talk with Mysterious Augur in Accra Port.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Strange herbs
Offer: Mysterious Diviner: Can modify people's memory. This should be caused by ancient witchcraft. This kind of thing does not come from our continent, or even from any civilization we know well. I can only unlock part of you. Help me collect materials.
Objective: Collect 3 Rosemary and 3 Holy light leaves and bring them to Mysterious Augur in Accra Port.

Name: Antidote with unknown effect
Offer: Mysterious Diviner: Antidote is ready, send it quickly!
Objective: Bring the Antidote to Winal Winal.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Go to Maya.
Offer: Winal: This pharmacy is very effective. I feel that the fog in my mind has dissipated a lot. This sacred rubbing is a sacred object of our Maya, which can greatly enhance the equipment, and it is also used with the star soul. These are the crystallization of the wisdom of our ancestors. You want more sacred rubbings to go to Salinas to find my good friend Kara, be careful of the war there.
Objective: Talk with Kara in Salinas.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Food shortage
Offer: Kara: Did Winal sent you here? Great, this proves that they have escaped safely, but there are still a large number of people who are suffering from hunger and war. We need a lot of food now.
Objective: Collect 5 Corn and 5 Rum and bring them to Kara.

Name: Harassment
Offer: Kara: With these foods, my people can survive this time, but there are many small wild people in the jungle who will harass us from time to time.
Objective: Find and defeat the violent tiny savage according to the map and talk with Kara

Name: Power is the most important
Offer: Kara:If you want more Star Runes, it's the best way to take part in the Palenque Battle.But the tribal chief will not be happy with an outsider and share a piece of it with him. But you have to understand that power is the most important thing.
Objective: Go to the Rain Forest to defeat the Maya tribe chief and talk with Kara

Name: Halloween publicity
Offer: Finally you are here,my dear captain.Halloween is coming.Please do some publicity for me.
Objective: Find the Halloween event officer and help him do some publicity.

Name: Riley's trouble
Offer: Do you know Riley in London? She is worring about the Halloween.
Objective: Go to London City and find Riley,help her solve the troubles.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Halloween Charm
Offer: Halloween is coming,but I don't have any Holloween dress.My only one was robbed by the North Europe Pirate.
Objective: Go to Hamburg Suburb and kill the Viking,bring the Halloween Charm back to Riley

Name: Begging Lehman
Offer: I already knew the punkinhead made by Uncle Lehman was very nice and cute.
Objective: Go to Oslo and find Lehman,ask him to help make the punkinhead.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Collecting materials
Offer: Captain, I need some materials to make the punkinhead, can you help me collect them?
Objective: Collect 10 Level 7 Cloth,10 Level 7 Timber and 1 Level 7 Hat flan,bring them to Lehman

Name: Lack of Candies
Offer: Good news captain, the punkinhead is almost finished,would you mind to buy some Halloween Candy for Riley? I can bring the punkinhead and candy to her when Halloween is coming.
Objective: Go to Bordeaux and find the Candy makers,buy 1 candy and bring it back to Riley

Name: Chocolate candy(1)
Offer: Aha,you got Halloween Candies for me.But I prefer the chocolate candy made by sister Hell,can you help me bring her some materials.
Objective: Go to Reykjavik and buy 3 Fruit Jam,go to Beirut and buy 5 Granulated Sugar,go to Istanbul and buy 3 Honey,go to Barcelona and buy 5 Apple. Bring them to Hell in Barcelona City.

Name: Chocolate candy(2)
Offer: We still need some very important material to make the chocolate candy,I heard Karabash in Gibraltar Straits has the precious chocolate.
Objective: Enter the Gibraltar Straits Instance and kill the Karabash's Hammerhead, get the Precious chocolate and the bring it back to Hell.

Name: Go to the Halloween party
Offer: I've made the chocolate candy,and I will bring them to Riley when Halloween is coming. Now, can you please bring back some Devil emblems by killing some ghosts in Athens Suburb? Because Riley need the tickets for te party with you.
Objective: Go to the Athens Suburb and kill the Halloween Ghost, get The Devil emblem and bring it to the Halloween event officer.

Name: Go to the Halloween party
Offer: I've made the chocolate candy,and I will bring them to Riley when Halloween is coming. Now, can you please bring back some Devil emblems by killing some ghosts in Athens Suburb? Because Riley need the tickets for te party with you.
Objective: Go to the Athens Suburb and kill the Halloween Ghost, get The Devil emblem and bring it to the Halloween event officer.

Name: Shipbuilding Manual
Offer: A manual about cutting-edge developments in ship construction painstakingly collated by renowned shipbuilders.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Shipbuilding Manual.

Name: Precision Instrument Manufacturing Blueprint
Offer: Contains introductions and detailed manufacturing instructions of some hand-made Precision Instruments.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Precision Instrument Manufacturing Blueprint.

Name: Mining Technology Blueprint
Offer: Contains technical drawings that explain how to increase mining efficiency in quarries to increase construction speed.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Mining Technology Blueprint.

Name: Suleymaniye Mosque Blueprint
Offer: A blueprint of the Ottoman-style Suleymaniye Mosque that shows the designer's vision.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Suleymaniye Mosque Blueprint.

Name: Religious Culture Research
Offer: A piece of research about the fascinatingly diverse Eastern and Western cultures and religions of the Ottoman Empire.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Religious Culture Research.

Name: Imperial Code
Offer: A legal code all citizens of the Ottoman Empire have to abide by.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Imperial Code.

Name: Large Gunboat Plan
Offer: A proposal about building large gunboats to expand sea space and territories through sea battles.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Large Gunboat Plan.

Name: Stealth Raiding Ship Plan
Offer: A proposal about modifying a ship's size and design to attain a camouflaging effect for vessels to launch stealth attacks.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Stealth Raiding Ship Plan.

Name: Mobile Weapons Research
Offer: Used for making portable and powerful weapons that could be carried by anyone.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Mobile Weapons Research.

Name: Top-Secret Reconnaissance Plan
Offer: A proposal about sending reconnaissance agents to other countries or the borders to get the latest intel and ensure border safety.
Objective: Head to the Suez Trials and collect 1 Top-Secret Reconnaissance Plan.

Name: New Intel
Offer: I heard the Suez Canal will be open for navigation soon. Let's go to Alexander and confirm this rumor.
Objective: Go to Alexander’s urban area and talk to Hussein.

Name: Drive Out the Thugs
Offer: Hussein‘s still as bitter and mean as ever. Seems like it's impossible to ask from official sources. We can only ask the workers who participated in the river's construction.
Objective: Kill the Drunk Worker at the outskirts of Alexander, and talk to the Sober Worker.

Name: Look For Clues
Offer: The workers know little about when the canal would open. The foreman may know something. Unfortunately, that unscrupulous guy absconded with the money at the end of the project, and we heard that he was robbed by some pirates and taken to Cyprus Island. Please track down the whereabouts of our hard-earned pennies.
Objective: Kill the Pirate Captain at Cyprus Island and track the whereabouts of workers' wages (kill the Pirate Captain to get the clue, and open it to complete the quest).

Name: The Missing Worker I
Offer: Two pirate vice-captains led the team to transfer a large amount of money to Crete and Corsica on the day the cunning pirates robbed the foreman. Let's help the workers by bringing the foreman back and let them settle the matter between themselves.
Objective: Go to Crete Pier to kill the Pirate Vice-Captain in the cottage, and find the Unscrupulous Foreman.

Name: The Missing Worker II
Offer: Crete's problem is solved. We got the money back from the Corsican Pirates, and the workers' wages issue is also solved. But we barely learned anything about the Suez Canal!
Objective: Go to the Corsica Pier, and kill the Pirate Vice-Captain in the cottage. Bring the wages and the Unscrupulous Foreman back to Alexander and hand them over to the Worker Representative.

Name: Ready to Start
Offer: To thank me for my help, the workers in Alexander finally provided some confidential intel about the opening of the Suez Canal. It turned out that the opening of the Suez Canal also attracted the attention of some colonists, who plan to steal the design of the canal and utilize its structure to destroy key areas of the empire for blackmail.
Objective: Go to Alexander’s urban area and talk to Hussein about the matter.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The Lost Blueprint
Offer: Hussein could only confess out of desperation. According to him, the pirates who stole the blueprints should most probably be instructed by some colonists. As it is not easy to publicize the matter for the time being, the official can only secretly hire some captains with a sense of justice to retrieve the blueprints. Maybe I can help too!
Objective: Sink the Alexander Demon Ship at the Alexander Coast to get the Secret Letter. Open it to complete the quest.

Name: Find the Blueprint
Offer: According to the letter's content, Hussein's conjecture is correct. The letter also mentioned that pirates would trade blueprints with the colonists in Sardinia.
Objective: Go to Sardinia to kill the Blueprint Robber, and return the blueprints to Hussein.

Name: Clearing the Waterway
Offer: The renovation and maintenance of the dams and lighthouses have been completed. Now we're left with the completion of the river dredging.
Objective: Go to Tripoli and ask the Route Cleanup Master to help us.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Eliminating Obstacles
Offer: Thanks to everyone, the canal renovation is going well. However, there's some bad news from the empire. Some pirate ships came to the channel (Alexander) out of nowhere and have delayed the progress of the canal's construction.
Objective: Sink a Corsican Raiding Ship (6985.85, -12894.710) and ask the Route Officer at Alexander.

Name: Incoming Trouble
Offer: The Route Officer told me that Suez is also facing the same problem. Let's go to the Suez Canal to ask for the specifics.
Objective: Speak with the Suez Route Officer.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Resolving
Offer: You came just in time, Captain. Manpower is stretched as the canal's opening draws near. I need your help to deal with those annoying pirate ships, and meet me at the canal when you're done.
Objective: Sink a St. Andrew Raiding Ship (-4997.41, 10002.02) and speak with the Route Officer's Flagship (973.15,1776.61) at the entrance of the Suez Canal.

Name: Get a Technician
Offer: Captain, you're finally here! Some of our people with a large amount of canal data were suddenly attacked by a group of pirate ships on the old Suez River. We can't let those data fall into the hands of pirates. We need to rescue and escort them back!
Objective: Go to the old Suez Canal to rescue and escort the technicians back (sink 10 Cretan Raiding Ships), and speak with the Route Officer's Flagship (973.15,1776.61) at the entrance of the Suez Canal.

Name: Rampant Pirates
Offer: You'll be honored by the Empire for your efforts, Captain! In addition, I learned from the rescued technicians that the pirates came for the canal data. This is definitely the colonists' doings. Please share my analysis and conjectures with those at Alexander, and let them take precautions as soon as possible...
Objective: Go to Alexander and share the Route Officer's opinion with Hussein.

Name: Defeat the Captain
Offer: This group of colonists is always on the move within the shadows. Now they are harassing us through some small means, which we can barely cope with. I'm afraid we'll have a hard time dealing with them if they were to turn against us in the future. We currently only have these options: Seek help from a third party and promise to make great profits or increase our manpower and become stronger to defend the country. Please pass on my suggestion to the Suez people.
Objective: Go to Suez and share Hussein's opinion with the Route Officer.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: About the Pirates
Offer: Hussein wants us to ask some nearby allies for help. I guess Hussein has something in mind! Help me invite the Aden Port's foreign affairs director over to discuss the issue of the Suez Canal.
Objective: Send the invitation to the External Lead at Aden Port.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Aid from Aden Port
Offer: Invite Mogadishu's External Lead to discuss the escorting issue of the Suez Canal.
Objective: Send the invitation to the External Lead at Mogadishu.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Mogadishu's Aid
Offer: Invite Muscat's External Lead to discuss the escorting issue of the Suez Canal.
Objective: Send the invitation to the External Lead at Muscat.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Muscat's Aid
Offer: Invite Basra's External Lead to discuss the escorting issue of the Suez Canal.
Objective: Send the invitation to the External Lead at Basra.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Return to Suez
Offer: The negotiation went well with the benefits we proposed and has achieved our goal in general. I have news that Hussein is building a naumachia on the Suez Canal. This is an invitation letter from him to you. Go and try your hand at it.
Objective: Enter the naumachia and defeat Stage 1's Boss (Lloyd Rodney's Ship). Speak with Hussein afterwards.

Name: Reply to Hussein
Offer: I've been waiting for this day! Help me invite external leads of the other countries for the Suez Canal's navigation ceremony that's happening in three days. The canal's opening marks the start of the empire's bright future, and the distance toward Europe will also be shortened!
Objective: Return to Alexander and report to Hussein.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Halloween publicity
Offer: Finally you are here,my dear captain.Halloween is coming.Please do some publicity for me.
Objective: Find the Halloween event officer and help him do some publicity.

Name: Riley's trouble
Offer: Do you know Riley in London? She is worring about the Halloween.
Objective: Go to London City and find Riley,help her solve the troubles.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Halloween Charm
Offer: Halloween is coming,but I don't have any Holloween dress.My only one was robbed by the North Europe Pirate.
Objective: Go to Hamburg Suburb and kill the Viking,bring the Halloween Charm back to Riley

Name: Begging Lehman
Offer: I already knew the punkinhead made by Uncle Lehman was very nice and cute.
Objective: Go to Oslo and find Lehman,ask him to help make the punkinhead.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Collecting materials
Offer: Captain, I need some materials to make the punkinhead, can you help me collect them?
Objective: Collect 10 Level 7 Cloth,10 Level 7 Timber and 1 Level 7 Hat flan,bring them to Lehman

Name: Lack of Candies
Offer: Good news captain, the punkinhead is almost finished,would you mind to buy some Halloween Candy for Riley? I can bring the punkinhead and candy to her when Halloween is coming.
Objective: Go to Bordeaux and find the Candy makers,buy 1 candy and bring it back to Riley

Name: Chocolate candy(1)
Offer: Aha,you got Halloween Candies for me.But I prefer the chocolate candy made by sister Hell,can you help me bring her some materials.
Objective: Go to Reykjavik and buy 3 Fruit Jam,go to Beirut and buy 5 Granulated Sugar,go to Istanbul and buy 3 Honey,go to Barcelona and buy 5 Apple. Bring them to Hell in Barcelona City.

Name: Chocolate candy(2)
Offer: We still need some very important material to make the chocolate candy,I heard Karabash in Gibraltar Straits has the precious chocolate.
Objective: Enter the Gibraltar Straits Instance and kill the Karabash's Hammerhead, get the Precious chocolate and the bring it back to Hell.

Name: Go to the Halloween party
Offer: I've made the chocolate candy,and I will bring them to Riley when Halloween is coming. Now, can you please bring back some Devil emblems by killing some ghosts in Athens Suburb? Because Riley need the tickets for teparty with you.
Objective: Go to the Athens Suburb and kill the Halloween Ghost, get The Devil emblem and bring it to the Halloween event officer.

Name: Santa's request
Offer: Dear captain, Christmas is coming!But there are still some preparations that the busy Santa Claus hasn't finished this year.,he can do nothing but ask you,Captian for help.
Objective: Talk with the Santa Claus in the London City.

Name: Make the sweets
Offer: Dear Captain,Aha,long time no see!How can such a lively Christmas lack of delicious sweets.I'm going to make some special sweets this time.Unfortunately,I couldn't seek out the meterials what i want here,so may I trouble you to bring me some of them back?
Objective: Go to Beirut to buy 5 Granulated Sugar from the Trader,Go to Venice to buy 5 Orange.And bring them to Santa Claus in London City.

Name: Christmas dinner
Offer: Captain,Thank you for your help!I am preparing for Christmas dinner and need some Turkey at present.I hear that Turkey in Jamestown outskirts tastes good,I really have something else on here but trouble you to hunt some for me.
Objective: Go to Jamestown outskirts and kill 10 Turkey,bring them back to London City and talk with Santa Claus.

Name: Repair the Christmas sled
Offer: Ah,by the way.when I was preparing the sled I just found that the sled has beome losse because it hasn't been used in quite some time,also it looks old than usual. Oh,hey.Don't look at me that way.I am not pretentious!I just want to embody the ideal of a perfect Santa Claus to these children who expecting a surprise all over the world.So please, help me do some preparation work for repairing the sled,collect some meterials.
Objective: Get 10 Argentwood and 10 Firebug Stone, bring them to Santa Claus in London City.

Name: Tame Elk
Offer: Haha!How's my sled,cool isn't it?What,you want one too?Allright, for so many assists'sake, I can provide you a chance. There are some reindeer in the suburb.If having predestined relationship between you and them really, I believe some of them are willing to follow you.
Objective: Go to the London Suburb and capture the Honest elk (you may need the The food in elk's favorr), then talk with Santa Claus.

Name: Pirate the pirate
Offer: Who would have thought you could capture them? Since the elk is willing to follow you for a while,I will keep my promise and make a sled for you.There are some remaining meterials you prepared for me.But it's may be difficult to make the sled at present because I still want some oversize planks and cable. I heard there are some pirates in North Sea,well, you know what I mean?
Objective: Enter the North Sea Battlefield and sink Jackal Armed Ship,get 3 Oversize planks and 3 cable and bring them to Santa Claus in London City.

Name: Magical Gift
Offer: Excellent,we got everything we need.Wow,It seems that the pirates enjoy their well-off life now,look at the cable,the quality is so good.Give me a bread, I will finish your sled soon.I am going to make your sled,Well,don't idle away your precious time.I want to make some Magical gift,could you please bring me some energy pendant back?
Objective: Enter the Battled Forest Instance in the Hurricane Island and Kill the Battled Backbreaker, get 3 Energy Pendant and Sail Off, bring them to Santa Claus in London City.

Name: Wishes of Kids
Offer: Thank you very much you've done me a great service.Here,your sled.cool isn't it?Say, how would you like to be a Santa Claus?I had made some sweets recently,take them to Jime in Seville City.He wrote me every month said he desired a delicious sweets,I believe your arrival will make him very surprised.I should go back to my christmas work,so,see you captain.
Objective: Bring the Christmas sweets to Jim in Seville City
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The troublemaking Crete Minotaur
Offer: What a wonderful time it is,however the residents in the Crete are pretty mad about the troublemaking Crete Minotaur.Go to Crete and teach the Minotaur a lesson.(There will be a Sign-in Envoy near the Crete Minotaur at 8 P.M. every night,sign in there and the finish the task.Attention please,the Sign-in Envoy will disappear since 22 P.M)
Objective: Talk with the Sign-in Envory in Crete Inland. [Show up at 8 P.M every night near the Crete Minotaur]

Name: Ask for Information
Offer: Hi, friend! Have you heard the news? Recently, someone has been releasing a large number of naval quests. It is said that some of the rewards for completing these special quests are quite generous. It really makes one's heart race! If I had a ship, I would definitely try my luck...
Objective: Go to the London Tavern and ask the Bartender for information.

Name: Accept Quest
Offer: These silver coins are so beautiful! Hahaha! Ahem... anyway, what you heard is true. The person who posted the quest is in London. All we know is that they used to be a wealthy pirate in the area, but now they've changed their identity and become an honest businessman. I don't know what the local government is doing about it.
Objective: Go to London to find Everton and see if you can get some benefits.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Proof of Strength (1)
Offer: Good timing. Indeed, I'm the one who posted those naval quests. However, it's not that easy to receive quests from me. You need to prove your strength first. We need to assess your naval combat abilities first.
Objective: Sink a Spanish Ruby merchant ship and report to Everton.

Name: Proof of Strength (2)
Offer: Done already?! Your naval combat strength has indeed exceeded my expectations. As I said, naval quests prioritize naval battle strength, but land battle strength cannot be neglected either. Show me what you're capable of.
Objective: Go to Havana and kill 10 American Randhawa Tigers and bring back 5 Tiger Teeth. Talk to the Docker and report to Everton\.

Name: Meeting Gift
Offer: Your strength is exceptional! Even a powerful pirate like myself have to be careful when dealing with you. (Oops, I might have said too much) Haha, don't worry about the details. Anyway, I have assessed your strength! You are qualified to accept my missions.
Objective: Collect 5 pieces of gold and deliver them to Drake in London City.

Name: Return
Offer: Go back and tell Everton I have accepted the gold he sent. As long as he serves the Empire well, I will speak highly of him to the queen.
Objective: Report back to Everton.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Go
Offer: Can you resist the temptation of gold? Captain, you are truly qualified to accept my mission. As you can see, the once notorious pirates have transformed into prosperous and legitimate imperial merchants with official support. This does not reflect my wisdom, but the needs of the Empire. Take this letter of recommendation and go to Havana to find Gerani Sabo. He will tell you the specific details.
Objective: Take Everton's letter of recommendation to Havana and find Gerani Sabo.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Explore Havana
Offer: Welcome! Everton has never sung such high praise of you before! It seems we have gained another powerful ally. Dear Captain, take this map and two days to familiarize yourself with the Havana region. I believe you will make some discoveries...
Objective: Go to Havana to collect 10 Sugarcanes and deliver them to Gerani Sabo.

Name: Start
Offer: You are right. Nowadays, a large number of Spanish merchants and soldiers have gathered in Havana because they have discovered abundant mineral resources, sugarcane, and other resources here. However, they want to quietly occupy this place and the Empire cannot tolerate it. Given the strong maritime power of Spain, the Empire also cannot openly take them on. Thus, the wise Queen decided to recruit neutral captains like you to raid the Spanish maritime trade. Of course, there are also conditions. You must hand over 80% of the loot obtained from the raid to the Empire. In return, the Empire will provide you with some "convenience". After you hand over the loot, the Empire will give you an irresistible reward. Now, take my letter and go to the front line.
Objective: Go to Havana and find Drake Francis.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: First Raid
Offer: Hello, Captain! Oh, I mean, Pirate (feels a bit awkward...). Start your privateering journey now.
Objective: Talk to the Docker. Set sail to the Caribbean route to hijack the Spanish Sapphire merchant ship and collect 10 silver (can be purchased from the Trader) and deliver it to Havana 's Gerani Sabo.

Name: Repay Crew
Offer: The first privateering operation was surprisingly successful. We should celebrate.
Objective: Talk to the Docker. Set sail to purchase 5 boxes of brandy (can be purchased from the Trader) and deliver them to Havana's 的 Gerani Sabo.

Name: Second Raid
Offer: After the success of our first privateering, we must accomplish a bigger one this time and make adequate preparations.
Objective: Talk to the Docker.Set sail to the Caribbean route to hijack the Spanish Sapphire merchant ship and collect 10 gold (can be purchased from the Trader) and deliver it to Havana 's Gerani Sabo.

Name: Queen's Call
Offer: Our success on the Caribbean route has caught the attention of the Queen of England, and some British officers have also expressed their approval of us.
Objective: Talk to the Docker. Set sail for London and talk to Drake.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Accept Commendation
Offer: The Queen has heard about your performance and received a decree from the Empire to bestow upon you the title of Baron and the corresponding nobility attire. Congratulations on becoming an official member of the Empire's Royal Pirates. We hope you will continue to serve the Empire with dedication, and rest assured that the Empire will not disappoint you.
Objective: Meet Queen Elizabeth and receive the honor of knighthood.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Queen's Order (1)
Offer: You received the Queen's orders. Head to the pirate city of Tortuga to meet with other pirates. Someone will greet you upon arrival there.
Objective: Go to Tortuga City and meet with the Queen's confidant.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Queen's Order (2)
Offer: Go to Havana. The Queen likes all kinds of fur, so she hopes you can collect some animal skins. Prepare for the journey and be careful of the Spanish along the way. Let's try to avoid conflict with them for now.
Objective: Talk to the Docker. Set sail for Havana and kill 10 Havana Crocodile and 10 Havana Black Bear to collect Rare Beast Skin*10. Talk to the Docker to set sail for Tortuga City and report to the Confidant.

Name: Queen's Order (3)
Offer: You discovered some Spanish infantry on the way to hunting beasts. Observing from afar, you saw quite a few of them. This matter needs to be told to our other friends in Havana.
Objective: Talk to the Docker. Set sail for Havana and fill Hadorei on the details.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Queen's Order (4)
Offer: The Spanish have already landed in Havana, and we don't know what their intentions are. Go assassinate a few of them and see if you can gather any clues. If you find anything, report it immediately to the Queen's confidant. The situation is critical, act quickly.
Objective: In the Havana area, kill 10 Spanish Musketeers and 5 Spanish Assault Troopers to collect an Encrypted Letter (10 clues will merge into an Encrypted Letter). Talk to the Docker and set sail to deliver it to the Confidant in Tortuga City.

Name: Queen's Order (5)
Offer: It seems that our trusted lord is not a good person after all and is taking credit for all the work. Seems Havana is no longer safe for me. I need to hurry back to England and have a serious talk with the tavern owner.
Objective: Talk to the Docker and set sail for London Tavern and have a drink with the Bartender.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Queen's Order (6)
Offer: Recently, I recounted everything to the tavern owner and learned that he actually has another identity, possibly a high-ranking one. Before leaving, he gave me a letter of recommendation to find Edward and assured me that I wouldn't be treated unfairly. I decided to wait until tomorrow to see what happens. After Edward learned of the situation, he said to me, "Ah, you're the brave hero who returned from the sea. The Empire will not forget your contributions. Come and meet the Queen, and you will receive first-class treatment from the Empire. Tonight, we will welcome you and show our hospitality. Please pardon our negligence.
Objective: Take the Recommendation Letter to Edward.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Promote Rank
Offer: Congratulations, Pirate. The Empire has not forgotten about your contributions. In recognition of your outstanding performance, the Queen invites you to London to receive a nobility rank of Duke.
Objective: Meet with Queen Elizabeth. The Queen needs to attend to numerous state affairs and has given a clear response that an ennoblement ceremony will be held. Please wait patiently.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Extra Mission
Offer: "Welcome back, hero! We have prepared an ennoblement ceremony for you. As we are still missing a few things, we cannot promote you at the moment. Please think of a solution!
Objective: Collect 10 Bottles of Rum and bring them to the Bartender at the London Tavern#.

Name: Confer Title
Offer: "So, you've settled these matters, Captain. Your abilities truly astound me. Alright, let's begin the ennoblement ceremony.
Objective: Talk to Queen Elizabeth to complete the ennoblement ceremony.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Recruit Sailor
Offer: The ennoblement ceremony is over. Now is the time to demonstrate the Empire's resolve. The most direct way is to kidnap the Spanish envoy while they are on their way back to their country. This is a crucial matter, so we must be well prepared.
Objective: Go to the London Tavern# and ask the Bartender to help recruit a group of reliable sailors.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Conquer Pirates
Offer: The best way to avoid being discovered by the Empire is to have real pirates come forward. Even if they fail, they won't come after you. The most effective way to hire pirates is to fight them, make them afraid, make them submit, and make them willing to help you.
Objective: Go to Havana and kill 5 Spanish Spies. Report to Hadorei.

Name: Escape
Offer: "The return of pirates has been confirmed. Due to the secret support of the Royal Pirates' privateering activities by England and France, the pirate forces have become even stronger and shown a tendency to be beyond the control of the Empire. Therefore, the Empire and the Spanish have reached a consensus to limit the development of the Royal Pirates and to start besieging them with the help of the Spanish.
Objective: Go to Athens and talk to the Athenian Diplomat to request a temporary respite from the Spanish aggression.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Conqueror
Offer: New colonies have been discovered, but due to the leak of information, there has been a large-scale conflict among nations over resource allocation. Show your strength and bring victory to your side, bringing the dawn of a new era.
Objective: In the cross-server Havana battlefield, kill 2 enemy faction players. After completing the quest, submit it via the New Colonial Governor at the Hall of Memories.

Name: Domination
TargetName: battlefield contribution of 50 points or more
Offer: In the Havana battlefield, kill enemy players, occupy central resources, and defeat bosses and creatures to increase battlefield contribution.
Objective: In the cross-server Havana battlefield, obtain a battlefield contribution of 50 points or more. After completing the quest, submit it via the New Colonial Governor at the Hall of Memories.

Name: Collecting Canned [Top]
Offer: In this area food spoils so easily that explorers often had to interrupt their expeditions because of food problems. It was discovered that by placing those freshly meats into fermenting barrels, they could be made into canned food and thus preserved for long periods of time. This method of storing meat had not yet been practiced in Europe! Canned [Top] needs to be obtained through fermentation Tip: Purchase [Fermentation Barrels] from the grocer in the camp, go to the campsite's Fermenter Administrator to report the placement of the barrels, open the barrels, put in the fermentation main material (necessary) and the auxiliary ingredient, click on Start Fermentation, and wait for the fermentation to complete Meat of various qualities (Desire World animals drop after death) is the main material for fermentation, the higher the quality the better the fermentation effect. The spices collected in the wild can be used as auxiliary materials for fermentation, but exactly which spices are adapted to which kind of meat is not yet known, it can only be confirmed that high-quality Reishi (collected or cultivated in the caves) has a facilitating effect on the fermentation of all meats!
Objective: Collect a few Canned [Top] and give them to the camp's Alliance Quest officer.
