Name: Pirate the pirate
Offer: Who would have thought you could capture them? Since the elk is willing to follow you for a while,I will keep my promise and make a sled for you.There are some remaining meterials you prepared for me.But it's may be difficult to make the sled at present because I still want some oversize planks and cable. I heard there are some pirates in North Sea,well, you know what I mean?
Objective: Enter the North Sea Battlefield and sink Jackal Armed Ship,get 3 Oversize planks and 3 cable and bring them to Santa Claus in London City.

Name: Magical Gift
Offer: Excellent,we got everything we need.Wow,It seems that the pirates enjoy their well-off life now,look at the cable,the quality is so good.Give me a bread, I will finish your sled soon.I am going to make your sled,Well,don't idle away your precious time.I want to make some Magical gift,could you please bring me some energy pendant back?
Objective: Enter the Battled Forest Instance in the Hurricane Island and Kill the Battled Backbreaker, get 3 Energy Pendant and Sail Off, bring them to Santa Claus in London City.

Name: Wishes of Kids
Offer: Thank you very much; you've done me a great service.Here,your sled.cool isn't it?Say, how would you like to be a Santa Claus?I had made some sweets recently,take them to Jime in Seville City.He wrote me every month said he desired a delicious sweets,I believe your arrival will make him very surprised.I should go back to my christmas work,so,see you captain.
Objective: Bring the Christmas sweets to Jim in Seville City
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The troublemaking Crete Minotaur
Offer: What a wonderful time it is,however the residents in the Crete are pretty mad about the troublemaking Crete Minotaur.Go to Crete and teach the Minotaur a lesson.(There will be a Sign-in Envoy near the Crete Minotaur at 8 P.M. every night,sign in there and the finish the task.Attention please,the Sign-in Envoy will disappear since 22 P.M)
Objective: Talk with the Sign-in Envory in Crete Inland. [Show up at 8 P.M every night near the Crete Minotaur]

Name: Secret of the Pyramid
Offer: There is a world famous pyramid in the suburbs of Alexandria. No one can explain the secret of it. Few can go near the Pyramid around which is occupied by tomb raiders. The Adventurer Guild members who want to enter it need three keys. The keys can be found from the Leader of the tomb raiders. Can you help me get these keys?
Objective: Collect 3 keys from the Leader of the tomb raiders, and bring them to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Oslo.

Name: Shipping Task
Offer: Wine of Bordeaux is world famous. Pirates are rampant in North Europe. Merchants dare not go there. A minister wants to hold a party. Can you go to Bordeaux to buy two cases of brandy and one case of champagne? You can go by yourself or escort merchant ship to buy them for you. Please hurry!
Objective: Go to buy 2 cases of brandy and 1 case of champagne in Bordeaux City and and bring them to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Oslo.

Name: Frenzied Bears
Offer: There are many bears in Mallorca, so many people cannot go here. The Fury Bear is the fiercest. Could you go to Mallorca and kill 5 Fury Bears?
Objective: Kill 5 Fury Bears, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Oslo.

Name: Journey to Africa
TargetName: North Sea Golden Eye Armed Ships
Offer: Dakar Harbor of Africa is an important supply harbor. Many ships from Britain are lost after passing Dakar and they is said to be robbed by Golden Eye pirates. Now I send you to Dakar to get more information and to sink 5 North Sea Golden Eyes Armed Ships.
Objective: When Sailing to Dakar, please sink 5 North Sea Golden Eye Armed Ships. After that, ask King# the situation and bring back his information of pirate,after that, talk to Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Hamburg.

Targets.Name: North Sea Golden Eye Armed Ships

Name: Weapon Drawing
Offer: Mutassar in Congo Forest has a passel of weapon drawings. Deliver this letter to him and he will give you a drawing. Here is a passport to the Congo jungle. Remember that it can be used only once. If you want to cancel this task after accepting it, I will have to charge you 100000 silver coins to cover my costs of providing you this passport.
Objective: Deliver this letter to Mutassar in Congo Forest
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Mystic Cave
Offer: It is said that there are various kinds of bats in a mysterious cave in Mallorca Island, but no explorer has catalogued them all. Could you go there and kill 5 bats of each kind? We can provide the information you collect to the explorers and scholars who study them...
Objective: Kill Ghost Bat, the Black Bat, the Fox Bat and the Vampire Bat, 5 for each, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Hamburg.

Name: Pirate Hunting
Offer: Crete island is occupied by pirates. The merchants of the Mediterranean Sea are complaining. The nearby alliance sent us a letter requesting help. Do you have time to destroy some pirates on Crete? If so, start by killing 5 pirate falchion men.
Objective: Kill 5 Pirate Saberers, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Reykjavik.

Name: Importing Watches
Offer: Horologe produced by Lisboa is well-known in Europe. Leo, the old tailor of Lisbon has a fine old watch, which is to be brought to our presiding judge. I have yet to find anyone up to the task: it is a long distance through pirate infested waters. Are you up to the job? This is my letter to Leo.
Objective: Take the letter to Leo in Lisbon and bring back his watch, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Reykjavik.

Name: Anubis
Offer: It is said that Anubis is the patron saint who escorts the spirits across the river. He and death go hand in hand. Someone claims to have seen him on the top floor of the Pyramid. Will you go and prove his existence for us?
Objective: Kill Anubis and bring back his head to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in London.

Name: The Legend of Crete
Offer: It's said that because King Minos offended the god Poseidon, the God made the wife of Minos fall in love with a bull. She gave birth to a Minotaur (also called Minotaur Bull), a man-eating monster with the head of a bull and the body of a man. The Minotaur was shut in a labyrinth. Minos ordered the King of Athens to send 7 young boys and 7 young girls to feed it every year. Now there still is a Biaxe Labyrinth on the Crete island. Go to have a look at the first floor and kill two toxic scorpions and two Drybone Skulls.
Objective: Kill 2 toxic scorpions and 2 Drybone Skulls, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in London.

Name: Mallorca Lizard
Offer: There are many lizards on Mallorca Island. At Cape Town Port, there is an expert named Cathelin who is doing research on creatures. He is really willing to help the Ares Warrior Alliance. You must first go to Mallorca Island and kill one lizard of every kind and then take them to Cathelin. He will give you weapon drawings. This is my recommendation letter, take it to him.
Objective: Go to Mallorca Caves to kill the Lizard, Cave Lizard, Poisonous Lizard,Dragon Lizard and Giant Lizard, 1 for each, then talk to Cathelin at Cape Town Port

Name: Help the Scholar
Offer: Grace, who is a scholar in Dakar, is an expert on pyramids. She can't go to the Pyramids, for she is giving lectures in Dakar. Please find a Key of Pyramid for her. The leader of the tomb raiders who is near the pyramid has the Key of Pyramid. Send this letter together with the key that you find to her.
Objective: Take a Key of Pyramid and a letter about Pyramid to the Scholar Grace.

Name: Purchase Goods
Offer: Mutton from the Mediterranean Sea is very popular here, but we need pepper when we cook it. Pepper is native to Accra. The merchants don't like to go there, because they are afraid of danger. Will you go there and buy some pepper for me? I need two baskets of pepper.
Objective: Go to buy 2 baskets of pepper in Accra City, and take them to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Bordeaux.

Name: About Cannibals
Offer: It is said that there are man-eaters in Mallorca Island. Many explorers never come back from there. Can you go to search for the secret of man-eaters? If you kill five of them, please come to me for your reward.
Objective: Kill 5 Cannibal Warriors in Mallorca Island, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Bordeaux.

Name: Exploring Old Castle
Offer: An ancient deserted castle in the suburb is now occupied by a flock of wolves. Could you go to the castle to investigate the event and kill three wolves of each species?
Objective: Kill 3 Coyotes, 3 Wildwolves and 3 Jackals, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Lisbon.

Name: Attract Pirates
TargetName: Gibraltar Steel Tooth Armed Ship among steel tooth pirate
Offer: the steel tooth pirates in the Mediterranean are rampant. They only rob the goods higher than level 3, affecting the trade of our city brandy seriously. Take some brandy and go out to sea to exterminate a Gibraltar Steel Tooth Armed Ship among steel tooth pirate!
Objective: Take some brandy and go out to sea to exterminate a Gibraltar Steel Tooth Armed Ship among steel tooth pirate, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Lisbon.

Targets.Name: Gibraltar Steel Tooth Armed Ship among steel tooth pirate

Name: Build New Ships
Offer: The Laborer Guild is producing battle ships for us, but they are short of canvas. They need canvas produced in Stockholm. Could you go to buy the canvas? We need 5 batches.
Objective: Go to buy 5 canvas in Stockholm City and bring them to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Lisbon.

Name: Sicily Bees
Offer: Many explorers disappeared in Sicily Island. It's said that this was caused by the various kinds of bees. Now we know there are Queen Bees, Killer Bees and Poison Stinger Bees. Can you go to kill 5 of each kind for study?
Objective: Kill 5 Queen Bees, 5 Killer Bees and 5 Poison Stinger Bees, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Seville.

Name: Purchase Jam
Offer: Reykjavik City teems with fruit jam. But pirates in North Europe are rampant, so many merchants dare not go there. Can you go to buy a basket of fruit jam for me and destroy 1 Gibraltar Steel Tooth Armed Ship on your way home? They are members of the Steel Tooth Pirates.
Objective: Go to buy a basket of fruit jam in Reykjavik City and destroy 1 Gibraltar Steel Tooth Armed Ship, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Seville.

Name: Acquaint with British Handmaiden
Offer: British aristocrats like to collect various kinds of mirrors. Now, the Ares Warrior Alliance in Britain should have a good relationship with the British Queen, but we don't have a chance. So we have to engage with the Queen's maids. Please go to the trade house to buy two mirrors and give them to her maid named Jone. She usually takes a walk near the Queen's palace in London.
Objective: Take 2 mirrors to London and give them to Jone, then bring back the reply to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Seville.

Name: Escort Goods
Offer: Ilene in Seville City is a lumberman. He once provided timber for our alliance to make arms. We decided to give him some of the specialties of Barcelona, lobsters, to express our gratitude. Can you help me buy two cases of lobsters and bring his reply letter to me?
Objective: Go to buy two cases of lobsters to Ilene in Seville City, and bring his reply letter to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Barcelona.

Name: About the Pyramid
Offer: The pyramids in the suburb of Alexandria are a great miracle, but there are too many tomb raiders. They not only loot the pyramids, but they blockade the surrounding areas of pyramids. Can you go to collect information about them? You'd better kill 3 tomb raider(s) (swordsman). Be careful!
Objective: Kill 3tomb raider(s) (swordsman), then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Barcelona.

Name: Destroy the Lord of Wolves
Offer: There are flocks of wild wolves in the Suburb, and the Wolf Lord is their leader. If you want to destroy the Wolf Lord, you'd best go there with some friends. Wolves hunt in packs, and you should avoid being surrounded by them. Best of luck, brave warrior.
Objective: Kill 1 Wolf Lord, and then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Genoa.

Name: Destroy the Lord of Wolves
Offer: There are gangs of wild wolves in the suburb recently, and there is a Wolf Lord among them. Go and kill it. Take some Healing Potions with you, and be careful not to let them surround you.
Objective: Kill 1 Wolf Lord, and then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Venice.

Name: Brandy
Offer: Abdullah, the notorious pirate, is hiding out on a small Island in the Aegean sea. Do you have the strength to defeat him? If you can, best him in combat and bring back one bottle of his Quality Brandy.
Objective: bring back one bottle of his Quality Brandy to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Venice.

Name: Collect Crab Pincers
Offer: A new seafood restaurant in Athens serves up a fine crab dish, and they're always looking for meat. It's not much of a task for an experienced warrior, but a green fellow like yourself could whet his sword by killing a few of them. Could you collect 8 crab pincers for me? I'll even throw in a new fight suit if you come back in one piece!
Objective: Take 8 crab pincers to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Athens.

Name: Fetching Letters Quest
Offer: Do you want to sail off now? You can rebuild your ship from the shipyard boss, but you will need to provide him with some necessary materials, and also pay for it. Then, you can sail off, as long as you have sailors and provisions. Can you go to Alexandria to find Dysseus and bring a letter back to me? I will give you a reward.
Objective: Go to Alexandria and fetch a letter from Dysseus! Then deliver it to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Athens.

Name: Task of Hides
Offer: Tania in Tripoli needs some hides to make battle uniforms for the Warrior Alliance. Can you go to collect some for her? Find a ragged hide and deliver it to Tania in Tripoli. The Warrior Alliance will reward your efforts.
Objective: Find a ragged hide and deliver it to Mahmoud in Alexandria.

Name: Search For Pilose Antlers
Offer: One of our warriors was injured while performing a task for the Alliance. We need a Pilose Antler to brew his treatment. There are many reindeers in the suburb. Kill one and bring back its antler. Be careful and quick; your fallen comrade is waiting for you.
Objective: Find a Pilose Antler and deliver it to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Athens.

Name: Escort Gifts
Offer: Now the Ares Warrior Alliance needs information about pirates. Simbara from Tripoli was once captured by them. So you can go to visit him bringing gifts and he will give you some information about pirates in return. Can you go and present the gifts to him and bring back the letter? There will be some pirates attacking you on the way. Do be careful!
Objective: Take this package to him and bring back his statement,then take it to Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Athens.

Name: Explorers' Troubles
Offer: The Adventurer Alliance recently turned to us for help. Their members are often attacked by wolves in the Suburbs. We've thinned out the wolves in this town, but things are different in Tripoli. Can you go to Tripoli and kill 2 wolves? The Adventurer Alliance has provided some drawings as a reward to whoever can complete this task.
Objective: Kill 2 Wild Wolves, and then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Athens.

Name: Kill the Blue Poet
Offer: There is a Depressed Poet living up by the Parthenon. His poetry is awful, and he's drawn his sword on the poor passersby who don't want to listen to it. The Warrior Alliance has been asked by the local guards to put an end to his sad existence. He's pretty strong for a pathetic little whiner, so be sure to bring along some Healing Potions.
Objective: Kill the Depressed Poet, and then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Athens.

Name: Kill Jackals
Offer: Jackals lurk in the suburb and hunt in packs. If you are surrounded, you're in deep trouble. Take some friends and go exterminate 5 Jackals!
Objective: Kill 5 Jackals, and then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Tripoli.

Name: Sicily Island
Offer: Many Adventurer Alliance members have been attacked by poison stingers on Sicily Island. Can you kill 10 poison stingers and bring back 5 stings? Don't get poisoned yourself! Also, beware of pirates around the island.
Objective: Kill 10 poison stingers and bring back 5 stings, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Tripoli.

Name: Kill Coyotes
Offer: Wolves haunt the suburb, hunting in packs for unwary travelers. Please take some friends and kill 5 coyotes. Good luck!
Objective: Kill 5 coyotes, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Algiers.

Name: Mallorca Island
Offer: Mallorca Island lies near Algeria. It is surrounded by pirates, and ordinary folk can't get there easily. A local merchant was shipwrecked there and claims that there are grizzly bears on the island. Could you go there and bring back proof? If there are grizzly bears on the island, kill 5 and return here.
Objective: Kill 5 grizzly bears, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Algiers.

Name: About Mummies
Offer: It is said that there are many mummies inside the pyramid of Alexandria, and explorers who go inside never come out. As a glorious warrior, can you go and eliminate 5 mummies? It will be a great favor for explorers.
Objective: Defeat the Dry Mummy,the Giant Arm Mummy, the Bewitch Mummy and the Stinky Mummy, 5 for each, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Stockholm.

Name: Viking
Offer: Northern Europe has been plagued by pirates. Sometimes they even appear near the suburbs of major cities. Our soldiers' patrol hasn't been able to root them out. Can you go to the suburbs and kill 5 pirates? City residents will thank you, brave warrior.
Objective: Kill 5 vikings, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Stockholm.

Name: Gibraltar Jackal Armed Ship
Offer: Gibraltar Jackal Raiding ships have blockaded almost every port around the Mediterranean Sea. Most of the merchant ships have been assaulted. Rampant pirates have humiliated us! It's every warrior's responsibility to eliminate them!
Objective: Go to Gibraltar Battlefield to defeat 5 Gibraltar Jackal Armed Ship, then talk to Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Madeira.

Name: Searching for Spider
Offer: There are different kinds of spiders in the Couple Axe Maze on the Crete Island. In the pub of the Cape Town Port, there is an expert on the creatures named Cathelin, who likes helping our alliance soldiers. Now you should go to the second floor of the Couple Axe Maze on the Crete Island and kill one spider of each kind. Then go and see Cathelin, who will reward you with weapon drawings.
Objective: Go to Double-Axe Labyrinth at Crete Inland to kill 1 Dead skin Spider,1 Giant Tarantula and 1 Poisonous Tarantula, Black Spider,then talk to Cathelin in Cape Town Tarven.

Name: Wolf Tooth
Offer: Your Land Battle Skill is good enough, so you must have collected many trophies. Various sorts of wolf fangs are articles for authentication as well as good ornaments. Can you give me the trophies? I am helping handicraftsmen collect wolf fangs.
Objective: Take more than 10 Fangs from any kind of wolves to Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Las Palmas.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: Jackal Pirate
Offer: Gibraltar Jackal Raiding Ships are so greedy and atrocious that people call them the Jackal Pirates. They congregate around Gibraltar, which is the mouth of the Mediterranean Sea and the passage to Africa. As a result, there are fewer and fewer ships going through the provision ports like Las Palmas. I command you sail off and sink 5 Gibraltar Jackal Raiding Ships and 5 Gibraltar Jackal Arm Ships.
Objective: Sink 5 Gibraltar Jackal Raiding Ships and 5 Gibraltar Jackal Arm Ships, then reply to Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Las Palmas.

Name: Viking
Offer: The pirates of Northern Europe are running rampant, not only on the sea. According to my information, they plague the suburbs of the cities in northern Europe as well. Because of the lack of warriors in those cities in northern Europe, so they are asking us for help. Can you go to exterminate some leaders of the Vikings? Take this assignment card and remember to bring it to me for the permission into the Gelei island dungeon.
Objective: Kill 3 Viking Lords, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Dakar.

Name: Legend of Stone Giant
Offer: According to legend, in Santa Maria Island Inland there are huge Stone Golems from prehistoric times, which are empowered by earth. I want information about Yellow Stone Golems. Can you go there and kill 2 Yellow Stone Golems? Bring back this Task Card when you are done and I will exchange it for a Goree Island Dungeon License.
Objective: Kill 2 Yellow Stone Golems, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Accra.

Name: Legend of Sea Serpent
Offer: On Santa Maria Island, Poseidon summoned a Herculean Sea Serpent to guard his palace. The Herculean Sea Serpent's power is so enormous that it can lift up any thing of any weight. Only the bravest warrior gets the chance to defeat her. Can you do it? Bring back this Task Card when your task is complete to exchange for a License to the Congo Jungle.
Objective: Kill 2 Herculean Sea Serpents, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Accra.

Name: Legend of Stone Giant
Offer: According to the legend, in Santa Maria Island Inland there are huge Stone Golems from prehistoric times, which are empowered by earth. I want to get information about Green Stone Golems, can you go there and kill 2 Green Stone Golems for me? Bring the Task Card to change for the Goree Island Dungeon License, and don't forget to bring it back to me.
Objective: Kill 2 Green Stone Golems, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Luanda.

Name: Legend of Sea Serpent
Offer: On Santa Maria Island, Poseidon summoned the Armored Sea Serpent to guard his palace, its armor is so hard that no weapons can penetrate it. I was hoping you would go and have a try. Bring the Task Card to change for the License to Congo Forest, and don't forget to bring it back.
Objective: Kill 2 Armored Sea Serpents, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Luanda.

Name: Legend of Stone Giant
Offer: According to the legend, in Santa Maria Island Inland there are huge Stone Golems from prehistoric times, which are empowered by earth. I want information on those Giants, can you go there and kill 2? Bring the Task Card to change for the Goree Island Dungeon License, and don't forget to bring it back.
Objective: Kill 2 Huge Stone Golems, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Cape Town.

Name: Legend of Sea Serpent
Offer: On Santa Maria Island, Poseidon summoned the Swift Sea Serpent to guard his palace, its armor is so hard that no weapons can penetrate it. I was hoping you would go and have a try. Bring the Task Card to change for the License to Congo Forest, and don't forget to bring it back.
Objective: Kill 2 Swift Sea Serpents, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Cape Town.

Name: Legend of Stone Giant
Offer: According to the legend, in Santa Maria Island Inland there are huge Stone Golems from prehistoric times, which are empowered by earth. I want information on those Giant Lords, can you go there and kill 2? Bring the Task Card to change for the Goree Island Dungeon License, and don't forget to bring it back.
Objective: Kill 2 Giant Lords, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Mozambique.

Name: Legend of Sea Serpent
Offer: On Santa Maria Island, Poseidon summoned Giant Sea Serpents to guard his palace. Herculean Sea Serpent is much bigger and stronger than an ordinary Sea Serpent. I want you to go and try killing it. Bring the Task Card to change for the License to Congo Forest, and don't forget to bring it back.
Objective: Kill 1 Giant Sea Serpent, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Mozambique.

Name: Challenging Santa Maria Island
TargetName: Cape of Good Hope Scorpion Raiding Ships
Offer: Since you've been to Santa Maria Island many times, can you eliminate the pirates around there? Find Cape of Good Hope Scorpion Raiding Ships and sink 5 of them. Here is the Task Card, you can change it for License. Don't forget to return it to me.
Objective: Kill 5 Cape of Good Hope Scorpion Raiding Ships, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Mogadishu.

Targets.Name: Cape of Good Hope Scorpion Raiding Ships

Name: End of Sea Serpent
Offer: You have learned those Sea Serpents very well. King Sea Serpent is the chieftain of Poseidon's land troops, its commanding ability is great and it will guard the palace till the last drop of its blood. Can you eliminate it?
Objective: Kill 1 King Sea Serpent, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Mogadishu.

Name: Escort Merchant Ships
Offer: Look, this Merchant Ship anchored in our port has got a little inside info from pirates. It seems they'll be attacked as soon as they leave port. Would you like to escort them? Their destination is Quanzhou.
Objective: Take the ship to Zhang Yuanqi in Quanzhou, and bring back the certificate to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Aden.

Name: Eastern Culture
Offer: Nalin who lives at the port is keen on Eastern culture. He once got to know a traveling monk from the East who promised him some books about Eastern culture. But he has never seen the monk ever since, it makes him really sad. Can you help him find the traveling monk?
Objective: Find Nalin to get the"Letter",then find XuanZhi to exchange for 'Books from the East',reply to Nalin again to get the reward.
GiverSource: GUESS turn-in NPC of the previous quest in the group

Name: The Legend of Crete
Offer: It is said that Minos peeved the djinn. The djinn let him fall in love with a bull, which gave birth to the Minotaur. The Minotaur was confined in a maze and Minos commanded the king of Athens to send 7 pairs of children and maidens to feed it. Now the Double-Axe Labyrinth is still on Crete Island, go and check if Minotaur really exists.
Objective: Kill 1 Minotaur, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Mascate.

Name: Investigation of Savages
Offer: The Hanging Garden in the suburb is world famous, but many savages converge there which prevents the explorers and travelers from going in. I don't know much about those savages. Would you like to collect information about them?
Objective: Go to kill 1 Jungle Goblin, 1 Spearman Goblin, 1 Dart Goblin, and 1 Poison Dart Goblin, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Basra.

Name: Strange Horse
Offer: I heard that there is a very strange kind of horse in the African jungles, whose body is embellished with black-and-white stripes. Can you find out where such horse a lives?
Objective: Kill 1 Zebra, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Basra.

Name: Hunt Rhinoceros
Offer: Nowadays the local officials are fond of using cups made from the horns of a kind of rhinoceros. The horns can also be used as a medical material in the East. Experienced hunters are needed to collect rhinoceros horns. Are you interested in joining the hunt?
Objective: Kill 2 Rhinoceros, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Bombay.

Name: Borobudur Temple Compounds
Offer: Borobudur is a Buddhist temple, assuming the shape of a pyramid. One can enter the temple climbing the steps. The base of the temple is square. There are 5 floors of platforms with sidewalls. On top of the square plantform is there are 4 round platforms. Each is smaller than the lower one. On the top is stands main tower which is guarded by many machine sculptures of Buddha. Try it by yourself to see if you can deal with the wood and stone Buddha machinery.
Objective: Kill Animated Wood Buddha and Animated Stone Buddha, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Bombay.

Name: Borobudur Temple Compounds
Offer: Borobudur is a Buddhist temple, assuming the shape of a pyramid. One can enter the temple climbing the steps. The base of the temple is square. There are 5 floors of platforms with sidewalls. On top of the square plantform is there are 4 round platforms. Each is smaller than the lower one. On the top is stands main tower which is guarded by many machine sculptures of Buddha. Try it by yourself to see if you can deal with the Animated Bronze Buddha and Animated Buddhism Guard.
Objective: Kill Animated Bronze Buddha and Animated Buddhism Guard, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in SriLanka.

Name: Translate Books
Offer: I heard that you've found an eastern book for Nalin in Suez. He is now depressed because he cannot understand the language of the book. You are well-informed and very knowledgable. See if you can help. I heard that there is a scholar in Beijing who has a solid grasp of many languages. Can you help him to find this man?
Objective: Find Nalin to get the book in Suez,then go to find Scholar Li in Beijing,Scholar Li asked me to fetch the translated book two days later and go to kill Black Fox Spirit, Send the translated Books to #Nalin.

Name: Borobudur Temple Compounds
Offer: Borobudur is a Buddhist temple, assuming the shape of a pyramid. One can enter the temple climbing the steps. The base of the temple is square. There are 5 floors of platforms with sidewalls. On top of the square plantform is there are 4 round platforms. Each is smaller than the lower one. On the top is stands main tower which is guarded by many machine sculptures of Buddha. Try it by yourself to see if you can deal with the Animated Golden Buddha.
Objective: Kill Animated Golden Buddha, then talk to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master in Malacca.

Name: About Fox Spirit
Offer: Most of the residents here are from China. They are very interested in Chinese culture and affairs. Not long ago, there was a Chinese scholar, who said a fox spirit appeared in the suburbs of Beijing. People here want to know the details. If you are going to China, could you please collect the information?
Objective: Kill one each of Fox Fairy, Fox Syren, Block Fox Spirit, and Original Form of Fox Syren,then get the ' Explanation of the Fox Spirit Fox Fairy'and take it back to Semarang.

Name: The Story of Benevolence Bead
Offer: It has been long said that there is a Humanity Bead in Semarang. It is said to have a relationship with the name of this place. A mysterious merchant said that as long as someone met his needs, he would give them the Humanity Bead. Are you interested in getting this Humanity Bead?
Objective: The merchant requires to change it for a piece of Velvet,a Tulip, a share of Marijuana, a share of Tobacco, a piece of Animal Hide, a piece of Silk, a share of Silk Fabric, a Antler Ornament, a Snake Gallbladder and a bottle of Chinese Medical Liquor. You can buy them in the Bourse of every city. And you can even make a divided payment.

Name: Realize Last Wish.
Offer: A brave British adventurer has been to Beijing, China, where he was summoned to an interview by the emperor and entrusted to bring a letter back. But he encountered the pirates here. He is now looking for someone who can send the letter to Queen Elizabeth. Can you help him?
Objective: Take 'ImperialLetter' and find the maid of the Queen Jone (require:finished quest 56),and then you give letter to Queen.if you are not finish quest 56, you need to pay 50000 Silver.If you get the Queen's Reply Letter, go to find emperor in Beijing.
